notes.title: Hotfix v1.2-1239
notes.content:
[p]Hi Farmers,[/p][p]We've released a hotfix to address your concerns with auto sort for storage, magnet range, and item prices not showing after selling.[/p][p]
[b]Bugfixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Price details now show up correctly after selling an item.[/p][/*][*][p]The auto-sort toggle button is now back.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a player magnet issue in single player where you had to wait until the floatie dropped before the magnet activated. The magnet now works just like before.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Storage drag-and-drop is now back as an optional feature. Enable it in Settings > Gameplay Options to use it again.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve increased the magnet range bonus when using the Forager Ring and Hoarder Ring.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]What's next:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixing remaining bugs from the 1.2 update[/p][/*][*][p]Working to resolve multiplayer connection issues.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll continue sharing updates on our bug-fixing progress via the beta channel on our [url="https://discord.gg/stairway"]Discord[/url]. Thank you so much for your patience and support.[/p][p][/p][p]Best regards,
[/p][p]Stairway Team[/p]

tags.bug: Price details now show up correctly after selling an item.
The auto-sort toggle button is now back.
Fixed a player magnet issue in single player where you had to wait until the floatie dropped before the magnet activated. The magnet now works just like before.

tags.feature: Storage drag-and-drop is now back as an optional feature. Enable it in Settings > Gameplay Options to use it again.

tags.balance_change: We’ve increased the magnet range bonus when using the Forager Ring and Hoarder Ring.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.2-1238
notes.content:
[p]Hi Farmers,[/p][p]We’ve just released an urgent hotfix to address an issue where Multiplayer could get stuck on “Connecting to Server” indefinitely. This issue still appeared to some players after the server upgrade yesterday, and this patch should resolve it.[/p][p]
Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Resolved the Multiplayer “Connecting to Server” screen indefinitely[/p][/*][/list][p]If you’re still experiencing problems after updating, please let us know via our Discord or the Steam forum.[/p][p]Thank you for your patience and understanding.[/p][p]
Best regards,[/p][p]
The Stairway Team[/p]

tags.bug: Resolved the Multiplayer “Connecting to Server” screen indefinitely

notes.title: 2025 Roadmap & March Dev Update!
notes.content:
Welcome to the March 2025 Coral Island development update!


This blog will showcase some of the exciting things Stairway Games has been working on, including the upcoming [b]1.2 update, "Multiplayer and Romance."[/b]


[b]The Coral Island Multiplayer and Romance update is set to launch in the summer of 2025


Join our [url=http://discord.gg/stairway]Discord[/url] for more information![/b]



[u][h2]2025 Roadmap[/h2][/u]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_73ad9dff9dda42a2bbdfd8dffc646565~mv2.png[/img]



[u][h2]1.2 Update Overview[/h2][/u]


We’re making amazing progress on the [b]1.2 update[/b], and currently, we are wrapping up key features. This update is one of our biggest yet, with [b]over 100,000 words of new text[/b] localized into multiple languages. 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3a0adaa46b8f468bb83071285822001e~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_2328,h_2184,al_c,q_90/491ae5_3a0adaa46b8f468bb83071285822001e~mv2.webp[/img]


Alongside all the exciting new content, we’re also fixing bugs at a record pace to ensure everything runs smoothly. Final testing is just around the corner, and we can’t wait to share the update with you soon!



[u][h2]Multiplayer [/h2][/u]


Get ready to experience Coral Island with friends!


The team has been hard at work, and thanks to your helpful feedback (and willingness to break the game!), we’ve fixed [b]over 500 bugs[/b] related to Multiplayer alone. Here are a few highlights of what’s in store:


[b]Co-op Fieldwork:[/b] Team up to share resources and daily chores!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_53c6ac0e1fce4b53add229569910ab7c~mv2.gif[/img]


[b]Co-op Farming:[/b] Expand your farm, grow crops together, and build bigger barns.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_26565aeae4ee432493928f77fd63cdb4~mv2.gif[/img]


[b]Co-op Exploration:[/b] Dive into the ocean, brave the mines, and uncover secrets in the Cave of Memorie together!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_47c2d2a4f7354db49c993afc1012076f~mv2.gif[/img]


[b]Co-op Rivalries:[/b] Compete in friendly challenges and see who’s the ultimate farmer.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_c8953588f6354c6db0e006e6621c824b~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/491ae5_c8953588f6354c6db0e006e6621c824b~mv2.png[/img]


[b]Co-op Marriage:[/b] Take your in-game relationships to the next level with multiplayer marriage!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0f15c9e1a7c643689650e179f4d55282~mv2.gif[/img]



[u][h2]Revamped Romance Progression [/h2][/u]


We’re making romance on [b]Coral Island[/b] more engaging and meaningful, giving your relationships with dateable characters [b]new depth and progression[/b]. Here’s what’s changing:


[b]New Progression:[/b] We’re introducing a heart-locking system to add more depth to relationships. Check out the media below for a simple breakdown of how to unlock hearts and progress with your favorite islanders! Start the game with access to Hearts 0–5 right away.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_572c5b68438c4163b4fd61c636be783b~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_1110,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/491ae5_572c5b68438c4163b4fd61c636be783b~mv2.png[/img]



Before you can start dating:


[list]
[*] Give a locket as a symbol of commitment.
[*] Join their hangout cutscenes to get to know them better before taking the next step.
[/list]


Building relationships takes time, and we want every step to feel special!


[b]Hangout Events:[/b] Spend quality time with your favorite islanders through optional mini-events. Whether it’s a cozy picnic, a jam session, or a spontaneous beach bonfire, these events let you share special moments with NPCs.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_dab8f9daa51f4e87a7f29e4b2ebb57cf~mv2.gif[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_b5d33e8bcd1b4151a96d4e26f3f76495~mv2.gif[/img]


[b]Hangout Cutscenes:[/b] Hangout events trigger unique cutscenes, focusing on your bond with an NPC. These are separate from [b]Heart Events[/b] and offer even more one-on-one time.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_b23953b43d834c24ab11013fa265766b~mv2.gif[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_dc23569648394836ba1bb779e3fc6921~mv2.gif[/img]


[b]How to Access:[/b] The revamped romance system unlocks at [b]Heart Level 2[/b], and you’ll see a [b]prompt in the Relationship UI[/b] whenever a hangout event is available.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_b8a71ea10bfb439b8ab09b3aaeb2ecff~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_857,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/491ae5_b8a71ea10bfb439b8ab09b3aaeb2ecff~mv2.png[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3fc85fba2b8d402ea601d4a613b25e92~mv2.gif[/img]


[b]New Relationship Detail Tab:[/b] Easily track [b]hangout progress, gift preferences,[/b] and key moments in the brand-new interface.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_52307e5e31d448048217861cffef1f05~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_857,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/491ae5_52307e5e31d448048217861cffef1f05~mv2.png[/img]



[u][h2]Heart Events 11-15[/h2][/u]


Marriage Is Just the Beginning!


[b]At Heart Level 12,[/b] you’ll unlock [b]post-marriage events[/b] that explore life beyond the wedding. Here’s what to expect:


[b]Deeper Conversations: [/b]Discover new dialogue that reveals your spouse’s dreams, fears, and personal aspirations.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_5a403a569a6647ea9eb91d67ee3a3703~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_857,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/491ae5_5a403a569a6647ea9eb91d67ee3a3703~mv2.png[/img]


[b]Special Cutscenes:[/b] Share meaningful moments in daily life, from quiet mornings together to romantic dates that bring you closer.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_00934cbdeb6e427ba40bb200935b18f1~mv2.gif[/img]



[u][h2]Spooky Outfits[/h2][/u]


All [b]dateable characters[/b] will be getting their own Spooky Outfit just in time for the Spooky Festival! These outfits will appear every Fall season.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ad9f72464484490d81c10a2d97fed930~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_663,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/491ae5_ad9f72464484490d81c10a2d97fed930~mv2.png[/img]


You might also spot them during special ghost-story events—but only if your friendship with certain NPCs is close enough! We also[b] plan to have the kids wear costumes[/b] in a future update.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_59ca02e48ab944dd9de27315a9355971~mv2.gif[/img]


We’re keeping the full lineup a secret for now because we want you to experience it in-game for maximum immersion. But here’s a sneak peek at what’s in store…



[u][h2]Asset Updates[/h2][/u]


Winter is coming—literally!


Our team has given the island a [b]frosty makeover![/b] We’re [b]shoveling extra snow[/b] off [b]crops, buildings, and roads[/b]—while letting a little snow [b]pile up on the forgotten ones[/b] for that extra cozy, wintry touch.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_c986a81e3aad4a4db35695d3a36b714e~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_857,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/491ae5_c986a81e3aad4a4db35695d3a36b714e~mv2.png[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_f355e7538fdc47edab9fdcf7a832b0aa~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_857,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/491ae5_f355e7538fdc47edab9fdcf7a832b0aa~mv2.png[/img]



[h2][u]Nintendo Switch[/u][/h2]


Regarding Switch news, [b]we don't have any updates yet[/b]. Discussions are still ongoing. But don’t worry, as soon as we’ve got something to share, we will! We're just as eager as you all are to get this resolved!



[h2][u]What's Next[/u][/h2]


We’re nearing the [b]finish line[/b] for the [b]1.2 update![/b] Once we wrap up QA, bug fixing, and finalize localization, we’ll share the official release date. After that, the Coral Island devs will shift focus to the [b]1.3 update[/b], which will bring:


[list]
[*] Growing kids 
[*] A Haunted House minigame at the Spooky Festival 
[*] New minigames at the Recreation Center 
[*] Merfolk Festival
[*] And more!
[/list]


Thanks for reading,

Stairway Team

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1b-1237
notes.content:
Hi Farmers 🧑‍🌾,
This hotfix addresses issues with certain achievements not triggering and various Savannah-related issues, including a black screen in the Cave of Memories and players getting stuck after digging up Fenn's secret map treasure, along with other fixes to enhance your gameplay experience! 🎉

🐞 [b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed occasional black screen when advancing levels in Cave of Memories - Savannah.
[*] Fixed player getting stuck after digging up Fenn's Secret Map treasure.
[*] Fixed achievements not triggering in-game and on Steam, including:
[list]
[*] It's a Date 
[*] Bug Enjoyer
[*] Part-Time Curator
[*] But It’s Honest Work
[*] Capital Gains
[*] Bests of Friends
[*] Home Cook
[*] Ironclad Slayer
[/list]
[*] Fixed fruit trees disappearing after season changes when reloading a save in specific cases.
[*] Fixed items disappearing when placed on the same day a shed is moved via the Carpenter.
[*] Fixed crash when moving Clover on the farm using the Architect Desk.
[*] Fixed crash when canceling chest movement in decor mode.
[*] Fixed an edge case causing a black screen after clicking finish in decor mode.
[*] Fixed game freeze after interacting with Tourist's Box.
[*] Fixed Lumina Wand reverting to the basic level when using Help Me Find My Tools.
[*] Fixed duplicate tools after using Help Me Find My Tools in certain save files.
[*] Fixed Alien Scarecrow not appearing in the Concerned Monkey shop after breaking a meteor or satellite.
[*] Fixed players not receiving rewards for winning the Rodeo minigame at the Animal Festival.
[*] Fixed NPC heart colors randomly changing from red to grey in certain save files.
[*] Fixed adoptable pets becoming invisible every time after triggering a cutscene at the Community Center.
[*] Fixed pets becoming invisible when players hangout at the Volunteer Shelter.
[*] Fixed animals exiting barns and coops through closed doors if called outside before the day ends.
[*] Fixed Osmium-quality animal products downgrading after reloading a save file.
[*] Fixed animal products disappearing from Auto Collector after entering and exiting farm buildings in certain save files.
[*] Fixed a collision issue allowing players to enter the Underwater Barn near the side wall.
[*] Fixed horses going underwater when using fast travel while mounted.
[*] Fixed incorrect Town Rank point calculation during the end-of-day recap.
[*] Fixed Rafflesia flower incorrectly having a Goddess Blessing interaction.
[*] Fixed Underwater Kimchi being priced lower than Underwater Pickled.
[*] Fixed missing hairlines on certain character-customization hairstyles, leaving only bald areas.
[*] Fixed characters floating onto rooftops when triggering the Recreation Center completion cutscene during festivals.
[*] Fixed White Flamingo shop hours not showing on the map.
[*] Fixed the missing email invitation for Mark's 10-heart event.
[*] Fixed missing notification when receiving purchased items from the online shop.
[*] Fixed inability to track and pin Heart Event UI using the space bar.
[*] Fixed Pumpkin Pie incorrectly turning into Fruit Tart when manually cooked.
[*] Fixed no tourists appearing in town.
[*] Fixed the last-reached level option appearing after using Warp Sesajen, returning players to the wrong level.
[*] Fixed spouse floating near the bed while sleeping.
[*] Fixed spouse rooms remaining empty after the wedding ceremony.
[*] Fixed dinosaur skin not applying to winning animals from the Animal Festival.
[*] Fixed players' and Nina's feet clipping into the ground during Watch Film Hangout.
[*] Fixed ranch animals randomly spinning on the farm.
[*] Fixed Area C displaying negative numbers during the Tree Planting Festival.
[/list]

🎮 [b]Controller-only Bugfix:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Y button rebinding issue due to overlap with Restore Default command.
[*] Fixed character preview and cart behavior in White Flamingo.
[*] Fixed hangout location always defaults to the second option when selecting.
[/list]

💭 [b]Text and Dialogue:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some NPCs repeating dialogue about completed murals, museum fish collection, unlocked attractions, and the big tree being healed in certain save files.
[*] Fixed Aging Barrel text in Jeff Smith's letter to correctly show it as a claimable item instead of a blueprint upon reaching Advanced Farmer.
[*] Fixed various minor NPC dialogue issues.
[*] Fixed various localization issues.
[/list]

🪄 [b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added information in the Relationship tab about Sam's 2-Heart Event being unavailable on certain days.
[*] Updated Treasure Bubbles and Recycling Center UI text to Insert Crops and Insert Trash, respectively.
[*] Removed the shocked emoji SFX when interacting with NPCs.
[*] Enabled certain NPCs' Heart Events to trigger year-round:
[list]
[*] Chaem: 7b, 8, 8b, 10
[*] Eva: 8a
[*] Leah: 6b
[*] Luke: 2c
[*] Macy: 6, 8, 10 (10 available only on Spring, Summer, Fall)
[*] Suki: 2, 4, 6, 8a
[*] Theo: 3, 8
[*] Wakuu: 2, 5, 8
[/list]
[/list]

Thank you for sharing information about these issues and for your feedback. We truly appreciate your support and patience 🙏✨

Best regards,
Stairway Team 🪸

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1b-1234
notes.content:
Hi Farmers,

This hotfix addresses several issues in the game, with the most notable fixes being achievements not triggering in-game and on Steam, crashes during the Winter Fair Trivia, and crashes that occurred when playing with New Game+/Early Access save files. Additionally, it resolves various other issues to improve overall gameplay stability.

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed achievements not triggering in-game and on Steam, including Legendary Farmer, Healing the Ocean, Healing the World, Social Butterfly, Memento of the Past, Paleontologist, Bug Enjoyer, Fishing Mania, Marine Observer, and Part-Time Curator.
[*] Fixed player falling through the floor every time after passing out the previous day.
[*] Fixed game freezing when opening the recipe book.
[*] Fixed crash that occurred upon completing House Level 3 upgrades if a decor item was placed in front of the house stairs.
[*] Fixed crash when upgrading seeds in the Oracle Chamber.
[*] Fixed crash when playing Winter Fair Trivia until the day changed.
[*] Fixed crash when opening save file in some rare cases caused by invalid furniture.
[*] Fixed crash occurring after sleeping on Beach Festival day in certain cases.
[*] Fixed crash after using explosives in the Cave of Memories and jumping into the hole.
[*] Fixed crash that occurred when playing with New Game+/Early Access save file.
[*] Fixed crash when starting the main event at the Tree Planting Festival in Year 4.
[*] Fixed the issue where the Greenhouse disappeared after completing the Crop Altar offering.
[*] Fixed some scarecrows incorrectly marked as out of stock in Concerned Monkey, even if not yet purchased.
[*] Fixed player being unable to submit crops for the Harvest Festival using controllers.
[*] Fixed the "Q" button cannot be pressed on the virtual keyboard with a controller.
[*] Fixed various automation machines disappearing after redesigning farm buildings.
[*] Fixed the inability to remove the Dehydrator, which displayed a popup message: "Object is being used by another player."
[*] Fixed Auto Petter and Auto Collector stacking when the player moved the Underwater Ranch.
[*] Fixed missing Sea Otter on the Ocean Farm when reloading a save file.
[*] Fixed stiff animation for the Sea Otter in Ocean Farm.
[*] Fixed specific Town music issues for some save files.
[*] Fixed inability to remove Fish Net using a pickaxe in some Beach and Deep Forest areas.
[*] Fixed player visual portrait being cut off at the bottom when wearing top-only on White Flamingo.
[*] Fixed scavengable items spawning inside Concerned Monkey.
[*] Fixed issues triggering Lily Heart 7, Millie Heart 10, and Macy Heart 15 events.
[*] Fixed Lady Lavanna’s shop not discounting prices after a player won the Savannah Race.
[*] Fixed Mural attraction picture not showing after completion.
[*] Fixed recipe book showing the wrong missing ingredient when the ingredient items are excluded from the global inventory.
[*] Fixed Water Essence not being detected in the global inventory and unusable for cooking.
[*] Fixed inspect button prompt appearing on a table next to the Cherry Blossom Festival entrance.
[*] Fixed tourist boat stairs appearing during the Beach Clean Up Festival at the Pier.
[*] Fixed Trivia Night minigame causing the festival name to revert to the season name.
[*] Fixed oily roots animation appearing every time players teleport to the Lima Pulu (50m) area after becoming a Merfolk.
[*] Fixed crash after watering Mythical Seeds.
[*] Fixed crash when skipping the question cutscene in the Volunteer Hangout at the Museum.
[*] Fixed edge case where players got stuck when pressing other keys while clicking split selection.
[*] Fixed controller input when processing items at the Blacksmith and Ling's Lab.
[*] Fixed incorrect button icons for moving the camera using controllers in Architect Mode.
[*] Fixed the player pointer appearing in the gray area on the Savannah map.
[*] Fixed NPCs not wearing winter outfits during the New Year's Eve Festival.
[*] Fixed wedding prompts not triggering if the player sleep in the Barracks.
[*] Fixed a notification issue on the wedding day.
[*] Fixed rare case issue where players couldn’t build the Underwater Barn.
[*] Fixed a collision issue on the Beach and near Coral Inn.
[*] Fixed an incorrect texture on House Style 3.
[*] Fixed the UI displaying coins twice during the end-of-day recap.
[*] Fixed items not stacking properly inside chests.
[*] Fixed mining rocks generating outside cave bounds.
[*] Fixed Solar Panel removal behavior based on the processing state.
[*] Fixed monster health not reducing directly after players’ attacks.
[*] Fixed items duplicating after using the "To Backpack" button to transfer from Chest to Inventory.
[*] Fixed missing Merit Points from some Winter Fair minigames in the activity log.
[*] Fixed players being able to use Fishing Rods during Cherry Blossom Festivals.
[*] Fixed two identical NPCs appearing in the Animal Festival.
[*] Fixed spouse NPCs becoming invisible when kissing in front of doors.
[*] Fixed mining ambiance and the mining lobby intro cutscene SFX.
[*] Fixed speech bubbles sticking above player characters' heads when a cutscene was triggered before the bubble faded.
[*] Fixed Kenny talking about Town Rank E instead of the Winter Fair during the festival.
[*] Fixed untranslated Trivia minigame rewards in all languages.
[*] Fixed missing or incorrect NPCs in Winter Fair trivia.
[*] Fixed items in Winter Fair artifact trivia being covered with snow.
[*] Fixed Lindi moving up or down the stage in the Animal Festival.
[*] Fixed missing UI backgrounds on some menus.
[*] Fixed Cara Eggs disappearing when the Underwater Ranch was moved.
[*] Fixed the player being invisible on top of the horse when starting the Savannah Race minigame.
[*] Fixed player footstep SFX missing when wearing the Goddess outfit.
[/list]

[b]Text and Dialogue:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed various minor NPC dialogue issues.
[*] Fixed various localization issues.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted to allow wine to be placed in the Cherry Blossom Potluck.
[*] Added information about the Theo Heart 8 event being unavailable between Fall 15 and Fall 28.
[*] Reduced outside environment sounds that can be heard inside mine.
[*] Adjusted background screen and improved SFX for End of Day Recap.
[*] Improved SFX in certain cutscenes, various minigames, festivals, and skill triggers.
[*] Added new SFX for Town Rank.
[*] Disabled the "NPC is busy" text for certain activities.
[/list]

As always, thanks for the report and feedback! We really appreciate your help, Farmers!

Stairway Team

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1b-1233
notes.content:
[u][b]Hotfix v1.1b-1233[/b][/u]

Hi farmers,

This is a major hotfix we’re releasing before our team goes on holiday. The key updates include the addition of season-specific background music and background images for the end-of-day UI. We’ve also made further optimizations to enhance the game’s performance.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some book lists in Sections C and D always being marked as "New" even after reading.
[*] Fixed the player wearing underwater suits during cutscenes on land.
[*] Fixed missing SFX for the two-legged player tail when underwater.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could receive Goddess Blessing from the Enchantment site.
[*] Fixed player pointer going out of bounds on the map when entering the shed.
[*] Fixed player pointer still being visible when entering buildings or caverns.
[*] Fixed a visual bug when tilling clover.
[*] Fixed character getting stuck when starting fishing with certain behaviors.
[*] Hide NPC birthdays you haven’t met from the end-of-day UI.
[*] Fixed Lanin shopkeeper portrait being empty in seasons other than Spring; now uses her Spring portrait instead.
[*] Fixed clipping issues when trying to mount a horse.
[*] Fixed various map issues where the player was out of bounds in certain locations.
[*] Fixed the cursor going out of bounds in the Guardian Mural UI.
[*] Fixed broken animations when the player used axes and pickaxes underwater at max speed.
[*] Fixed player info not updating in-game after the end-of-day UI.
[*] Fixed UI issues in the Offering UI.
[*] Removed snow season effects when starting the Trivia Mini Game during Winter.
[*] Fixed missing furniture ramen mesh after upgrading.
[*] Fixed Winter Fair booth appearing in the Walter Heart Event 7 cutscene.
[*] Fixed being stuck in a riding pose after fainting while riding a horse.
[*] Fixed Wabanana sandals sometimes duplicating after being placed in the wardrobe.
[*] Fixed crashes when buying ranch animals in certain cases.
[*] Fixed bamboo nets not being able to catch medium fish.
[*] Fixed underwater building interior items not updating to new locations.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Pufferfish shop during the Beach Cleanup Festival couldn’t be interacted with.
[*] Fixed incorrect teleport locations for tilling and planting in Year 2 and Year 3 during tree planting festivals.
[*] Fixed the player’s teleport being blocked by objects in front of the farm portal; the player is now teleported to the front of the player’s home.
[*] Fixed Princess Miranjani missing from the map and no icon appearing when standing in front of the Sacred Tree.
[*] Fixed missing SFX when cutting mushrooms.
[*] Fixed Lady Lavanna’s shop not being discounted after winning the race.
[*] Fixed the player failing to dismount after exiting the Savannah race minigame.
[*] Fixed Town Rank board incorrectly displaying the rank.
[*] Fixed farmland becoming untilled or reverting to default after canceling a tree move action using the Architect Desk.
[*] Fixed tappers missing when moving trees with the Architect Desk.
[*] Fixed weird lighting when waking up in the underwater house.
[*] Fixed crafting wasabi paste incorrectly producing green smoothies.
[*] Fixed crashes when upgrading seeds/seaweed in the Oracle Chamber.
[*] Fixed the greenhouse disappearing after the player completes the Crop Altar Offering.
[*] Fixed being unable to remove items with a pickaxe because of the "Object is Being Used by Another Player" message.
[/list]

[b]Text and Dialogue:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed various minor NPC dialogue issues.
[*] Fixed various typos in cutscenes.
[*] Fixed various localization issues.
[*] Simplified the flow of the "One of Us" cutscenes.
[*] Updated Paul’s Relationship UI information.
[/list]  

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Disabled cursor hover over disabled inventory slots when using a controller.
[*] Optimized loading for various game areas.
[*] Removed unused keybind ("Open Inventory Decor") from the settings.
[/list]

[b]Balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated the minimum requirement for large log farms to a silver axe.
[/list]

Thanks for all your reports so far. We wish you a happy holiday season!
Stairway Team

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1b-1232
notes.content:
Hi Farmers,

This hotfix addresses game performance optimizations for the Steam Deck and resolves some edge-case crashes in the game.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed freezes during the Semeru wedding event on the Steam Deck. The previous fix missed some scenarios.
[*] Fixed freezes during the unwanted guest cutscene on the Steam Deck.
[*] Fixed an issue where the UI would disappear after interacting with the rename panel.
[*] Fixed a bug that made floating resources unpickable in certain cases.
[*] Fixed the ability to open the pause menu while fishing, this shouldn't be possible.
[*] Fixed missing fishing animations during fishing.
[*] Fixed a crash when moving the underwater barn to a location occupied by a chest or a machine with active temperature.
[*] Fixed a crash when moving the underwater barn building.
[*] Fixed a crash when sleeping or saving after upgrading the barn to level 2.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced freezes occurring at 12:00, 16:00, and 18:00 in-game when playing on the Steam Deck.
[*] IOstore has been disabled, allowing the game to be modded again. Due to this change, the hotfix is larger in size than usual, as you will need to redownload some files. This won't increase the game's size on your computer.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and happy farming!

Best regards,  
Stairway Team

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1b-1231
notes.content:
[u][b]Steam Hotfix v1.1b-1231[/b][/u]

Hi Farmers,

This hotfix focuses on optimizing game performance and addressing some edge-case crashes in the game.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash that occurred when collecting overlapping eggs in the chicken coop.
[*] Fixed a crash caused by a meteor or satellite hitting a fruit tree.
[*] Resolved an issue in controller-only mode where the cursor became stuck after pressing "back" in the Lake Temple offering menu.
[*] Fixed a cursor freeze in controller-only mode when exiting the dating list in the Hangout Menu.
[*] Addressed a bug where no upgrade information appeared at the blacksmith after completing an upgrade.
[*] Resolved a critical issue where merit points from tree planting were incorrectly applied daily after completing the Tree Planting Festival.
[*] Fixed a crash that occurred after completing the dinosaur hologram cutscene.
[*] Fixed a crash that occurred after participating in Apple Bobbing during the Harvest Festival.
[*] Fixed a crash that happened in certain cases when playing the match-pattern mini-game at Winter Fair. 
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed the "busy" text from certain NPCs during activity animations.
[*] Optimized performance by improving asset loading logic in the Ramen Shop.
[*] Drastically reduced hitching issues on the Steam Deck by implementing more efficient memory garbage collection.
[/list]

[b]Localization:[/b]
[list]
[*] Resolved various translation issues.
[/list]

We hope this update enhances your gameplay experience, especially for those playing on the Steam Deck. 

Best regards,  
Stairway Team

More hotfixes to address some high-priority issues from our last update:

notes.title: Coral Island "Quality of Life" update Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38098234/2a91ae629570cc9817796d5e0d78b0c5c7ebf81c.png[/img]

Hello Islanders!

Coral Island "Quality of Life" 1.1b update is finally released!

Here are all the new changes for our 1.1b Quality of Life update:

[b]New Cooking Show:[/b]
We’ve added a new cooking show hosted by Chef Sisca, airing every Friday on your in-game TV.
By watching, you’ll learn and unlock new cooking recipes, which can then be prepared in your kitchen at home.

[b]Goddess Daily Blessing:[/b]
Introducing the [b]Goddess Daily Blessing[/b], a feature that grants players one daily buff.
Buffs can improve your chances of catching insects, fish, or scavenging rare items, among other benefits.
To unlock this feature, complete four offerings. Once unlocked, visit the nearest fast travel point to access the [b]Goddess Blessing[/b] option (the second choice). This feature resets daily, so remember to visit the fast travel point each day to receive your blessing!

[b]Mystery Rocks:[/b]
[b]Mystery Rocks[/b] are a new type of debris found in the Starlet Mines and the Cave of Memories.
Breaking these rocks may yield ores, ore veins, seeds, rare fish, rare insects, or occasionally unleash monsters!
The number of Mystery Rocks that spawn per floor depends on the number of offerings made to the Goddess. For every two offerings, more Mystery Rocks will appear.

[b]Fish Nets:[/b]
We’ve added [b]Bamboo Nets[/b], a new item for passively catching fish.
[list]
[*] Unlock the Small Bamboo Net at Fishing Level 3 and the Large Bamboo Net at Fishing Level 7.
[*] To use, place the net at the edge of a water body. It will automatically catch fish daily.
[*] Small Bamboo Nets hold 1 fish, while Large Bamboo Nets hold up to 3 of the same type.
[*] Add bait to increase your chances of catching fish! Unused bait will remain intact if no fish are caught.
Note: Bamboo Nets cannot catch legendary fish.
[/list]

[b]Additional General Store Quests:[/b]
Help Sam revive the empty sections of the general store by completing various requests.
Start by triggering the [b]Local Produce[/b] quest. Sam will provide more details at the store. Once completed, Sam will continue requesting your assistance to stock his store with goods, improving life for the townsfolk.

[b]Hangout Hours for Attractions:[/b]
We’ve adjusted the available times for certain attractions:
[list]
[*] Observatory: Open only at night.
[*] Hot Air Balloon: Open only during the day.
[*] Afternoon Tea: Available from 12 PM to 5 PM.
[/list]

[b]UI Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated Decor Mode UI to improve switching between inventory and non-inventory modes.
[*] Added an Inventory Full message when buying decor in furniture shops with a full inventory.
[*] Added permanent interactable objects in the Lake Temple to show progress and rewards.
[*] Added one-time notifications when new areas unlock at the start of a new day.
[*] Added VFX and SFX for giving NPCs items they love.
[*] Improved the crafting menu order to display items from the same category together.
[*] Added VFX for interactables at Cave of Memories checkpoints.
[*] Added icons to indicate if a new heart event cutscene is available.
[*] Updated the NPC Relationship Menu with heart event locations and hangout locations.
[*] Added Heart Event tracking information to the Player’s HUD.
[*] Added income tracking to the day-end UI.
[*] Updated the day-end UI to show heart progress and allow day changes.
[/list]

[b]Dialogue Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new dynamic dialogue for Aaliyah about her trip to space.
[*] Introduced a cooldown for all dialogues (except marriage dialogue) of 2 in-game hours.
[*] Added emotes for spouses after kissing or hugging.
[*] Added dynamic dialogue for when your spouse randomly gives a dish to the player.
[*] Added dynamic dialogue for the day after a meteor or satellite has fallen.
[*] Added dynamic dialogue where your spouse mentions the wedding anniversary every year on the day of marriage.
[*] Added dynamic dialogue for when Eva gives the player cookies at random.
[/list]

[b]Lowered Requirements for Town Rank A:[/b]
We’ve reduced the requirements for reaching [b]Town Rank A[/b] to make it more accessible:
[list]
[*] Town Rank B requirements reduced by 6%.
[*] Town Rank A requirements reduced by 10%.
[/list]
These adjustments will help players achieve higher ranks faster and enjoy community projects sooner.

[b]Balancing Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players now unlock the ocean farm sooner. Three days after completing the Roots Above quest, you’ll receive a letter from King Krakatoa, summoning you to Naga Castle.
[*] Using the Milk Pail, Shears, and Petting Animals now costs 3 stamina.
[*] Hangouts are now available at Heart Level 2 (previously Heart Level 3).
[*] Removed stamina cost for tools used without hitting a target.
[/list]

[b]Additional Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved save stability to prepare for Multiplayer.
[*] Added the ability to retrieve tools from the player’s bed.
[*] Added a new cutscene after completing the Spooky Festival Treasure Hunt mini-game.
[/list]

Thank you,
Stairway Games

notes.title: November 2024 Dev Update!
notes.content:
Welcome to the November 2024 Coral Island development update!

This month, we'll showcase all the changes and additions to the [b]"Quality of Life" 1.1b content update[/b]! We also have news about private and open Multiplayer testing. 

[b]The Coral Island "Quality of Life" 1.1b update releases tomorrow @ 7AM WITA/3PM PST![/b]

Tomorrow's update is for Steam only. The console version release will follow once the Steam version is stable.

[b]Join our [url=http://discord.gg/stairway]Discord[/url] for more information![/b]


[u][h2][b]New NPC Reactions[/b][/h2][/u]
When giving a loved item as a gift:
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_2f123052dfbf4f38bacd45b071bb9496~mv2.gif[/img]

When hugging or kissing your spouse:
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_15e18c5793f444678560038d61233d5e~mv2.gif[/img]

[u][h2][b]Triggerable Woohoo event[/b][/h2][/u]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_93c2fc03cab54b34add4b9c2c2b27571~mv2.gif[/img]

[u][h2][b]Heart Event Notification[/b][/h2][/u]
Icons now appear on an NPC in the relationship UI when a heart event is available:
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_63feee32338d4bfe93fadfe01c25de86~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_833,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_63feee32338d4bfe93fadfe01c25de86~mv2.png[/img]

Click on an NPC to view details about how to trigger the heart event:
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_62c72d31c23e465d97169d16c3872a6c~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_833,h_636,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_62c72d31c23e465d97169d16c3872a6c~mv2.png[/img]

Track heart events that will appear in the main gameplay HUD:
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_e3c47dfb2eee44dfa15545c98caf795c~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_833,h_636,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_e3c47dfb2eee44dfa15545c98caf795c~mv2.png[/img]


[u][h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2][/u]
[b]Goddess Daily Blessing:[/b]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3595ae9103a34dcbba201ef229f9c0cc~mv2.gif[/img]

We’ve added a new feature called the Goddess’s Daily Blessing. Players can receive one buff per day from the Goddess, which may increase your odds of catching insects, fish, or scavenged items, among other benefits. To unlock this feature, you need to complete four offerings. 

Once unlocked, go to the nearest fast travel point, and the Goddess Blessing option will appear as the second choice. Blessings reset daily, so make sure to visit the closest fast travel point each day to receive your blessing!


[b]Fish Nets:[/b]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_8f118234747949a7a41e0f174d5d17d3~mv2.gif[/img]

Like the Insect Trap, we’ve added a new item called the Bamboo Net for passive fishing. To unlock this item, you need to reach Mastery Fishing Level 3 to unlock the Bamboo Net (Small) and Level 7 for the Bamboo Net (Large).

To use it, simply place the net at the edge of a body of water. Each day, it [b]may[/b] automatically catch fish. The Bamboo Net (Small) has a maximum capacity of 1 fish, while the Bamboo Net (Large) can hold up to 3 of the same type of fish.

You can also add Fish Bait to the Bamboo Net to increase the chances of catching specific fish. If no fish are caught, the bait remains intact and will not be used.

[b]Mystery Rocks:[/b]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_8dc084de87af4b94a5b8deffcb2f910a~mv2.gif[/img]

Mystery Rocks are new debris that spawn in the Starlet Mines and the Cave of Memories. When destroyed, they may drop ores, ore veins, seeds, rare fish, rare insects, or even unleash monsters!

The number of Mystery Rocks on each floor depends on the number of offerings made to the Goddess. For every two offerings, the number of Mystery Rocks that can spawn increases.


[b]New cooking channel to unlock recipes:[/b]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3fcf43ed6d024723b55abd20ff252141~mv2.gif[/img]

We’ve added a new cooking show by Chef Sisca, airing every Friday on your TV. Watching the show allows you to learn and unlock new cooking recipes, which can then be prepared in your kitchen at home.

[u][h2][b]Balancing improvements[/b][/h2][/u]

[b]Town Rank:[/b]

We’ve reduced the requirements for reaching Town Rank A to make it more accessible.

[list]
[*] Town Rank B requirements reduced by 6%.
[*] Town Rank A requirements reduced by 10%.
[/list]

These adjustments will help players achieve higher ranks faster and enjoy community projects sooner.


[b]Others:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players now unlock the ocean farm sooner. Three days after completing the Roots Above quest, you’ll receive a letter from King Krakatoa, summoning you to Naga Castle.
[*] Using the Milk Pail, Shears, and Petting Animals now costs 3 stamina (previously 0 stamina)
[*] Hangouts are now available at Heart Level 2 (previously Heart Level 3).
[*] Removed stamina cost for tools used without hitting a target.
[*] Additional General Store Quests (help Sam revive the General Store)
[/list]


[u][h2][b]Various UX Improvements[/b][/h2][/u]

[b]Improved day-end recap:[/b]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_aac660cf67e745bf9aa7383f712c00d1~mv2.gif[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_e60fb39bbddf416da9108bc87b863d71~mv2.gif[/img]

[b]Temple offering tracker:[/b]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_b918d2d7d57f418e8c5446ffecc2983d~mv2.gif[/img]

[b]New area unlocked notification:[/b]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_06e64987835a4bfda0af38134b2d4eec~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_833,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_06e64987835a4bfda0af38134b2d4eec~mv2.png[/img]

[b]Retrieve tools from bed:[/b]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_7164f362f84842f08bba5a63506888bb~mv2.gif[/img]

[b]Improved Decor UI switching inventory/non-inventory mode:[/b]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3d18775784a0496db6884e2a2228de12~mv2.gif[/img]

[b]Notification that inventory is full when buying decor:[/b]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_cf0a9865c70d46d9b93533ae10fbc100~mv2.gif[/img]


[u][h2][b]Multiplayer Testing[/b][/h2][/u]

Multiplayer is feature complete. We need your help with feedback and, most importantly, break things so we can fix them!

[b][u]Closed Testing[/u][/b]
[u]When:[/u] Dec 2, 2024 to Dec 8, 2024
[u]Who:[/u] 100 to 150 people

[u]Access:[/u] Selection is random, signup details on Discord


[u][b]Open Testing[/b][/u]

[u]When:[/u] Dec 16, 2024 to Jan 5, 2025

[u]Access:[/u] Enter a code to gain access to the Multiplayer branch. The code will be made available closer to the testing date. Details to follow on Discord

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1-1220
notes.content:
Hi Farmers,

We have fixed more bugs and added some improvements in this patch:

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed underwater house floor and wallpaper issues.
[*] Fixed issues with savannah mine monsters and treasure levels.
[*] Fixed various clipping issues with NPC clothing.
[*] Fixed tapper disappearing when canceling tree movement in architect mode.
[*] Fixed item duplication/disappearance in global storage.
[*] Fixed response when proposing to an NPC when the player is already married.
[*] Fixed ranch animals rotating incorrectly when going inside.
[*] Fixed multiple mastery level-ups not displaying correctly in Day Recap.
[*] Fixed wrong mesh shown on Snatcher for Fire, Ice, and Wind Mines.
[*] Fixed treasure hunt daily loot not resetting.
[*] Fixed some underwater items showing wrong placement displays in inventory.
[*] Fixed issue with harvesting tap from mushroom trees.
[*] Fixed clipping and preview issues in the Clothing Shop.
[*] Fixed weird animation for kissing and hugging from long distances.
[*] Fixed flickering issue on sprinklers.
[*] Fixed UI not showing certain quality ocean crops/animal produce required for upgrading the lab.
[*] Fixed some issues with auto chests not processing items.
[*] Fixed upgrade tool held upside down when retrieved.
[*] Fixed random crash when rummaging in trash cans.
[*] Fixed floating rock issue in the mines.
[*] Fixed no tile highlight on Water Mines Floor 27, 28.
[*] Fixed cases where the bottom is naked when loading a save with a specific outfit.
[*] Prevented freeze issue caused by moving auto chests in architect and decor mode.
[*] Fixed auto collectors not working on the underwater barn building.
[*] Fixed Charles walking on the spot and spinning in front of Ling's Lab.
[*] Fixed fruit tree errand's deadline being 6 days instead of 7.
[*] Fixed missing horse during the savannah race.
[*] Fixed scrap tiles becoming invisible on the underwater farm.
[*] Fixed missing Lady Lavanna in the journal UI.
[*] Fixed interaction prompt to show when the player interacts with pets and horses on floor tiles using the mouse.
[*] Fixed Jim heart 5 quest not handled properly.
[*] Fixed wrong requirement for dynamic dialog for a healthy sacred tree.
[*] Fixed failed teleport for some aftermath hangouts.
[*] Fixed NPCs thinking they are married when they aren't.
[*] Fixed fossil spawn in Diving 50m.
[*] Fixed Charcuz low-rise pants and shoulder belt top issues.
[*] Fixed scarce water geode drop in Starlet Mine.
[*] Fixed savannah cave memory fragment interact prompt requirement.
[*] Fixed seeds dropped from the savannah cave not stacking.
[*] Fixed Garden Lane listed incorrectly when opening the map.
[*] Fixed some cases of artisan item machines getting stuck.
[*] Fixed some cooking recipes not increasing the cooked count.
[*] Fixed Osmium meteor's wrong setup for reminder text.
[*] Fixed horse being called inside the community center using an animal whistle.
[*] Fixed Semeru's dialogue glitch during Merfolk Chaperone/Starlet Expedition.
[*] Fixed being unable to fish in savannah.
[*] Fixed beach shack location area triggers elsewhere.
[*] Fixed well's string stretching after being moved by the architect desk.
[*] Fixed Spin the Wheel minigame exploit (spin attempts reset if the player quits before using all attempts).
[*] Fixed crash on cutscene reapplying weather.
[*] Fixed crash in savannah race minigame.
[*] Attempted to fix the inability to toggle the fireplace using a controller.
[*] Fixed underwater ranch animals getting stuck at gate buildings.
[*] Fixed being unable to place offerings on the orchestra altar 50m with different quality.
[*] Fixed portrait glitching during cutscenes.
[*] Fixed Miranjani portrait using the fall portrait in spring.
[*] Fixed floor preview carrying over to other rooms.
[*] Fixed carpets and rugs becoming white in floor previews.
[*] Attempted to fix a crash when opening UI containing inventory slots in an edge case.
[*] Fixed Island Guardians being able to talk in the early game.
[*] Fixed save settings not updating for duration and cooldown dynamic dialog when loading a game save.
[*] Fix gem offering resetting to 0.
[*] Fix Velociraptor hologram completion missing 10 points blocking completion to town rank S even after completing everything.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted tumbleweed scale, speed, and locations.
[*] Added a rare chance of spawning butterflies when hitting a tree.
[*] Faster zoom steps in architect mode.
[*] Implemented rotate functionality for rotatable objects in architect mode.
[*] Disabled item weapons during underwater diving.
[*] Added VFX for giant crops in the Cave of Memories.
[*] Allowed 3 NPC birthdays.
[*] Added information to add a temperature machine for underwater buildings to avoid animals being put in a bad mood in Winter.
[*] Polished temperature machine for underwater, only showing a red light.
[*] Readjusted ramen shop attraction camera preview.
[*] Added translucency for the pufferfish building.
[*] Enabled grass spawn and growth on floor tiles with grass type.
[*] Resized all coconut and geode by 1.5x.
[*] Disabled the ability to repeatedly pet ranch animals.
[*] Adjusted purple flower texture.
[*] Added cooldown for all meteors.
[/list]

[b]UI:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated Item Mixing layout for better navigation with the controller.
[*] Updated Animal Shop requirement pop-up text for better understanding.
[*] Updated Tablet of Memories Relationship Panel to ensure the layout is correct and the NPC icon is not stretched.
[*] Updated Calendar to allow for 3 NPC birthdays.
[*] Added married requirements for New Year Spouse dialogue.
[*] Fixed various UI typos.
[/list]

[b]Balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed Mastery Point acquisition for Catching and Fishing from trash cans.
[*] Revised daily loot table content.
[*] Unlocked monster scarecrow recipe (concerned monkey shop).
[*] Adjusted prices for underwater sprinkler + attachment weather conch and wellness fruit.
[*] Adjusted prices for buff ocean flower honey and mead.
[/list]

[b]Dialogue and Text:[/b]
[list]
[*] Various translation improvements.
[*] Denali and Princess Miranjani dialogue text fixes.
[*] Added Deno extras description.
[*] Removed dot in Ask texts.
[*] Removed Day After Wedding dialogue for Aaliya, Alice, Ben, and Chaem.
[/list]

Best regards, 

Stairway Team

notes.title: Coral Island 1.1 Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/03d1d46e88f4e61e2212ec68ef6ae9c86eae5305.jpg[/img]

Hello Islanders!

Coral Island 1.1 is finally released!

Here are all the new changes for our 1.1 Finale: Land and Sea update:

[b]Hangout System:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now ask your favorite dateable NPC to hangout with them at a place you choose to get some relationship points.
[*] More Hangout locations become available as you progress through the game.
[*] Similar to gifting, Hangouts are limited to twice a week. Hangouts become available starting Heart 3.
[/list]

[b]Attractions:[/b]
[list]
[*] An entirely new town rank category is added sometime after you reach Town Rank A.
[*] You can access the attractions menu inside the Community Center Town Hall room.
[*] The attractions will benefit townies and attract visitors.
[*] Recycling centers can now be upgraded to Treasure Trove Recycler, allowing you to donate trash for rewards. 
[/list]

[b]Recreation Center:[/b]
[list]
[*] Recreation center is one of the attractions you can build.
[*] This building adds a lot of new things for the townies to do. As such, some of their schedules will change once this building (and all the rooms inside it) are built.
[*] Townies will start hanging out in the Recreation Center. 
[/list]

[b]Storyline Completion & New Quests:[/b]
[list]
[*] Town Rank S 
[*] Attraction Rank S
[*] Heritage Rank S
[*] Museum Rank S (Holographic Dino)
[*] Song of the Sea (Ocean Rank S)
[*] Rebuild Merfolk Kingdom
[*] Starlet Expedition
[*] Giants Storyline completion (Savannah)
[/list]

[b]Tourist System:[/b]
[list]
[*] As the town rank grows, more tourists will start visiting Coral Island once per week. 
[*] That includes our tourist Backer NPC. 
[*] Each tourist Backer NPC will have their unique seasonal outfits.
[*] You can chat with the tourist Backer NPC.
[*] The tourists arrive via tourist boat. 
[*] Tourist boat changes based on the current in-game Town Rank.
[/list]

[b]Cutscenes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Heart cutscenes for all townies. 
[/list]

[b]Savannah Area:[/b]
[list]
[*] Savannah Cave (Cave of Memories).
[*] Ability to buy two more animals in the savannah: Ostrich and buffalo
[*] New scavangeable.
[*] Treasure Bubbles give various reward items. 
[*] One new mini-game in Savannah.
[/list]

[b]Flower Teleport:[/b]
[list]
[*] New magical teleport to fast travel to new locations around the map. 
[*] You can fast travel to Savannah using this. 
[/list]

[b]New Decor and Clothing:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Indoor Decor: 142
[*] New Outdoor Decor: 122
[*] New Clothing: 62
[/list]

[b]Spouse Interactions:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now hug and kiss your spouse once daily to get some point in the relationship. 
[*] Your spouse's relatives will send wedding gifts via mail once you get married. 
[/list]

[b]Library Books:[/b]
[list]
[*] The library now slowly gets populated as you increase town ranks.
[*] Reading some books offers perks like mastery points and recipe unlock. 
[/list]

[b]Merfolk NPC Marriage:[/b]
[list]
[*] Merfolk Heart Events. 
[*] Merfolk Wedding cutscenes. 
[*] New dialogues after marriage for your spouse.
[/list]

[b]Underwater Outdoor Decor:[/b]
[list]
[*] New outdoor underwater decor.
[/list]

[b]New Merfolk NPC:[/b]
[list]
[*] Rysy
[*] Jannu
[*] Slamet
[*] Tahat
[*] Goolong
[*] Lawu
[*] Lanin
[*] Vihren
[*] Todi
[*] Etna
[/list]

[b]New dialogues:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Merfolk NPC Dialogues
[*] New Dynamic Dialogues
[*] Merfolk NPC Gift Dialogues
[/list]

[b]Underwater Farming:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can farm underwater.
[*] 15 different seeds. 
[*] You can mix your land seeds with sea creatures to produce ocean underwater seeds. 
[/list]

[b]Underwater Ranch:[/b]
You can ranch the following animals: 
[list]
[*] Shellcluck producing Pearls.
[*] InkHog producing Deepvoid Ink.
[*] Carapoultry producing Cara Egg.
[*] Seashroud producing Seashroud Algae.
[*] Mermoo producing Mermoo Milk. 
[/list]

[b]Underwater Stores:[/b]
[list]
[*] Underwater General Store
[*] Underwater Ranch Store
[*] Underwater Clothing Store
[*] Underwater Furniture Store
[/list]

[b]New Errands:[/b]
[list]
[*] Special Errands.
[*] Underwater Errand.
[/list]

[b]Shed Skins:[/b]
[list]
[*] Items that allow you to change the look of your Shed can be obtained from Treasure Trove Recycler.
[*] To change the Shed's look, you must go through the Carpenters. Dinda and Joko will make the change for you free of charge.
[/list]

[b]Ranch Animal Dino Skins:[/b]
[list]
[*] Completing specific collections rewards you with items to change your farm animals into Dinos. 
[*] It also works with underwater farm animals.
[*] The dino skin is removable. 
[*] You can buy more dino skins in Concerned Monkey shops once unlocked.
[/list]

[b]Bark Dialogue (speech bubble text):[/b]
[list]
[*] All spouses now feature bark dialogue. What they say depends on the spawn condition (time/location/etc). For example, a spouse will say "Good morning" to you (in the morning) or "Welcome back home" (in the evening).
[*] Most townies also have bark dialogue. What they say also depends on the spawn condition (time/location/etc.).
[/list]

[b]Additional features:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can rename your player name, farm, and pet in the town hall. The rename will be applied the next day.
[*] Your farm can now support up to 3 adopted pets + 1 mythical pet.
[/list]

[h2][b]Thai Localization now available![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/7a5487d86b483bafb96c4cd4144fdd331bbf2b05.png[/img]
Coral Island is now available for Thai!

[h2][b]Coral Island 20% Off[/b][/h2]
We're happy to be part of Simfest, and we're celebrating the 1.1 “Story Finale: Land & Sea” release with a 20% off for Coral Island, only until July 29, 2024!
Great opportunity to start a new life as a Farmer in Coral Island!
Already own it? Get it for your family, friends, and loved one

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158160/Coral_Island/


Thank you,
Stairway Games

notes.title: June 2024 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the June 2024 Coral Island development update!
Brought to you by [b]Millie-meters <3[/b]

This month, you'll get a brief look at Multiplayer and the remaining details of what's to come in the 1.1 update! PLEASE NOTE: there are [b]mid to late-game spoilers[/b] ahead.

[b]The Coral Island "Story Finale: Land & Sea" 1.1 update is in progress, and we will release it as soon as possible. Stay tuned for updates![/b]

[b]Join our [url=http://discord.gg/stairway]Discord[/url] for more information![/b]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_97014c62528b460e9babbbeb6e540294~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_592,h_146,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_97014c62528b460e9babbbeb6e540294~mv2.png[/img]


[u][h2][b]Some Of The New Merfolk Townies![/b][/h2][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/508aae0733fea8e86797a63f4bbfe7cddbd78171.png[/img]
[Galoong, Etna, Todi and Lanin]


Hey there, beautiful, talented, brilliant farmers! Buckle up because the 1.1 update is bursting with amazing new features and the most adorable NPCs ever. And guess what? There are even more new merfolk waiting to be discovered. Meet some of the New Merfolk:

[b]Galoong[/b]: This guy is the sculptor of the deep! With an incredible talent for turning sand into masterpieces, he spends his days lost in creativity and deep conversation with his BFF, [b]Lanin[/b]. His longtime partner [b]Vihren[/b] also sculpts, but it’s Galoong who runs the shop. His art is all about celebrating the sea and protecting its beauty. Aah!!! What a hero!

[b]Etna[/b]: Deemed the most beautiful sea creature in the entire universe by her adoring husband, [b]Tahat[/b] (so sweet!!!). She spends her day tending to her garden, and that charming, sweet smile? She’s passed it on to her daughter, [b]Denali[/b]. Talk about a winning genetic lottery!

[b]Todi[/b]: The friendly general shop owner with a knack for finding great deals on rare items. He’s always got the latest in stock, from fresh petalia seeds to unique sea spices. Todi runs the shop with his amazing wife, [b]Lawu[/b], who’s a wizard in the kitchen. When he's not minding the store, Todi loves exploring the coral forests and dreaming about life above the waves. He even has a land-dwellers watch—sure, it may not work, but hey, it looks awesome!

[b]Lanin[/b]: The chatty and vibrant clothing vendor of the sea! She's always ready to brighten your day with her dazzling smile and perfectly curated outfits. Lanin’s shop is close to Galoong's decor store, making them best friends in both business and life. She's full of curiosity about life on land, often marveling at human habits and inventions. Whether you're looking for the latest fashion or just a friendly conversation, Lanin’s the mermaid to visit!

[u][h2][b]Dino Suits for Ranch Animals[/b][/h2][/u]
This is BIG, folks! In the 1.1 update, you can transform your ranch animals into dinosaurs. The dino costumes automatically adjust the size based on the animal you dress up, ensuring a perfect fit every time! Unlock the dino suit by completing the [b]dino hologram[/b] in the museum. Each completed hologram unlocks a specific dino costume for your animals. How cool is that?

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_7ef3e91a6a544de1bd81b515d4016b98~mv2.gif[/img]
[Oh my gosh! Two-legged dino suits for your two-legged ranch animals like ostriches. Can you say adorable?!]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ab69eb8f2ce549fabc690a63aeef6c2c~mv2.gif[/img]
[Four-legged dino suits for your four-legged ranch animals like cows. Moo-ve over, ordinary cows! ;) ]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3a0d200303d94665b8cb7aae69d6d955~mv2.gif[/img]
[Look at those tiny Triceratops! They’re so cuteee! My tiny dino-pal.]


[u][h2][b]Gacha Prizes![/b][/h2][/u]
Introducing the Gacha feature! There are two Gacha machines to explore: one at the [b]recycling center[/b] and another in [b]Savannah[/b]. Keep cleaning up trash to earn rewards and fuel these exciting machines.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d7397e6ad54946abbcc349ee5aca7efe~mv2.gif[/img]
[Daily Rewards: Open daily to see what fabulous loot awaits you. It's like a gift every day!]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3c45fa7f864f4bf18d8024a9ba0646cf~mv2.gif[/img]
[Unique Inputs: Different Gacha machines require different materials to operate. Turning trash into treasure is what we do best, you clever recycler!]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_2c738211347642bd8176c90d929dd7f5~mv2.gif[/img]
[One man's trash is another man's treasure. Let’s keep the island sparkling clean, eco-warrior!]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/82989f38df6a89123726d1077a95881227b228a6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/a2916a08c2cc2c4f2776f74238756228f3fbbdd5.png[/img]
[Cool things await you, farmer!]


[u][h2][b]Shed Skin & New Interiors[/b][/h2][/u]
One of the exclusive rewards from the recycling center is the Shed Skin! It's too much work for one person, so I’d recommend asking Dinda the [b]carpenter[/b] (Archie's Mom) to help apply the Shed Skin for a fresh new look. I chatted with Dinda, and she’s more than happy to help you out for [b]free[/b]. You’re welcome!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_534ec09051544b23a208c35d7c1e4b04~mv2.gif[/img]
[Acquired in the Recycling Center Gacha!]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_bf3e0fd0464245bb92cae62bf5d08314~mv2.gif[/img]
[Acquired in the Savannah Gacha!]

Straight from the Savannah, feast your eyes on the cutest mushroom decor ever! The bookshelf, in particular, is simply too cute for words! You’ll want to decorate every inch of your home with these delightful pieces. It’s like having a little piece of magic right in your living room!


[u][h2][b]Savannah Race[/b][/h2][/u]
The Savannah isn’t just about introducing new animals for Coral Island farmers to care for. Oh no, it also presents a thrilling opportunity to challenge the Lady of the area herself. Mirror, mirror on the wall, who’s the fastest of them all? Time to find out and show everyone what you’ve got!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_93bd983a92434276962afad7e09a751d~mv2.gif[/img]
[Prepare to compete against Lady Lavanna in her own game and discover the rewards that await the victor.]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_e6b888e311f94b61b7a2b213b908d8cc~mv2.gif[/img]
[SPEEEEEEED!!!]


[u][h2][b]Other Updates[/b][/h2][/u]
[h3][u]Island Guardian Outfits[/u][/h3]
The 1.1 update is bringing you fabulous new exclusive outfits. Unlock the island guardian ensembles (5 in total!), including the stunning Lady Lavanna's outfit, as shown below. Simply divine! You’ll be the talk of the town, my stylish, fabulous friend!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_89df227d8be5434b88883aa0bfd87a9a~mv2.gif[/img]
[Unlock Lady Lavanna's outfit after completing her offering.]


[h3][u]Cellar[/u][/h3]

Remember that mysterious locked door next to your house? Well, it’s now open. How cool is that?!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_fbe36f7beb224761ac9b772ab1fc5cab~mv2.gif[/img]
[Aging barrels age faster inside the cellar! Fix up the bottom half to gain even more access. More space, more efficiency, my little organization wizard!]


[h3][u]Wellness Fruit[/u][/h3]

Discover the amazing wellness fruit, which permanently increases your HP. But where is it located? Ah, that’s a delightful mystery waiting to be solved.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_8ca14aa589914abab270026358e7cba0~mv2.gif[/img]
[Meet the [b]pink<3[/b] stamina fruit’s sibling. Permanently increases your HP on consumption.]


[h3][u]Lumina Sprinkler[/u][/h3]

Get ready to sparkle up your underwater garden with the new Lumina Sprinkler! It’s sparkly and oh-so-pretty.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_fbb5c33995484a208fc2bc3e74fb53b5~mv2.gif[/img]
[Applies light to your underwater crops. The underwater version of the sprinkler. Shine on!]


[u][h2][b]Multiplayer Brief Look[/b][/h2][/u]
Now, let’s talk about another major update for the future—multiplayer! While diligently working on the 1.1 update, we’ve also been crafting and refining the multiplayer experience. Trolling and developing aside, here are some delightful GIFs for your enjoyment. Get ready to game with friends and have the time of your life! :)

[h3][u]Playing In Multiplayer[/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/e1fa477ec4b8c49a0cdee6b4dea7d9bb6710a582.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/f0d39631a171242135886f24ecf64c4bbb2d70d2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/976fcba199d1da232b023e3b7c6fb3a4f34a6ad8.png[/img]
[Host a new MP game or join an existing one using the new co-op menu button.]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_67bd5be91e41497490d6b2dcb8efda7a~mv2.gif[/img]
[Adjust various multiplayer specific settings game settings.]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_5ec12498e4424f078da41e870267a743~mv2.gif[/img]
[Keep tabs on Multiplayer Members at any time!]


[h3][u]Entering The Game[/u][/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_69b3a719388e434b999251addbd84e91~mv2.gif[/img]
[In the "shared" housing layout, each player has a different room in the main house.]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_28659c196de34f1cb5b4ac66766189eb~mv2.gif[/img]
[Talk, plan, and strategize via in-game chat!]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_57db9db65e67453aa280ca1d72955017~mv2.gif[/img]
[Keep tabs on where everyone is located via the map UI.]


[u][h2][b]Prepare For Chaos[/b][/h2][/u]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_88948b108a52481f814ed8d1de074886~mv2.gif[/img]
[Much trolling has occurred during MP development.]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_83871cfb323040bb9197fbfeec24b112~mv2.gif[/img]
[Does your relationship withstand the explosion test?]


[u][h2][b]What's Next[/b][/h2][/u]
In August, we’ll do a deep dive into Multiplayer and share news about a closed invite-only Alpha test for Multiplayer. Start gathering your friends because adventure awaits!

Coral Island Discord: [url=http://discord.gg/stairway]take me there![/url]

Until next time, may your 1.1 adventures be as boundless as the ocean itself.

[b]Thanks for reading,[/b]
Stairway Team

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0-948
notes.content:
Hi Farmers,

We readjust some achievements to make it easier to understand. 
More bugfixes and improvements for this release: 

[b]Achievements adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] Coral Island’s Sweetheart: Reach heart 8 with all townies. Previously Reach heart 8 with all NPC. The change will made clear that you do not need to increase heart with Merfolk NPC to achieve this. 
[*] Multi-level Gifting: Give a gift to all townies. Previously Give a gift to all NPC. This will make clear you do not need to give a gift to Merfolk NPC to achieve this. 
[*] Legendary Farmer: Ship all items in the Produce Caught and Found categories in the Journal. Previously Ship all items in game. The change are made to make clear what needs to be shipped instead of just generic all.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix super coral museum assets disappearing in museum cutscene.
[*] Fix bug where cancel errand confirmation still allowing you to navigate the UI instead of having confirm or cancel. 
[*] Fix oil press mesh issue. 
[*] Fix collision issues. 
[*] Fix one of DIY crafting cannot be completed. 
[*] Fix legendary farmer achievements cannot be completed. 
[*] Fix issue with hair mesh. 
[*] Fix ambiance sound missing after load game from pause menu.
[*] Fixes NPC collisions issue (so they don't stand on top of the value)
[*] Fixed touch garden causing crash if moved with architect desk. 
[*] Fix possible crash when save list is corrupted. 
[*] Fix underwear tops still seen over other clothes. 
[*] Fix soybean growth length text. 
[*] Fix typos on some NPC Dialogues. 
[*] Fix bamboo sanctuary doesn't show cutscene.
[*] Fix Master Slime didn't show portrait.
[*] Fix spooky lamp not working properly. 
[*] Remove POI in Nursery room.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Update more text for museum POI
[*] Various UI improvements. 
[*] Add sandals to Balinese Kebaya and Safari Outfit
[*] Change Macy's sofa from single to double size.
[*] Adding whale sound when player wakes up underwater instead of roost. 
[/list]

[b]Balancing:[/b]
We made the following mini-games easier: 
[list]
[*] Balap karung 
[*] Tug of war 
[*] Cow competition
[*] Chicken competition
[*] Bonk the skeleton 
[*] Smashing pumpkin
[*] Match Pattern
[/list]
 
[b]Localizations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Various translation improvements.
[/list]

Best regards, 
Stairway Team

notes.title: April 2024 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the April 2024 Coral Island development update!

This month, it's all about the ocean. Take a look at several new Merfolk and more! PLEASE NOTE: there are [b]mid to late-game spoilers[/b] ahead.


[b]Coral Island 1.1 beta will launch on May 20th, 2024. Join our [url=http://discord.gg/stairway]Discord[/url] for more information!
[/b]

[h2][b]Free Wallpaper Alert[/b][/h2]
New wallpaper. Visit our [url=http://discord.gg/stairway]Discord[/url] to get access to other sizes, perfect for your PC and or mobile phones!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/3517f61e0c23ec7f418230da366b5bba9a2fab5f.jpg[/img]


[b][h2]Merfolk Townies[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/9434d26c9534410fb418b0fa6b1be797749aa68a.png[/img]

Meet the latest members of the Merfolk Kingdom: a tattoo artist, a rancher, a tavern owner, and a senior guard. 

[b]Rysy[/b] runs her own tattoo shop where she designs all the tattoos herself and doesn't take custom orders. Art over custom, she said. Sorry, folks! She dedicates a lot of time to perfecting her art, hoping to find people who appreciate it. Could that someone be you?

[b]Slamet[/b] is a rancher who can help you get animals for your [b]underwater ranch[/b]. He's trained countless sea horses, [b]mermoos[/b] and more. If it were up to him, he'd care for all the animals in the ocean, but alas, he's only got two hands. So, he dedicates himself to serving the kingdom.

Fun fact: Slamet, like Joko, is a common name in Indonesia. It’s also the name of a mountain in Central Java. The word "Slamet" loosely means "safety" or "congratulations."

[b]Jannu [/b]owns [b]Sleepy Eel[/b], the local tavern. He's single and not interested in dating; he's content with his life and prefers not to let a relationship complicate things. You'll find him at the tavern all the time, fully devoted to his work.


[b]Tahat[/b], a loyal guard who has served the kingdom for many years. He's married to what he considers the most beautiful sea creature in the world, [b]Etna[/b], and leads a quiet life. They've mostly stayed in the kingdom, only traveling when duty calls. Tahat is a man of loyalty to the kingdom, a trait he shares with his daughter, Denali.


[b][h2]Merfolk Relationships[/h2][/b]
Once you've advanced far enough in the game, you can start building relationships with the Merfolk.  Explore how we're alike and different from our friends beneath the sea.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_69b3c679b7c34d63971adb79f0b90898~mv2.gif[/img]
[The player is in everyone's business, as usual. Bless my heart.]

Discover their likes and dislikes, and they might open up about their stories. Learn about their hobbies, passions, and heck, if you talk to the right person, they might even reveal the advantages and disadvantages of being named after famous mountains.

[b][h2]Merfolk Romance[/h2][/b]
That's right! Romance with the Merfolk will be available in the 1.1 update. Who's the first choice? Is it Semeru or Semeru?

Remember Erika's tip: everyone loves gifts. Now it's not just the townies, but also the underwater hotties. 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_71bae174ffe8405b976a9ee4aaff278a~mv2.gif[/img]
[This also means [b]a new wedding location[/b] for all the wedding location collectors out there. Better keep both eyes peeled for this one!]

[b][h2]Ocean Farming[/h2][/b]

Game progression unlocks underwater farming. Farmers, once you've cleared your underwater farm, dive right into farming. Mix different land crops together and see what underwater seedbags they produce. Plant them to unlock even more varieties of seeds! A whole new world indeed.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_b6928d988483402b91014317df755293~mv2.gif[/img]
[Your newest property: location, location, location!]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_9c3d32abea714f259d7354c5afe906e1~mv2.gif[/img]
[Same tool, different place. Still Hoeing around.]

What crops need underwater is not more water, but light! And that's exactly what the Lumina Wand will provide, a new tool you'll acquire as you progress through the game.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_68e87c74a0b14a9c989848df04829556~mv2.gif[/img]
[The Lumina Wand will provide ample light for your underwater crops to thrive.]


[b][h2]Ocean Crops[/h2][/b]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_7265aefc5a0c48abb9cba24dde460c51~mv2.gif[/img]
[Mix up different land crops and see what underwater seedbags they produce—it's all in this cute little three-pocket thingy. You've got one on your land farm too!]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3344226822ca44b1b7ea9ab915ac5faa~mv2.gif[/img]
[Fun fact: "labu" means pumpkin in Bahasa Indonesia.]



[b][h2]Ocean Ranching[/h2][/b]

The ranch has five underwater animals: [b]Mermoo, Inkhog, Shellcluck, Carapoultry, and Seashroud[/b]. Just like the land ranch animals, each one of these cuties produces something you can sell. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/b9b20218c9173764655b4a1aa9b7a8bb8777c980.png[/img]
[I know they're all cute, but I must say, my ranch strategy would be to fill up my farm with millions of Mermoos 'cos look at them!]

Seashroud takes inspiration from the leaf slug, a real underwater creature. Cute, isn't it?

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_c793603117f54adba9f23daff4defe62~mv2.gif[/img]

Just like your dry cows and sheep, you’ll need to pet these underwater animals and feed them hay, bla bla bla. By the time you gain access to these cuties, you’ll already know the ropes—you'd be a pro rancher yourself!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_fa544b3cd8a54d289d500eaf7adb43b8~mv2.gif[/img]
[This is where you can purchase your underwater animals. And, more importantly, it's where you'll find Slamet. Huehuehue.]

[b][h2]Ocean Decor[/h2][/b]

New farm, new decor. With you having two separate farms in version 1.1, where would all that money go if we didn't release more decor? 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_6437e4eb44df46e99a3110a318167944~mv2.gif[/img]
[The red one is my favorite.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_1cd56f1556664a559f3bd0d90ceaa0fc~mv2.gif[/img]
[Now you're sleeping on seaweed, just like the other merfolk do.]


You can still bring your favorite land decor—do NOT worry! We've added new tags to decor items to clarify whether you can place these items on land, underwater, or both.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/15b5858b8903d583f9646847e970e2cb9cab4e14.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/4d6862face7f8c034b3a0e390bfaed7f625355b6.png[/img]


[b][h2]Ocean Rank S[/h2][/b]

Remember these things you saw while diving? If you've advanced through the diving questline, you've likely come across these various "orchestra sites." These will play a key role in your final quest to reach Ocean Rank S.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_5c688b4774c64ef59e92af5deabe6b27~mv2.gif[/img]
[This merfolk dances as well as I cook—I don't cook.]


[b][h2]NPC Speech Bubble[/h2][/b]
We've added a variety of speech bubbles that your spouse might say to you during the day.  In testing, we've found this new feature to be super immersive and really helps bring the characters to life.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_27ca194c25fd48b4919c6e0866be276d~mv2.gif[/img]
[Hehe, I'm Sunshine.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0532dd04a4f748c9be74e18829e9be20~mv2.gif[/img]
[Alright, boo, thanks. My wife is so nice.]


[b][h2]Decor System Improvements[/h2][/b]
We've signifincatly improved the decor experience. In addition to UX improvements, flooring and walls are now treated as stackable items. Upon applying a flooring or wall, you'll acquire the items as a floaty so you can easily reuse the patterns you've collected.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_8ad470fefc7c488091f082dd987249b4~mv2.gif[/img]
[This floaty will help you visualize better what you're currently holding.]


[b][h2]Library Books[/h2][/b]
For enjoyers of books, the library now slowly gets populated as you increase the towns rank. Bonus: Some books now offer perks when read, such as mastery points. Additionally, two special books provide a permanent buff that boosts the rate you earn relationship points.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_461e6d928cc44d1f97b291aff7593049~mv2.gif[/img]
[Reading pays off!]

[b][h2]Multiplayer Teaser & Switch Backers[/h2][/b]

We're making TREMENDOUS progress on adding Multiplayer to Coral Island!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_20490f4196e84d22abd7224872aa1f5f~mv2.png[/img]
[You and up to 3 other farmers let loose on Starlet Town]

Switch backers: we're still in the game development process and going strong. We don't have any updates to share yet, but we'll keep you informed as soon as we have more to share!


[h2][b]What's Next[/b][/h2]
In June, we'll showcase the progress of Multiplayer development in Coral Island. We can't wait for you to see the updates and just how enjoyable farming with friends can be!

Speaking of friends, If you're looking to make new gaming buddies, why not join our Discord server? You'll meet some of the coolest, most passionate farmers around.

Coral Island Discord: [url=http://discord.gg/stairway]take me there!
[/url]
[b]Thanks for reading,[/b]
Stairway Team

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0-947
notes.content:
Hi Farmers,

In this patch, we're implementing a "load save file from backup" feature to handle the very rare case where a save file becomes corrupted. You should now be able to view and load from backup save files.

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Load from backup save files: We've added an option in Game Settings called "Show Backup." Once enabled on the Load Game page, this will display all the backup save files available.
