notes.title: February 2024 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the first Coral Island development update of 2024!

Here’s part 1 of the 2-part series on what’s coming in the 1.1 update. Today, we're talking about new stuff on land. Next time, we'll dive into ocean content.

[h2][b]State of Coral Island[/b][/h2]
Since 1.0 launch, we've been closely monitoring all the feedback from our community. Whether it's discussions on Discord, streams, Reddit posts, social media, or the Steam forums, we're grateful to everyone who's shared their thoughts and supported us.

We're committed to fully realizing the vision that we've had for Coral Island from the very beginning, and to making it the best game that we possibly can. There are a number of improvements and features, like the Town Rank S questline, the Merfolk storyline, and much more that we are excited to bring to the game with future updates.


[b][h2]Updated Roadmap[/h2][/b]
Today, we'd like to share a look at our current development roadmap with you. The future of the game is looking incredibly exciting! 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_5d5187d799dd4a8e81e9b32264084593~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_740,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_5d5187d799dd4a8e81e9b32264084593~mv2.png[/img]


[h2][b]Game Infographic[/b][/h2]
Since our initial Kickstarter, Coral Island has grown significantly. With the 1.0 launch, we brought you a world with 130 hand-drawn NPCs and over 600,000 words, among numerous other content and features. This game has been a true labor of love by our dedicated developers. Now, with the 1.1 update, we've added even more cool stuff, giving you new things to see and do.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/8b591389254c34f70e283eea9bf3e20ed40acb24.png[/img]


[b][h2]Town Rank S[/h2][/b]
Become the ultimate farmer by reaching Town Rank S, a new end-game goal that expands and completes existing storylines. Yeah, hitting Rank A is pretty cool, but why stop there? If you're looking for more challenges and achievements, go for Rank S! We've added Town Rank S for anyone who's up for an extra layer of accomplishment. It's there for the taking if you want to push your farming skills to the max!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3fbb3ab77bc04ff3aee986653ada497f~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_416,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_3fbb3ab77bc04ff3aee986653ada497f~mv2.png[/img]


[h2][b]New Town Rank Category: Attractions[/b][/h2]

Attractions is a new Town Rank category that becomes available after you've reached Town Rank A. You'll help the town build new attractions that will benefit townies and attract visitors.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_4ccc19629f3e4191a6bfb2d501cbe7f3~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_416,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_4ccc19629f3e4191a6bfb2d501cbe7f3~mv2.png[/img]

Here's a sneak peek at a couple of the attractions:
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_50dabdc57dbc4727a3fa004aae659f4f~mv2.gif[/img]
[Everyone needs a Decent Gym.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_43f13ae855a845928ee942b374bafe08~mv2.gif[/img]
[Also, everyone needs access to great ramen!]

[h2][b]Museum Rank S[/b][/h2]

To get to Rank S in the museum, your task is to bring dinosaurs back to life, sort of. You'll be making animated projections that make these ancient creatures look like they're alive again. So, how are you going to make that happen? Well, you’ll just have to play and see for yourself! Huehuheu.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_920fd8f162ec4e8ba4e5e59002c559a7~mv2.gif[/img]
[RAWRRRR!]

[h2][b]Heritage Rank S[/b][/h2]

Embark on an epic quest to recover fragments of the Guardian's Mural and unlock the full story of the island's rich history and heritage.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_32ecba8015c6455a98aba1fd4d5804af~mv2.gif[/img]
[The Guardian’s Mural]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_bd64019c4a5545fb82b7f5ea4d19ba03~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_416,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_bd64019c4a5545fb82b7f5ea4d19ba03~mv2.png[/img]
[The mysterious Guardians!]


[b][h2]Tourists now visit the town[/h2][/b]

Roll out the welcome mat for tourists visiting the island weekly, (looking at you too, Tourist Backers! Welcome to Coral Island!) offering new opportunities for exploration, interaction, and adventure.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_09a6f785fc52400dbd01b17bfd45e640~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_463,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_09a6f785fc52400dbd01b17bfd45e640~mv2.png[/img]
[Meet the Tourist Backers! They’ll be visiting Coral Island two seasons each year, wearing their own unique[b] seasonal outfits[/b]. Plus, you can even [b]chat[/b] with them! And just the heads up, before anyone asks: nope, you can’t romance these tourists.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d379e74ad9a24c1eae2c42825aee1b53~mv2.gif[/img]
[You’ll find tourists visiting different parts of town.]


[h2][b]Giants Story Finale Sneak Peek[/b][/h2]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3c0089cdc46d48518480362d5f53b332~mv2.gif[/img]
[I wonder which way you ought to go...]


[h2][b]New Mechanic: Hangouts[/b][/h2]
For the 1.1 update, you can invite your favorite dateable NPCs to hang out and earn friendship points by inviting them for ramen, enjoying a fishing date, or having a movie night, among other fun activities. And that's not all – we're looking to grow this feature in future updates to include more than just the dateable NPCs. So, tell us, which townies are you most excited to hang out with?

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_646584bf164b453fa594a9ec4ab0a40a~mv2.gif[/img]
[You can invite eligible NPC to [b]hangout[/b] twice a week.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_bafe1498beb44ab8b469217d96863141~mv2.gif[/img]
[Choose from a variety of hangout spots. Unlock more spots through progression.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d8b08209dc3346fc9aedf7fc48796eac~mv2.gif[/img]
[Getting up close and personal - here's a snapshot of me and Alice on our museum date. Alone, no more!]


[h2][b]New Ranch Animals: Buffalo and Ostrich![/b][/h2]
Meet the Buffalo and Ostrich, two exciting additions to your farm. You'll be able to acquire these unique farm animals at the Savannah.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_a5126164df914056b4bc59d26a2db828~mv2.gif[/img]
[How are you getting out of the coop door?]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_4c45a3fbd7c248b68d12c06fd9ffeb74~mv2.gif[/img]
[Look at those ears!]

[h2][b]New Outfits and Decor[/b][/h2]
We’re adding even more outfits and decor options! New look, who dis.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_992b6a3ad3324cc9a9872acd74d48a78~mv2.gif[/img]
[Looking good.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_7be1ca22c1c9430db3897c82fd58668f~mv2.gif[/img]
[Oh yes, we did!]

[h2][b]Other updates (SPOILER ALERT)[/b][/h2]
There's loads more to share, but let's not make this blog a novel. Here’s a quick sneak peek: 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_8806cfb82f094916bd85a802cc274b03~mv2.gif[/img]
[Besides the bald hair option (which some of you really dig, so it stays), we've added two more hair choices for hat-wearers.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_7f0f8fda39704e8bae39ed4aaee53a7e~mv2.gif[/img]
[Wildlife will begin repopulating the island as you heal the land and ocean.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_f45216898a1d481291682a894b83265c~mv2.gif[/img]
[Say goodbye to those Pufferfish stalls at festivals, Karen's not running them anymore. Phew!]


[h2][b]Localization Update[/b][/h2]
Our vision for Coral Island has always been to make it accessible to players worldwide. However, at the 1.0 launch, we weren't able to include as many languages as we hoped. When we launched our Kickstarter, we unfortunately underestimated the sheer volume of words the game would have by 1.0, and the localization costs are significant. We're now re-evaluating our roadmap.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_35b6e83b47c04e53aab1e621832106ed~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_740,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_35b6e83b47c04e53aab1e621832106ed~mv2.png[/img]

The next language we are going to implement will be Thai, and we're beginning work on that this month. Going forward, we plan to expand localization support in the future where possible.


[h2][b]Happy Chinese New Year[/b][/h2]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_248a74abb2694838938c9c07788c41fb~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_592,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_248a74abb2694838938c9c07788c41fb~mv2.png[/img]

[h2][b]What's Next?[/b][/h2]
Next April, we'll be diving into the ocean-related content of the 1.1 update. It’s a deep dive, so brace yourself for an ocean of info! A bit of an ocean pun for you.


[b]Thanks for reading,[/b]
Stairway Team

notes.title: Hotfix v1-218
notes.content:
Hi Farmers,

Happy New Year 2024! Our development team had a much-needed rest and is now ready with another release:

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect loading of save backup, causing backup save to not load when the save is corrupted.
[*] Prevented some cases of corrupted save data.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing game entry if any save files were corrupted.
[*] Resolved backup files appearing in the main list but not loading.
[*] Solved a problem where nothing could be placed in house storage when the panel was first opened.
[*] Updated to address hairstyle clipping issues.
[*] Added safety checks for cooking to prevent further crashes.
[*] Fixed an issue where fruit tart and seaweed ingredients were not inserted after canceling ingredients.
[*] Corrected incorrect flower textures.
[*] Fixed an issue where Zarah, Luke, and Wakuu's heart 10 cutscenes were not triggering in some cases.
[*] Resolved incorrect player skin in Mark's Heart 10.
[*] Fixed the wrong 3D mesh for decoy objects.
[*] Addressed the issue of time freezing while fishing.
[*] Fixed a crash when using traps.
[*] Resolved an issue with spike traps not dealing damage.
[*] Corrected a tool action exploit using vault animations.
[*] Disabled the ability to move fruit plants to floor tiles.
[*] Fixed a crash when changing mine levels while being attacked by certain monsters.
[*] Addressed placement issues for some curtains.
[*] Resolved a potential random crash due to a rare logic timing issue.
[*] Fixed crashes occurring when skipping dialogues in baby cutscenes.
[*] Corrected the issue of not being able to find Olan on the map.
[*] Fixed Amalo's attack behavior.
[*] Resolved the issue of Theo wearing a swimsuit in the Community Center on Spring Day 1.
[*] Fixed schedules for Kenny, Mark, and Pablo during the Winter Fair.
[*] Resolved an issue preventing the opening of decor mode after entering the winter festival.
[*] Fixed an issue where an NPC spouse would get stuck in the starting position after decor mode.
[*] Corrected an issue where Leah and Millie's heart 10 events were not triggering in some cases.
[*] Fixed problems with the aging barrel and item refinement.
[*] Addressed an issue where Surya's heart 10 event was not triggering in some cases.
[*] Resolved some instances where Scott would drop the baby while carrying them.
[*] Fixed various dialogue typos.
[*] Fixed issues with cutscene logic requirements.
[*] Fixed issues and zoom behavior in decor mode UX.
[*] Fixed dynamic dialogue issues for Zarah after having a kid.
[*] Fixed the hedgehog seahorse issue.
[*] Fixed the issue of hay disappearing from the silo when moving the silo building.
[*] Fixed a stair collision issue in the forest area.
[*] Fixed the tutorial panel making the pickstarter cutscene stuck.
[*] Fixed the wrong race track for the pet race minigame.
[*] Fixed crashing when opening the Cow Competition Panel UI [Xbox only].
[*] Fixed a crash when starting the Cow and Chicken competition [Xbox only].
[*] Attempted to avoid crashes by limiting the number of spawned slime projectiles at a time in combat.
[*] Fixed the Trivia Interactible Choice Panel by adding a function to change the list options instead of re-showing the choice panel.
[*] Fixed a crash in the main event harvest when opening the panel.
[*] Fixed certain heart events that couldn't be triggered.
[*] Fixed crashes caused by an older fix to farm tiles.
[*] Fixed the absence of SFX in some cutscenes.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]

notes.title: Hotfix v1-176
notes.content:
Hi Farmers, 

Another day, another batch of bugs crushed. Here are the fixes we made last week.

[b]Bugfix:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed levels wrongly loaded for crowdfunding cutscenes.
[*] Fixed Ben having two spring outfits in the relationship UI.
[*] Fixed the issue where Jim's Wife Photo could not be turned in after exiting/loading the game.
[*] Fixed the incorrect sacred tree level south of the farm at the start of the game.
[*] Fixed the issue where Scott's heart level 10 could not be triggered.
[*] Fixed the incorrect date for Lily's birthday.
[*] Fixed the fire giant's lobby cutscene not being triggered.
[*] Fixed Charles' Intro to trigger the Spring intro dialogue first when applicable.
[*] Fixed the inability of the spouse to sleep in the player's bed if there's furniture beside it.
[*] Fixed crash when destroying a fruit tree using explosives.
[*] Fixed crash during the Harvest Festival when opening the Beluga Bay display.
[*] Attempted to fix the match pattern minigame post-game causing inventory loss.
[*] Fixed item duplication when enchanting items.
[*] Added missing monitors in Lily's spouse room.
[*] Fixed various stair collision issues.
[*] Fixed crash when catching the magnolia green jumper and other spiders.
[*] Fixed the wrong setup for the widow spider and hedgehog seahorse.
[*] Unloaded beach volleyball field during beach clean-up.
[*] Fixed wrong harvest prompt text for the Mythical Pet.
[*] Fixed minor typo in the Starlet Display description for the Harvest Festival.
[*] Fixed issue where the player keeps falling if upgrading the house and then sleeping in the merfolk barracks.
[*] Fixed the player ride manta animation not playing in two-legged merfolk form.
[*] Fixed dialogue bug post-marriage where the spouse still speaks their before-marriage dialogues.
[*] Fixed various issues with mail texts.
[*] Fixed some cases where NPC dialogues get repeated.
[*] 
[*] [b]Improvements:[/b]
[*] The museum is now sectioned off into separate areas, requiring loading per area, like entering a different room. This reduces memory usage for the game.
[*] Optimization of crowdfunding cutscenes.
[*] Removed the talk button in festivals when NPCs have nothing more to say.
[*] Updated all text related to having a baby to "You just had a baby."
[*] The controller input threshold, a.k.a. dead zone, is now 0.3, enhancing responsiveness.
[*] Added Cow Suit and Duck Suit to the clothing store.
[/list]

[b]Balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated cooking recipes for Apple Pie, Assorted Grilled Platter, Summer Burger, and Rainbow Sandwich.
[/list]

[b]Localizations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Implemented various translation improvements.
[/list]

Thanks to everyone for reporting bugs to our team. We'll keep working on them.

Best,
Stairway Team

notes.title: Hotfix v1-162
notes.content:
Hi Farmers, 

We're back with more hotfixes! Thank you for all your feedback and reports on our game. Here's the list of changes:

Stairway Team.

notes.title: Coral Island 1.0 Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/af959606ed802982b91a5e14d3b9c27983b42c51.png[/img]

Hello Islanders!

Coral Island 1.0 is finally released!

Coral Island v1.0 features a questline to revitalizing the town, introducing more content and exciting new features unavailable in the Early Access versions. 

Here is the list of things you’ll be able to do in this version of the game:

[list]
[*] Storyline to revitalize the town.    
[*] In-depth interactions with NPCs, including heart events and dynamic dialogue.
[*] Marriage and the ability to start a family.
[*] NPC outfits for Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter (most NPCs).
[*] Bathing outfits (select NPCs).
[*] Customization options for your house's exterior.
[*] Over 200 décor options to choose from!
[*] Over 200 clothing options to choose from!
[*] Adopt a pet. 
[*] A total of eight unique festivals each filled with mini-games. 
[*] Access to all diving depths (10m/20m/30m/40m/50m).
[*] Access to all mining gates (Earth/Water/Wind/Fire).
[*] The chance to acquire a mythical pet.
[*] Encounter Merfolk NPCs and explore their Kingdom.
[*] And much more!
[/list]

Thank you,
Stairway Games

notes.title: October 2023 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the October 2023 Coral Island development update!
Please check out our Steam page to purchase the game and find out more: swg.gg/corstm


[b]Coral Island 1.0 launches on November 14, 2023! Coming to Steam/Win10, Gamepass, Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5. The countdown is on–under two weeks to go![/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iyRUBNF7-k4

[1.0 trailer, in case you missed it!]

[u][h2]Winter outfits[/h2][/u]
Winter clothing for NPCs has landed and they're ready to cozy up as the snow starts to fall. It’s time to bundle up and embrace the chill in style on the island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/baf8a3d23c9f662220352c19379b7eda91f5ad62.png[/img]
[Everyone looking warm and comfy for Winter!]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_6e7efb93a77c43018a0ddbc4ee9e8293~mv2.gif[/img]
[Same here, Leah. Same here.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3613feaf23964c32a428911e6336b0ac~mv2.gif[/img]
[I’m all about that burrito life indoors in Winter, but you do you, Joko!]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_43ea3f95df8a41b09698b0d680ca6e09~mv2.gif[/img]
[Valentina sure is active.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_a858c27b5edc47338f2474845bab2a17~mv2.gif[/img]
[Why yes, I am…snow and your company. Huehuehue.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_6e0250512a9943308962d9c96b80b52d~mv2.gif[/img]
[Samesies. Great minds, Erika.]


[u][h2]Winter fair[/h2][/u]
Get ready for some frosty fun at The Winter Fair. From Winter 17 to 21, join in on the festivities and enjoy exciting mini-games:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_115d5cea93894253aa18f42b33bee788~mv2.gif[/img]

Speaking of minigames, check out all the fun things available during Winter Fair:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_520fa25a06ff44d6a20da05bec00cf8a~mv2.gif[/img]
[b]Bullseye Blitz (Shooting Mini-game)[/b]: Ready, aim, fire! Test your marksmanship skills with this shooting mini-game.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_5154ba2024834eb791313ebbea516d68~mv2.gif[/img]
[b]Treasure Trawl (Magnet FishMini-game)[/b]: Relive the nostalgic joy of childhood as you play a life-sized fishing magnet mini-game. Catch all sorts of treasures lurking beneath the water's surface.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_f1d8b3feec884b5ba39d738c178119e4~mv2.gif[/img]
[b]Trivia Bonanza (Trivia Mini-game)[/b]: Challenge your knowledge in the trivia mini-game. Guess the items displayed and earn points for selecting the correct answers. It's a brain-teasing blast!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d7fdda7074534a47b626ff682ad4f099~mv2.gif[/img]
[b]Ice Glide Showdown (Curling Mini-game)[/b]: Glide gracefully across the ice as you partake in a thrilling game of Curling. Show off your skills and dominate the ice rink!

[u][h2]Giveaway Alert[/h2][/u]
The launch of Coral Island's 1.0 is right around the corner (November 14, 2023) and we could really use your help in getting the word out. If you're up for it, we've got some exciting stuff lined up!

The Social Media Giveaway Event Rewards (for each platform):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/3a231e999376e42b6e76ca7a7d06ae7e65f3c5fb.png[/img]

[b]Instructions and how to enter the giveaways here:[/b]
[list]
[*] Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/coralislandgame/status/1718944507482591399]Here[/url]
[*] Instagram: [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/CzBVgx7rMBU/?img_index=1]Here[/url]
[*] Facebook: [url=https://www.facebook.com/coralislandgame/posts/pfbid0Rc5QX9nm9fZtmPAwWfHAG36pPZRpJAbmumcY2Jmp14HdthRqkfKzr1p5HcfEXg8Vl]Here[/url]
[/list]
Whatever you choose to do, thank you for being a part of our island community.
Wishing you all the best of luck!


[u][h2]New Discord Server Emoji[/h2][/u]
We're thrilled to unveil a brand-new set of Discord emojis and stickers, specially designed to celebrate the upcoming 1.0 launch of Coral Island. Join our lovely server to check it out: https://discord.gg/stairway 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/b3186a32fddf273d31f0a8971d4e2c6be63ad80e.jpg[/img]
[Which one is your favorite?]


[u][h2]Dateable popularity contest[/h2][/u]
It's time to settle this once and for all. Just who is the most popular dateable character in Coral Island?! We'll make new character wallpaper art (mobile and desktop) featuring the NPC that wins. Here's an example of a character wallpaper art featuring Semeru:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/d4ff4c1c8052c209b829ca4780cf92a3055fee2b.jpg[/img]
[We love sharks...but Semeru is best shark.]

Every day starting tomorrow, we'll feature one dateable character on our socials. To vote for a character, all you have to do is[b] like the post[/b] featuring that character (1 point) or [b]share it[/b] (1 point). You can do both for 2 points. For those of you who can't decide, fret not, you can vote on more than one character!

On December 3, 2023, we'll total all the points and announce the most popular character. The character wallpaper art should be ready before the end of the year.

[b]Thanks for reading,[/b]
Stairway Team

notes.title: August 2023 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the August 2023 Coral Island development update!
Please check out our Steam page to purchase the game and find out more: swg.gg/corstm

This post is part 4 of a 4-part series where we'll be going over the content you can expect to play in the Merfolk & Fall update.

[b]We're planning to release the Merfolk & Fall update in early September. We need extra time to polish and bug-fix this HUGE update.[/b]


[h2][u]Adoptable pets[/u][/h2]

Adoptable pets are going live in the upcoming update. Check out all the adorable pets (designed by our very own backers) that you'll be able to adopt!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3df9890282c24c1085879e6694055ad5~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1023,h_1564,al_c,q_90/491ae5_3df9890282c24c1085879e6694055ad5~mv2.webp[/img]

You have 20 pets to choose from, ranging from cats, dogs, foxes, bunnies, and a lizard.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_59860a7519794af4a22b39dfefc7afdc~mv2.gif[/img]
[Lots of different animations play inside the pet shelter to bring the animals to life!]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_8ca2e4af8dc948c68cdb16a73b550de4~mv2.gif[/img]
[Animals take turns soaking up the sunshine outside, giving everyone a chance to shine!]

To adopt a pet, you'll first need to reach [b]Town Rank E[/b]. This unlocks the availability of both the Pet Bed and Pet House at the Pet Shelter. Once you purchase either item and place it on your farmland or inside your house, you’re all set to adopt a pet!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_f2f827f9adc94cb1903b2db254ae21d7~mv2.gif[/img]
[The different pet beds available.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_89d22f02db704cbcb99aacd32cff0896~mv2.gif[/img]
[SPIKER DOOOOOOOO!]


[h2][u]Auto Chest[/u][/h2]

The Auto Chest is the ultimate [b]automation item[/b] for the crafty farmer. Head to the lab to unlock this one-of-a-kind chest. Need convincing? Take a look at what it does below:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_add5d38c1e9442ffa3d70c6e16592b71~mv2.gif[/img]
[The Auto Chest: Not your average chest, oh no!]

Placed by your machines, this smart chest [b]automatically moves items to and from machines[/b] on its sides. Simply load it up with the items or materials you want to process.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_187afac89c31425e844d3c6c48f87c0f~mv2.gif[/img]
[Work smarter, not harder.]

When stacked, they magically morph into conveyor belts, allowing you to make your own product line. Time to turn your organization game up a notch!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_9a92579e486f45a7b2a87f552f2b0891~mv2.gif[/img]
[Behold our 30-chest-long conveyor belt masterpiece!]

Items will flow seamlessly between the Auto Chests and all linked machines! And when ready, just access the Auto Chest to collect your items.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_36f8f6ca182843168eb67af782f787a6~mv2.gif[/img]
[The fruit juice will be deposited into the aging barrel once complete!]


[h2][u]New building styles[/u][/h2]

[h3][u]Farmhouse[/u][/h3]

We're excited to reveal the different selection of house styles that have been added for each house level! You’ll have [b]5 styles[/b] to choose from, check it out:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_4e2a13eaeee24643b18998fd4c7c6819~mv2.gif[/img]
[Level 1 farmhouse styles.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_1a6cdd320aa14e91bc3c804597943c0e~mv2.gif[/img][Level 2 farmhouse styles.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_964f34a453d2481ebf4b069cbd8e06cd~mv2.gif[/img]
[Level 3 farmhouse styles.]

[h3][u]Farm Buildings[/u][/h3]

But wait, there’s more! You can now swap [b]styles for various farm buildings[/b], including the barn and coop. Take a peek below:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_e98a9d72ceff47c8ba0301fe11a6bddc~mv2.gif[/img]

Visit the carpenters to change the style of your farmhouse or building. A fee applies, of course.

[h2][u]Merit Points[/u][/h2]

Introducing Merit Points, a new feature to our game where players can [b]trade earned points for special items[/b] at the Merit Exchange counter.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_c4d5c3ce66e548f1b77143395434d328~mv2.gif[/img]
[Unlock the Merit Exchange counter as you progress through the game.]

[b]Earn your Merit points[/b] by increasing the town's rank, completing errands, and participating in festivals. 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0e8f793150a5492cbcbcb931e29f933c~mv2.gif[/img]
[You'll see a recap of Merit Points earned at the end of the day.]

[b]Exclusive[/b] Merit Exchange counter items include stamina fruit, mastery elixirs (granting a master skill point), and many unique scarecrow designs.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_6a58cf30bfff4ffb8b96bb8c5a0753b9~mv2.gif[/img]
[Time to roll up those sleeves and rack up those Merit Points.]


[h2][u]Scarecrows![/u][/h2]

Hold onto your sunhats, farmers! We're adding a ton of different scarecrow designs. Most can be acquired at the Merit Exchange counter, while some will fetch for a hefty price at the secret shop. Let us know what you think!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_78f825796d8442429371c9dafa808ea1~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_1415,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_78f825796d8442429371c9dafa808ea1~mv2.png[/img]
[Which one is your favorite?]


[h2][u]Cooking updates[/u][/h2]

Cooking just got a major upgrade! It sources ingredients from [b]your global inventory[/b] (across all chests) and filters ingredients based on the recipe you're cooking. No more backpack ingredient juggling!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_164b042fc01e4ed29635e87b827e05c3~mv2.gif[/img]
[Global inventory makes cooking a breeze.]

And here’s the icing on the cake: [b]Each recipe now yields not one, but two[/b] dishes!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3cf5875f14cc485f99904a4726a8880e~mv2.gif[/img]
[No more tough choices between eating or gifting. Do both!]

Plus, buffs from cooked dishes are now displayed on your hot bar and in your inventory. You can have up to 2 buffs active at a time, one from food and one from drinks.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_684d279d36e5439895f80fe4f16f02d8~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_591,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_684d279d36e5439895f80fe4f16f02d8~mv2.png[/img]
[A preview of what the buff icon looks like in your inventory screen.]


[h2][u]Charity DLC ($50k raised!)[/u][/h2]

A heartfelt thank you to all the Ocean Guardians around the world! Your support has enabled us to raise an [b]astounding $50,000 USD[/b] for an incredible cause.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_7c5b7d3b848548d080aa658b3176e4d1~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_740,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_7c5b7d3b848548d080aa658b3176e4d1~mv2.png[/img]


[h2][u]What's next[/u][/h2]

In September, we'll take a look at the Winter Fair, Winter Outfits and have some exciting news to share!


[b]Thanks for reading,[/b]

Stairway Team

notes.title: July 2023 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the July 2023 Coral Island development update!
Please check out our Steam page to purchase the game and find out more: swg.gg/corstm

This post is part 3 of a 3-part series where we'll be going over the content you can expect to play in the Merfolk & Fall update.

[b]We're planning to release the Merfolk & Fall Update sometime in August 2023.[/b]


[h2][u]Merfolk character reveal[/u][/h2]

We're wrapping up our Merfolk reveals with a bang! Here's your last reveal:
Introducing [b]Krakatoa[/b], King of the Merfolk Kingdom! King Krakatoa, named after his esteemed processors, embodies the weight of his noble lineage. He carries the weight of his family's legacy with a sense of duty and fairness.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_422fa01442824e0bb94fcb760935de00~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_1193,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_422fa01442824e0bb94fcb760935de00~mv2.png[/img]
[King Krakatoa, leader of the Merfolk Kingdom.]


[h2][u]Merfolk Kingdom[/u][/h2]

Prepare for an enchanting journey into the depths of the ocean, where the Merfolk Kingdom awaits!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_72bd0b1a1dd7432298dae76f24769b8b~mv2.gif[/img]
[At long last, the gates will open.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_7a2b6839341242e6a6a86b8375260ebd~mv2.gif[/img]
[Naga Palace interior.]


[h2][u]Merfolk storyline[/u][/h2]

You've witnessed the effects of the oil spill on Starlet Town. Now, we're taking the story beneath the waves. The Merfolk storyline provides a unique perspective on the spill's impact under the sea.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_086817daeab5457190a40b68cdd70abc~mv2.gif[/img]
[What happened to the big root?!]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_df56c992b1374d68aaf12a0b8bcff166~mv2.gif[/img][You'll just have to see for yourself...]


[h2][u]Additional lab equipment[/u][/h2]

We're bringing more devices to the Lab to help streamline your farming and enhance your gameplay experience:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_55808738c7404af3b9f9f93e32162f10~mv2.gif[/img]
[b]Auto Trash Collector[/b]: This device automatically collects trash when placed on the ocean floor. A great source of trash!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_e4be298dbe8149a289c69b031d45f0d6~mv2.gif[/img]
[b]Ultra Scarecrow[/b]: Say goodbye to pesky crows with the Ultra Scarecrow. When placed on a farm tile, it covers a 19x19 radius, making it the ultimate crow deterrent!


[h2][u]Game achievements[/u][/h2]

Who's ready for some game achievements?! Here's a preview!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_8ae14c9251d246cd96378446c8a6f740~mv2.gif[/img]
[52 achievements await you.]


[h2][u]Ranching updates[/u][/h2]

To make your ranch feels more alive, we've added a touch of realism! Animals that receive love through petting, feeding, and product collection may now take delightful daytime [b]naps[/b] and peacefully snooze at night.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0d6163c45f4c433a84193807c880920a~mv2.gif[/img]
[Naps are the best thing ever!]

Animals now also have a chance to get sick. When they do fall ill, you'll need to give your animal some Animal Medicine to cure them. The season and your animal's mood influence how likely your animal is to get sick. Placing a temperature machine inside a coop or barn will prevent any animal from getting sick.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_798d4f2452114ea29deaccbefe0deaf6~mv2.gif[/img]
[Animals will naturally recover from sickness in 4 days if you don't give them medicine.]


[h2][u]Various UI updates[/u][/h2]

We continue to revamp various elements of the game UI to better communicate your in-game progress and highlight important information!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_2399ba0c7b8f4b3191a73fc2f20962c4~mv2.gif[/img]
[Introducing the Town Rank activity log. See what you've unlocked as the town ranks up!]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_8f91d21131e941d6931c14afd211e6d8~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_8f91d21131e941d6931c14afd211e6d8~mv2.png[/img]
[Cooking recipes now feature icons to indicate the buff you get when consuming them.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_a3b45d663c844b26b4305af7e8054d6b~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_814,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_a3b45d663c844b26b4305af7e8054d6b~mv2.png[/img]
[Cooking now yields two dishes!]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_a4ad464d51ba437594828d8c0ad91ca1~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_a4ad464d51ba437594828d8c0ad91ca1~mv2.png[/img]
[Mastery also got a nice overhaul.]


[h2][u]Slice of life events[/u][/h2]

We've added a ton of slice of life events to the game, showcasing the everyday happenings of the community. Unlike heart events, which mostly focus on one NPC, these events bring together a wider cast of characters, unfolding naturally as you journey through the game. 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_5f7d6f29d6d845749baa0d2c3335e586~mv2.gif[/img]
[The fun.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_e75aabf9924c41f7b9ef625e48a9fde6~mv2.gif[/img]
[The fight…and more!]


[h2][u]Charity cosmetic DLC[/u][/h2]

The Ocean Guardian charity DLC is still available! [b]100%[/b] of publisher and developer’s proceeds will benefit Coral Guardian, a non-profit org with the mission to [b]protect & restore coral ecosystems[/b] worldwide. Preserve together! Get it here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2471180/Coral_Island__Ocean_Guardian_Charity_DLC_Pack/]link to awesome charity DLC
[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/c42ff8a807a71365f71777d4a145a8ddfbfa28c0.jpg[/img]

[h2][u]What's next[/u][/h2]

Next month we'll be taking a look at even more exciting things, including the excavation site, winter outfits, the winter fair, adoptable pets, merit points & more!


[b]Thanks for reading,[/b]

Stairway Team

Introducing [b]Semeru, the Guard Leader[/b] of the Merfolk Kingdom! He is a dateable character, yes. Semeru is all about keeping the Kingdom safe, and he takes his duty very seriously. He resides in the barracks.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3c47917a45f44e48bf1aa52fe0fcdd5e~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_1025,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_3c47917a45f44e48bf1aa52fe0fcdd5e~mv2.png[/img]
[Semeru, the Guard Leader of Merfolk Kingdom.]

Here's the roster of dateable Merfolk characters. We have Semeru, the head of the guard, Denali, the steadfast gatekeeper, and Princess Miranjani.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_769a4b11f81249d4afe2d3db5ba3a29c~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_555,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_769a4b11f81249d4afe2d3db5ba3a29c~mv2.png[/img]


[h2][u]Final dateable lineup[/u][/h2]

We’ve finally arrived! Presenting the complete lineup of romance characters for Coral Island, all 28 of them.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_a26cda2b55b6443d983d68bb344c47d7~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_550,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_a26cda2b55b6443d983d68bb344c47d7~mv2.png[/img]
[Merfolk romance will come in a [b]post-1.0[/b] update!]


[h2][u]Spooky festival[/u][/h2]

As Fall approaches, we're getting into the spirit with our Spooky Festival! The townies of Starlet Town go all out for this festival, so it's not one to miss.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_26209fbb8b234badb120f1d9c044fb0a~mv2.gif[/img]
[Spooky festival takes place on Fall 28]

This event features Bonk the Skeleton and Ring Toss minigames, an Ogoh-Ogoh parade, a scavenger hunt, and so much more. Don't miss out on the fun!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_8fa9cc4321b24beda1ba6c2553c64aea~mv2.gif[/img][Bonk the skeleton.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_abc12aab473f4bb59fbc5df6e81c7c27~mv2.gif[/img][Ring toss.]

[b]Fun fact[/b]: The Ogoh-ogoh parade is a vibrant and festive procession held annually in Bali, Indonesia. During this event, giant papier-mâché sculptures, known as ogoh-ogoh, are paraded through the streets to ward off evil spirits before the Balinese New Year, known as Nyepi. It's a colorful and lively celebration that showcases the rich cultural traditions of Bali.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_acf2fb253bdb4c4d90bc5b850cd682f5~mv2.gif[/img]
[Ogoh-ogoh parade.]


[h2][u]Develop ranching equipment[/u][/h2]

Ever wished you could have extra help taking care of farm animals? We've got you covered! [b]The Lab[/b] offers a range of Ranching equipment that you can develop to make your tasks easier and more efficient.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_65c0f43de028444596a32344259a20d9~mv2.gif[/img]
[b]Auto Petter[/b]: This device will automatically pet your animals when placed inside a coop or barn. Get ready to see some happy faces!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ab164256dba54c47bb548bbc3af1939a~mv2.gif[/img]
[b]Auto Feeder[/b]: No more worries about missing a feeding time. When placed inside a coop or barn and provided with hay in the silo, the Auto Feeder will take care of your animals' meal times.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_e23e2ab5e4a44acabfd163b36beb5265~mv2.gif[/img]
[b]Auto Collector[/b]: This clever contraption automatically collects animal products when placed inside a coop or barn. Just sit back and let it do its thing!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_4dabbe57f37d4a19aacd22d04422c00c~mv2.gif[/img]
[b]Temperature Machine[/b]: Keep your animals comfortable in all seasons. The Temperature Machine regulates the temperature inside a coop or barn, improving animal mood in Summer and Winter.


[h2][u]Last ranch animal (for real this time)[/u][/h2]

Your final ranch animal, the [b]Llama[/b], will also be available in the upcoming update!

[u]Llama[/u]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_bd0829fcfc41417495fa885a97206ae8~mv2.gif[/img]

New [b]barn[/b] animal: you can now acquire the Llama at the Ranch! Llama's produce [b]Llama Wool[/b]. At the ranch, llamas are sold in pairs, as they are social creatures that thrive with a companion.


[h2][u]The architect's desk[/u][/h2]

We're thrilled to introduce the Architect's Desk! Harnessing the [b]power of the Giants[/b], this special desk will let you modify and decorate your farm's tiles from a bird's eye view. It's time to unleash your creativity and design the farm of your dreams!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_cf3c81cf85bc40049c38c4f403feae68~mv2.gif[/img]
[The Architect desk occupies 2x2 space]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_b69428db21844c038bbe81d36cd49a41~mv2.gif[/img]
[Move [b]any object[/b] on your farm!]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3b5c05b7ef964c4b9eed2fe6be0b93db~mv2.gif[/img]
[Moving objects will cost you, best to keep that in mind.]


[h2][u]Steam deck verified[/u][/h2]

Coral Island is now officially [b]verified for the Steam Deck platform[/b]! With this, the game's performance, stability, & user experience is great on Steam Deck. Now, you can dive into Coral Island in the palm of your hand, wherever you go [i]smoothly[/i].

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_f54c176d3f0e43eca046167917893375~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_523,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_f54c176d3f0e43eca046167917893375~mv2.jpg[/img]


[h2][u]Charity cosmetic DLC[/u][/h2]

On July 11th, we'll be launching a charity cosmetic DLC! 100% of proceeds will benefit Coral Guardian, a non-profit org with the mission to protect & restore coral ecosystems worldwide. Preserve together!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_09dad5f8bca44cbb9612e26ddff579a9~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_416,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_09dad5f8bca44cbb9612e26ddff579a9~mv2.png[/img]
[Stairway Games x Humble Games x Coral Guardian x [b]You[/b]!]


[h2][u]Backer Updates[/u][/h2]

[u]Founder Statue[/u]

Founders! Next month, July 2023, we'll be emailing you about customizing your founder statue. We can't wait to see what type of statue you make.

[u]Name in credits[/u]

A friendly reminder to please complete your Kickstarter survey to secure your name in credits. The deadline for submission is July 10, 2023. If you have any questions, please email support@stairwaygames.com or reach out to our Community Managers on Discord.


[h2][u]What's next[/u][/h2]

Next month we'll do one more Merfolk reveal; take a sneak peek at the Merfolk Kingdom & storylines, more lab devices, and go over the excavation site!


[b]Thanks for reading,[/b]

Stairway Team

notes.title: Hotfix 0.4-68650
notes.content:
Hi farmers, 

For this update, we fixed some of the issues reported by the community. Here are the release notes. 

Hotfix 0.4-68650: 

[b]Bugfix: [/b]
- Fixed crash when loading the game for some save files.
- Fixed bugs that cause farmers to be unable to continue playing after finishing the harvest festival judging cutscene.
- Eggs no longer spawn inside the nesting box (which is why some farmers reported they no longer spawn eggs). 
- Fixed crash when after sleeping while saving.
- Fixed some NPC hair becomes black when they shouldn't; now all of them have the correct hair color.

[b]Improvements:[/b]
- Improvement in text sizes for Inventory UI for easier readability
- The game will now prompt you to restart the title screen when you change the Dyslexic Font or the Font sizes modifier.

Thanks to everyone who reported bugs to us. We'll keep working on making the game as smooth as possible. 

Thanks, 
Stairway Team

notes.title: May 2023 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the May 2023 Coral Island development update!

Please check out our Steam page to purchase the game and find out more: swg.gg/corstm

This month we've got lots to share! We'll start with the release news & the updated roadmap, then go over the next game update, our biggest to date, which combines the Merfolk & Fall update into one. 

This post is part 1 of a 3-part series where we'll be going over the content you can expect to play in the Merfolk & Fall update.

[b]We're planning to release the Merfolk & Fall Update sometime in August 2023.[/b]


[h2][u]Updated roadmap[/u][/h2]

We're excited to share some news with you all! To reflect our current pace of development, we've made updates to Coral Island's roadmap.

Take a look at our updated roadmap to see what's coming up, starting with the "Merfolk & Fall Update" in August 2023.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_b33ef628cda0480cb6ff1ee089d026b0~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_969,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_b33ef628cda0480cb6ff1ee089d026b0~mv2.png[/img]

To our console players and backers, we haven't forgotten about bringing Coral Island to other platforms. We apologize for not providing more updates on this so far, but please be assured that we are still actively working out the details. Although we don’t have all the information to share at this moment, we will keep you informed as soon as we have concrete updates.

*Rewards for console backers and the Character Designer Pack tier will be delivered at a later time.


[h2][u]Merfolk character reveal[/u][/h2]

We're revealing the first of many Merfolk characters! We can't spill all the beans just yet, but we can spill some beans! Our team is working hard to bring this unique character to life. Drumroll, please...

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_670dc17fa6f643df99ecb210034cf330~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_954,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_670dc17fa6f643df99ecb210034cf330~mv2.png[/img]

Meet [b]Princess Miranjani[/b], one of the dateable Merfolk! She lives in the Kingdom with her family. Sweet, kind, with curiosity as boundless as the galaxy. Thinks door knobs are the coolest thing. 

We're going to be tight-lipped on more details, but tease more we shall. A sneak peek below at the other Merfolk you'll encounter in the upcoming update:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_e7d121bca9b1470d930db9450a35eb7b~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_578,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_e7d121bca9b1470d930db9450a35eb7b~mv2.png[/img]
[The royal Merfolk family.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_42eb384f12ac457bb601acac10616554~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_578,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_42eb384f12ac457bb601acac10616554~mv2.png[/img]
[More Merfolk: Redacted, Redacted and Redacted!]


[h2][u]Fall outfits[/u][/h2]

We're excited to release the third set of seasonal clothing in this upcoming update: fall outfits! Here's a preview:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_c1f835bf7baf4d2eb387ecf1d0bd6500~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_578,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_c1f835bf7baf4d2eb387ecf1d0bd6500~mv2.png[/img]
[Mark, Bree, Archie, Millie, and Theo]

Take a look at these outfits in-game. Let us know what you think!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_48e9a705ae1a4fb39405f40c343eb371~mv2.gif[/img][Mark in Fall outfit.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ab03dca7e4754a97a59f20b7947d01e7~mv2.gif[/img][Millie in Fall outfit.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d0f0ff65dc4e471e890c1644c6fa0e97~mv2.gif[/img]
[Theo in Fall outfit.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_7ff44f5eb2ed4719b4639b0bb80b7978~mv2.gif[/img]
[Bree in Fall outfit.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_60649e78fb4544bc8f6f9e6bceee61a5~mv2.gif[/img]
[Archie in Fall outfit.]


[h2][u]Last batch of ranch animals[/u][/h2]

Your final batch of ranch animals will be available in the upcoming update. Check them out! Peafowl, luwak and llamas!

[u]Peafowl[/u]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_64039b223bf4478398e2f7e4be089cb9~mv2.gif[/img]

New [b]coop[/b] animal: you can now acquire the Peafowl at the Ranch! Peafowls have a chance at dropping [b]Feather[/b].

[u]Luwak[/u]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_4550d8de6a7d4583b796724c077709fc~mv2.gif[/img]

New [b]barn[/b] animal: you can now acquire Luwak at the Ranch. They'll find [b]Gesha Coffee[/b] around your farm when you let them outside.


[h2][u]Heart 8 with NPCs[/u][/h2]

In the Merfolk & Fall Update, you’ll able to reach up to heart 8 with all NPCs! We've added many heart events that can now be accessed, so don't forget to check them out. Here are a couple events that we like:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_744718a956a64212bffc4c3959ae4dfa~mv2.gif[/img]
[Look at those moves!]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_5a8d07c6565e48af87509ac9ad91c829~mv2.gif[/img][Anytime Noah... anytime.]


[h2][u]Sturdy computer[/u][/h2]

Today we're taking a closer look at the Sturdy Computer, one of the many devices you can develop at the Lab. Once crafted, you can use your sturdy computer for [b]online shopping[/b].

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_e916099ce7104860b460b64174eb0055~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_416,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_e916099ce7104860b460b64174eb0055~mv2.png[/img]

Add items to your cart from select shops around town, and when ready, confirm your order for a 10-minute delivery, straight to your mailbox, by way of a carrier pigeon!

But that's not all! You can develop components at the lab and add [b]functionality[/b] to the Sturdy Computer.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_bdad8e39d71a4c7c80269834efbac408~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_578,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_bdad8e39d71a4c7c80269834efbac408~mv2.png[/img]

Whether it's the Foraging, Fishing, or Catching component, each gives you real-time information about what has spawned in the world on any given day.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_7230271f25f441d5bbb02cf1e8b862d0~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_416,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_7230271f25f441d5bbb02cf1e8b862d0~mv2.png[/img]

We hope this is helpful for those looking to complete their Museum collection!


[h2][u]Shed[/u][/h2]

We've also added Shed that can be purchased at the Carpenter. The shed provides an interior area of 17x17 for those of you that want more space!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_233cbd94d1324424b5b99d267c3f54a2~mv2.gif[/img]


[h2][u]Decor (Indoor & Outdoor)[/u][/h2]

Last but not least, we're adding more decor to the game!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_f0e027e6e4924d6ea9aff6bfdd228282~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_555,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_f0e027e6e4924d6ea9aff6bfdd228282~mv2.png[/img]
[Merfolk indoor decor!]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_2a6e8c48ffb547a7904209dd1de10b5b~mv2.gif[/img]
[Merfolk outdoor decor!]


[h2][u]What's next[/u][/h2]

Next month we'll reveal another Merfolk, showcase automated Ranching devices, the architects desk, and go over the Spooky Festival.


[b]Thanks for reading,[/b]

Stairway Team

notes.title: Summer Update is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/88a291610ee6acde57c115d89facbfbc105f6cb2.jpg[/img]

Hello Islanders, Summer update is finally here! 
We have new festival, new NPCs outfits, combat rework, and more!

[b][h2]Summer Update Changelist[/h2][/b]

[b]Animal Festival[/b]
Join the Animal Festival on Summer 12, in the town center:
[list]
[*] Rodeo Challenge: Test your skills on a mechanical bull!
[*] Chicken Stare-Off: See whose chicken has the strongest stare.
[*] Cow Race: Find out which cow is the fastest in town!
[/list]
[b]NPCs[/b]
Dateables and some townies’ in-game models and portraits now switch to summer outfits during the season. 
Enjoy additional dialogues and new heart events.

[b]New Contents[/b]
[list]
[*] Fire Gate: now open for exploration!
[*] Fire Gate: discover osmium ores, gems, and new monsters.
[*] BOS Hideout: unlockable through story progression.
[*] BOS Hideout: shop for rings and 4 new weapon types.
[*] Combat Rework: standard, unique, and special attacks for each weapon.
[*] Giants Storyline: free the fire giant and embark on a special quest.
[*] Errands: dynamic quests in Town and BOS Hideout.
[*] Traps: craft to passively catch insects and ocean critters.
[*] Scents: consumables to reduce detection by insects, critters, and monsters.
[*] Fish Pond & Insect House: available at the Carpenter for breeding fish and insects.
[*] Ranching: Pig and Quail now available at Jack's Ranch.
[*] Sprinkler Attachments: auto seed/fertilizer can be developed at Ling's Lab starting Summer 8.
[*] Ocean Critters: new species to catch while diving.
[*] Mastery: level cap raised to 9!
[*] Town Rank: increased to Rank C.
[*] Festivals: shops added at various festivals.
[/list]
[b]Improvements/bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced memory usage for smoother gameplay.
[*] Game balance optimizations.
[*] Over 175 community-reported bugs fixed!
[/list]

[b][h2]Kickstarter Rewards[/h2][/b]
For our backers with tiers "Just the Game" and above, you will receive one code to redeem two exclusive outfits. One is a Kickstarter Exclusive "Farmer Outfit" set, and the other is an additional free cosmetic called Pandabacker. Please check your e-mail or Backerkit account. If you're a Backer and didn't receive the key, don't hesitate to contact Support@stairwaygames.com or our CMs on the Discord server.


Thank you,
Stairway Games

Ranching: Pig and Quail now available at Jack's Ranch.
Sprinkler Attachments: auto seed/fertilizer can be developed at Ling's Lab starting Summer 8.
Ocean Critters: new species to catch while diving.
Mastery: level cap raised to 9!
Town Rank: increased to Rank C.
Festivals: shops added at various festivals.

notes.title: April 2023 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the April 2023 Coral Island development update!

Please check out our Steam page to purchase the game and find out more: swg.gg/corstm


This month's dev update is part 2 of our showcase of the upcoming Summer Update. This post will include new ranch animals, revamped combat, sprinkler attachments, and more!


[b]We're planning to release the Summer Update sometime in May 2023.[/b]


[h2][u]New ranch animals[/u][/h2]

Here's a look at the new ranch animals you'll be able to acquire this Summer Update:

[u]Pig[/u]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_238cd181892640449af4f27ccf017e66~mv2.gif[/img]

New barn animal: you can now acquire Pigs at the Ranch. As outdoor explorers with a keen sense of smell, they'll find Truffles when you let them outside.

[u]Quail[/u]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_2361e452c9ad4430af79701170aa1d28~mv2.gif[/img]

New coop animal: you can now acquire the Quail at the Ranch! Quails produce Quail Eggs.

[u]Goat[/u]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_9a0b935f81d54153b0a0e10db5a8732b~mv2.gif[/img]

New barn animal: you can now acquire Goats at the Ranch. Goats will produce fresh Goat Milk, perfect for crafting artisan cheese!


[h2][u]Combat beta overview[/u][/h2]

The revamped combat system includes 4 new weapon types, new monsters, and combat traps. Choose between Swords, Hammers, Shields, and Spears, each bringing a unique gameplay style.

[u]Weapon types[/u]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_2ef504a32ffc429ca8b1403e3a7523aa~mv2.gif[/img]Spear

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_05ebb87104a5452fb492fe33db438807~mv2.gif[/img]Hammer

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_4199e238024844d292471658399d2f76~mv2.gif[/img]Shield

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_c4416e0511d24dc59327e98fb47ef7d6~mv2.gif[/img]Sword

You can acquire weapons from the BOS shop in the forest. Be sure to try all the new weapon types and give us feedback! 

[u]Special attack[/u]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_fa939c5e72a24a278bb504c8832fb0da~mv2.gif[/img]Special Sword

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_71a61535f0b5403498a57346377d3e50~mv2.gif[/img]Special Shield

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_79d086e67b9a46e1b3f80ca8481660cc~mv2.gif[/img]Special Spear

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_426699e9eafd45299b9565a2bac7d63c~mv2.gif[/img]Special Hammer

Each weapon type now comes with a special attack. As you use a weapon to fight enemies, the special attack meter will gradually build until an aura appears. The exception is the spear you can throw at any time. 


[h2][u]Scent & ring mechanics[/u][/h2]

Scents are craftable items you can consume or attach to a trap. While active, scents alter the awareness of certain actors of your presence, making them more or less aware of you. Different scents affect different actors.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_a1ce7dce52c84f23b48ace7b5b53d760~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_873,h_558,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_a1ce7dce52c84f23b48ace7b5b53d760~mv2.png[/img]

Rings are wearable equipment. You can wear up to 2 rings at a time, and they can be found throughout the world or purchased at the BOS shop. When equipped, rings provide a status effect, ranging from increasing tool use speed to gaining energy while doing activities.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_de4da26309274f638d1f428ec2edb42f~mv2.gif[/img]


[h2][u]Fish pond & insect house[/u][/h2]

Introducing Fish ponds and Insect houses, available from the Carpenter's. Breed various species and build a thriving farm with them!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0da5161b8a744ac8a2ff93ec90e46c4b~mv2.gif[/img]Fish pond preview

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ba3e0a30b8f4412a8b3fa30b514e97b6~mv2.gif[/img]Insect house preview


[h2][u]Sprinkler attachments[/u][/h2]

Upgrade your farming with automatic seed and fertilizer dispersal via Sprinkler Attachments. Develop these game-changers at the lab first.

[u]Attachments in action[/u]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_b9374677f1a24d5195f2bd9dde10c0ea~mv2.gif[/img]The auto seed in action

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_7700e53788794a6f8dee7ac11149bfd4~mv2.gif[/img]The auto fertilizer in action

[u]Equipment Development[/u]

As you progress through the game, The Lab will start to offer you the service of developing equipment recipes.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_caaa9605d2da4ac6b9bbfad63a00ee64~mv2.gif[/img]

Besides the sprinkler attachments, a lot more equipment can be developed at the lab.

For the Ranchers, you can look forward to developing the Auto petter, Auto collector, Auto feeder, and Temperature machine.

Then there's the Sturdy Computer, which will allow for online shopping. You can then develop components such as Farm stats, Fishing forecasts, and Catching forecasts for more information.

Other quality-of-life equipment, including the Auto trash collector, Sturdy Music Player, and more, can be developed!


[h2][u]Errands[/u][/h2]

Errands are dynamic quests that spawn on boards throughout Coral Island. Their great for extra coins and a good way to earn more heart points with townies.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_7313b3112d204a28a20686dcac79017c~mv2.gif[/img]You'll see an exclamation mark when errands are available.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ffb91481087343d0818a154fccb8da29~mv2.gif[/img]Cycle between available errands and decide whether to take them on.


[h2][u]Other updates[/u][/h2]

- Reduced memory usage for smoother gameplay.

- Game balance optimizations.

- Over 175 community-reported bugs fixed!

- Cycle through clothing sets directly in your inventory, and name them too!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_5dcf42b0cc204845a6cbbb868e0786e4~mv2.gif[/img]


[h2][u]What's next[/u][/h2]

Next month we'll break down the next major game update, share an updated roadmap, and more with you all!


[b]Thanks for reading,[/b]

Stairway Team

notes.title: March 2023 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the March 2023 Coral Island development update!
Please check out our Steam page to purchase the game and find out more: swg.gg/corstm

This month's dev update is part 1 of our showcase of the upcoming Summer update. This post will highlight summer outfits, the pet day festival, fire gate mining, and more!

[b]We're planning to release the Summer Update sometime in May 2023.[/b]


[h2][u]Summer Outfits[/u][/h2]


Coral Island features seasonal outfits for most of our townies. We're excited to release the second set of seasonal clothing in this upcoming update: Summer outfits! Here's a preview:


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_4d9c9334efed45cb8a850c9c78d3fce7~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_723,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_4d9c9334efed45cb8a850c9c78d3fce7~mv2.png[/img]
[Oh yes he did!]

Townies start the day wearing their [b]seasonal outfits[/b]. We've captured some footage to show this in action!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_18d5fc4d6805460989c7ccc9a2e3dbd6~mv2.gif[/img]
[Aaliyah in her summer outfit]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_956f3c6e34984234999432554a8c15f9~mv2.gif[/img]
[Scott got his glasses on!]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_29023844e411476395c1321b110f48b2~mv2.gif[/img]
[Yuri in Wabanana crop top]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_9be24c9d22e64c69bab0866c14478b95~mv2.gif[/img]
[Wakuu in his summer [i]hair[/i]?]


[h2][u]Pet Festival[/u][/h2]


Another WIP festival will be accessible for the upcoming Summer Update: [b]The Pet Day[/b] Festival. This festival occurs every Summer 12 and can be triggered in town. Don't miss it!


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_849ed80951f44f7396026fb5e2e44be5~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1903,h_1428,al_c,q_90/491ae5_849ed80951f44f7396026fb5e2e44be5~mv2.webp[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_52b5ba7058864f0c8acdf82d70bd0f9e~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1903,h_1428,al_c,q_90/491ae5_52b5ba7058864f0c8acdf82d70bd0f9e~mv2.webp[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_6d9bccad620d47eb8fae90f28dd0401d~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1903,h_1428,al_c,q_90/491ae5_6d9bccad620d47eb8fae90f28dd0401d~mv2.webp[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0cc468ec72294711af1ac29fa424fd90~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1903,h_1428,al_c,q_90/491ae5_0cc468ec72294711af1ac29fa424fd90~mv2.webp[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_e0e28d7116124150a97c844f514ca309~mv2.gif[/img]
[[u]Pet day festival[/u]]

Eventually, you'll be able to participate in four activities at the Pet Day festival: Rodeo, Cow Competition, Chicken Competition, and the main event, the Pet Race. The upcoming Summer update will include the rodeo, cow, and chicken competitions.

[u]Available activities[/u]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_e0e28d7116124150a97c844f514ca309~mv2.gif[/img]
[Rodeo. Stay on for as long as you can!]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_c6b8142b84784b1ea4fabb82f39dc4d2~mv2.gif[/img]
[Cow competition. Get moooving!]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_fcc94392e5d94ea186e7492563170aaf~mv2.gif[/img]
[Chicken competition. Reminds us of a time back in nature.]

[u]Future activities[/u]

Starlet Town has an animal shelter housing over [b]20 adoptable pets[/b]. Once you've adopted a pet, you'll be able to participate in the pet race. Below is a tease at all of the adoptable pets, most of which are designs from our backers!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_1dda3e390d714269ad08faa28f5c400b~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_925,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_1dda3e390d714269ad08faa28f5c400b~mv2.png[/img]
[Best pets in the world!}

[h2][u]Fire Gate Mining[/u][/h2]


The last gate in Starlet Town will become available in the upcoming update. You'll find [b]more gems[/b] and, most importantly, come across [b]osmium ores[/b] in the fire gate. Have a look:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_982962fa6a134cc18eb18d1f130430ec~mv2.gif[/img]
[[u]Osmium ores!][/u]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ec2b156e1a424b8a91245791eb6dee6c~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_694,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_ec2b156e1a424b8a91245791eb6dee6c~mv2.png[/img]
[Sorry Slime but farmer need ores.]


[h2][u]B.O.S Hideout[/u][/h2]

New interior alert! In preparation for the revamped combat experience in the game, we've added a new location called the B.O.S hideout. This is where you'll need to go to progress in combat.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_bbb4299b000945a59ec6a907d7f13290~mv2.gif[/img]
[A great place to meet up with other B.O.S members.]


[h2][u]New Customization[/u][/h2]

More hairstyles, beards, hats and outdoor decor are coming in this update!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_a7445c681d35497f935a1063c4c50228~mv2.gif[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_b983a9dad31a47a2adf74ac517b6aa3b~mv2.gif[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_dbd7be10cd5049d59e312b172fe6d2ff~mv2.gif[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_138af8c2a5014107afae3891b640f060~mv2.gif[/img]


[h2][u]Kickstarter Rewards[/u][/h2]

We wouldn't be where we're at if it weren't for [b]our backers[/b]. In the Summer Update, backers with tiers "Just the Game" and above will receive one code to redeem [b]two exclusive outfits[/b]. One is Kickstarter Exclusive “Farmer Outfit” set, and the other is an additional free cosmetic called Pandabacker. Take a look at the reward below:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ddb053b69d7c4dcbb22e971077aac330~mv2.gif[/img]

[h2][u]Fruit Plants & Ocean Critters[/u][/h2]

More fruit plants and ocean critters have been added to the game. You can purchase the new fruit plant at Sam's General Store and find the new critters while diving in the ocean.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ca88891c7e774e589005dd4afbe6fd92~mv2.gif[/img]
[Dragon fruit, Jack fruit, and Avocado fruit plants!]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_a524605aa49747aab5770b2744b9741e~mv2.gif[/img]
[New critters for you to catch and donate to the museum!]

[h2][u]Insect & critter traps[/u][/h2]

As part of the catching mastery, you'll now unlock traps used to catch insects and critters. You can place these on the ground and in the ocean. There are 4 traps, 2 for insects and 2 for critters. Here's a look at traps in action:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_903751395dc64530b0d91766cab81735~mv2.gif[/img]
[Applying scents to traps will influence what you catch!]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0e3048816b264b2da3e9a1e134d8d206~mv2.gif[/img]
[Traps passively catch insects/critters when placed on ground or ocean beds.]

[h2][u]Sprinkler III[/u][/h2]

You'll be able to reach Mastery level 9 in the upcoming Summer Update. This means access to Sprinkler III. Compared to Sprinkler II, which has a coverage of 5x5 (24 tiles), Sprinkler III covers a 9x9 area (80 tiles).

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_6d7cb1191ce64309a77c7ffc430b9e29~mv2.gif[/img]
[Sprinkler coverage comparison.]

[h2][u]Whats next[/u][/h2]

Next month we'll go over part 2 of the Summer Update and showcase the following:

- New ranch animals
- Scent mechanic
- Ring mechanic
- Combat beta overview
- Fish pond & insect house
- Sprinkler attachments (auto seed and auto fertilizer!)
- Balancing & memory optimization
- Errands

[b]Thanks for reading,[/b]

Stairway Team

notes.title: Spring Update and Coral Island original soundtrack is live!
notes.content:
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/215/304/203ae452319a83c4dd95449767f2bbe2_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1678686994&gif-q=50&q=92&s=06bbe5e412e08bfc3ea3ff1f8a236bc8[/img]

Hello Islanders, Spring update is finally here! We have a few other things as well, like the OST reward.

[b][h2]Spring Update Changelist[/h2][/b]

[b]Tree Planting Festival:[/b]
[list]
[*] Join the tree planting festival every Spring 21. It happens right behind your farm, near the Ranch.
[*] Replant Purwo Woods, an area devasted by illegal logging.
[*] See the trees grow every year until complete restoration in Year 4.
[*] Afterward, the event will turn into something. Replant and find out!
[/list]


[b]NPC’s :[/b]
[list]
[*] All dateables and a few townies will now change into bathing suits when doing most activities on the beach or at the hot springs.
[*] Both the in-game model and portrait changes!
[*] You can increase your heart level until level 5 with all NPC.
[*] Unlock additional dialogue with them.
[*] Unlock newly added heart events with them.
[/list]


[b]New Contents:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can open the Wind Gate now after you've reached level 40 of the Water Gate.
[*] Explore the Wind Gate to mine new ores and gems.
[*] Giants Village is now accessible!
[*] The first part of the Giants storyline is available to play through.
[*] Have dialogues with the Giants and grow your relationships with them.
[*] Enchant your tools with special attributes at the Giant Village.
[*] Fuel enchantments by donating gems, fossils, or artifacts.
[*] Upgrade your house to level 3 for extra rooms and a second floor.
[*] Duck and Sheep can now be purchased from the Ranch.
[*] Sheep produces Wool and can be processed with Loom to Wool Cloth.
[*] Duck produces Duck Eggs, which can be processed with various artisan processors similar to Eggs.
[*] Added artisan machine, Dehydrator: Turns ocean loot into dried goods.
[*] Added resource machine, Solar Panel: Used to produce a battery.
[*] 4 New Fruit Plants: Banana (Spring & Summer), Cocoa (Spring & Summer), Lemon (Fall & Winter), and Rambutan (Fall & Winter).
[*] Large logs spawn daily in the Mid Forest (these drop hardwood!).
[*] 20 New Hairstyle
[*] 71 New Clothing
[*] 4 Beards
[*] 17 New Outdoor Decor
[*] 24 New Indoor Decor
[/list]


[b]Accessibility:[/b]
[list]
[*] Support for Dyslexic Font for Latin characters.
[*] Support for in-game font sizes modifier. You can change the font to be bigger or smaller. We recommend you use the maximum value when playing with Steam Deck!
[*] Support for Color Blindness filter, you can change the in-game filter to help weaknesses in Deuteranopia, Protanopia, or Tritanopia. You can also adjust the filter strength in-game to your liking.
[*] We’ve moved several options related to accessibility into the “Accessibility” tab to make it easier to find.
[/list]


[h2][b]Improvements/bug fixes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added various buff effects when consuming cooked items.
[*] Buffs give special attributes to players for a limited time.
[*] Upgrading to house level 2 now gives the player an oven.
[*] Improved the Journal feature to correctly keep track of everything you’ve captured in the game.
[*] Bug fixes of random crashes for low ram devices.
[*] Re-added Sprinkler II back.
[*] All sprinkler models have been made smaller.
[*] Various 3d model improvements.
[*] Rebalancing various items.
[*] Masteries are being reworked to up to 6 skills for each mastery.
[*] You can now level up until level 8 for each Mastery.
[*] Relationship UI now shows bathing outfits for NPC.
[*] Relationship UI now shows the Giants tab to see relationships with the Giants.
[*] Interacting with tower views across the map now shows you a zoomed-out view of that area.
[*] Play how you want with our new customized Mouse / Keyboard and Controller keybinding.
[/list]

[b][h1]Coral Island Original Soundtrack (OST)[/h1][/b]
Coral Island OST is now available to purchase on Steam! Enjoy more than 100 original soundtracks.
For all backers, please check your email or Backerkit account for your OST reward. You should have received the OST key to redeem. If not, please reach us at support@stairwaygames.com

[h1][b]Bundle Sale is Live on Steam![/b][/h1]
Get Coral Island + Original soundtrack bundle at the link below. It’s on sale!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31132/Coral_Island_OST_Bundle/



[b][h1]FAQ[/h1][/b]

[b]When will Coral Island be available on consoles?[/b]
Coral Island will be available on consoles including Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch after PC's full release. We will announce the date when we have more to share.

[b]I have not received my game key yet![/b]
Please make sure that you ordered Steam as your platform of choice. If you choose Steam as your platform of choice and still don't have the code, you can reach out to our support email at Support@stairwaygames.com

Thank you,
Stairway Games

notes.title: February 2023 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the February 2023 Coral Island development update!

Please check out our Steam page to purchase the game and find out more: swg.gg/corstm


You'll get the final sneak peek at the [b]Spring Update this March[/b]. We highlight new content you can play through, tool enchantments, custom keybindings, and new accessibility options. Scroll to the bottom to check out the complete change list!


[b]The Spring Update will go live in March 2023.[/b]


[h2][u]Giants Storyline[/u][/h2]


Experience the part of the Giants storyline in this upcoming Spring Update. Head to the mines after you've received the Goddess Blessing to kickstart the quest.


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_9f592309e2ca4a56aa083c6b79b8c27d~mv2.gif[/img]
[awwwwwww]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_c755edaa810c4d59ad8e16ab74a7692b~mv2.gif[/img]
[be sure to return to this area once you've freed the first giant]


[h2][u]Tool Enchantments[/u][/h2]


Enchantments apply special effects to your tools and weapons. This feature unlocks as you progress through the game. You'll need [b]gems[/b], [b]artifacts[/b], or [b]fossils[/b] to fuel the enchantments!


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3f80477c2c604e8681b9f2361cbf63fe~mv2.gif[/img]
[select the tool you want to enchant and load it up with fuel!]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_b73b699624df4b65a8ccb042bf95ff4e~mv2.gif[/img]
[a visual indication of an enchantment proccing -- this is not visible during play]


[h2][u]Game Progression[/u][/h2]


Here is a look at other new content you'll be able to play through this Spring Update:


[u]Duck[/u]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_40f5b0f87a034315920228524ba35454~mv2.gif[/img]
New [b]coop[/b] animal: you can now acquire the [b]Duck[/b] at the Ranch! Ducks produce Duck Eggs.

[u]Sheep[/u]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_98b319e802234965a6d8ea887cea56c6~mv2.gif[/img]
New [b]barn[/b] animal: finally, your cows can have new company inside the barn. Acquire the [b]Sheep[/b] at the Ranch. They produce Wool.

[u]Level 3 House[/u]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_890e89ea65bb4bf38ec596bc5811ed20~mv2.gif[/img]
Head to the Carpenters to acquire a level 3 house for even more room!

[u]Large Logs[/u]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_f3c3f82cc73f4c3a9107acb208c2f0e8~mv2.gif[/img]
Large logs now spawn daily in the Mid Forest—these drop [b]hardwood[/b] which you'll need to upgrade your house to level 3.

[u]Mastery skills[/u]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_2bd502e4931d46148c2d2e0f2cb65b15~mv2.gif[/img]
In addition to increasing the mastery level cap to 8, we've simplified the selection of skills. Now you'll earn one skill point for every two levels of mastery you acquire. Decide which skill you want to unlock first!


[h2][u]Custom Key Binding[/u][/h2]


You can now set custom key binds for the mouse/keyboard and controllers.


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_e5cb6e7add774b569051142132693a84~mv2.gif[/img]
[nice feature this is!]


[h2][u]Accessibility Updates[/u][/h2]


We’re proud to showcase a couple of the accessibility features we’ve been hard at work on for Coral Island.


[u]Dyslexic Font[/u]

Thanks to the great folks at Open Dyslexic, we've added a dyslexic font option for all Latin alphabet-based languages, like English.


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_b16ff1c40a9741f0998d5772455b01cb~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_b16ff1c40a9741f0998d5772455b01cb~mv2.png[/img]
[find the dyslexic options under the "Accessibility" tab, a restart is required]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_e4505e78a74a497da1f0335e78330bcf~mv2.gif[/img]
[a look at the dyslexic font in action!]


[u]Colorblind Mode[/u]
We're excited to include several [b]color blind modes[/b] into Coral Island.


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_b47dab4927f242d2b1e38aef7920552b~mv2.gif[/img]
[find the color blind mode options under the "Accessibility" tab.]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_2d035c3b0c594727aa2f244371146ded~mv2.gif[/img]
[a look at the colorblind mode in action!]


[h2][u]Spring Update Changelist[/u][/h2]


[u]Tree Planting Festival:[/u]
- Join the tree planting festival every Spring 21. It happens right behind your farm, near the Ranch.
- Replant Purwo Woods, an area devasted by illegal logging.
- See the trees grow every year until complete restoration in Year 4.
- Afterwards, the event will turn into something. Replant and find out!

[u]NPC’s[/u]
- All [b]dateable[/b] and a few townies will now change into bathing suits when doing most activities on the beach or at the hot springs.
- Both the in-game model and portrait changes!
- You can increase your heart level until level 5 with all NPC.
- Unlock additional dialogue with them.
- Unlock newly added heart events with them.

[u]New Content[/u]
- You can open the Wind Gate now after you've reached level 40 of the Water Gate.
- Explore the [b]Wind Gate[/b] to mine new ores and gems.
- Giants Village is now accessible!
- The first part of the Giants storyline is available to play through.
- Have dialogues with the Giants and grow your relationships with them.
- Enchant your tools with [b]special[/b] attributes at the Giant Village.
- Fuel enchantments by donating gems, fossils, or artifacts.
- Upgrade your house to level 3 for extra rooms and a second floor.
- Duck and Sheep can now be purchased from the Ranch.
- Sheep produces Wool and can be processed with Loom to Wool Cloth.
- Duck produces Duck Egg, which can be processed with various artisan processors similar to Egg. 
- Added artisan machine, Dehydrator: Turns ocean loot into dried goods.
- Added resource machine, [b]Solar Panel[/b]: Used to produce a battery.
- 4 New Fruit Plants: Banana (Spring & Summer), Cocoa (Spring & Summer), Lemon (Fall & Winter), and Rambutan (Fall & Winter).
- Large logs spawn daily in the Mid Forest (these drop hardwood!).
- 20 New Hairstyle
- 71 New Clothing
- 4 Beards
- 17 New Outdoor Decor
- 24 New Indoor Decor

[u]Accessibility:[/u]
- Support for Dyslexic Font for Latin characters.
- Support for in-game font sizes modifier. You can change the font to be bigger or smaller. We recommend you use the maximum value when playing with Steam Deck!
- Support for Color Blindness filter, you can change the in-game filter to help weaknesses in Deuteranopia, Protanopia, or Tritanopia. You can also adjust the filter strength in-game to your liking.
- We’ve moved several options related to accessibility into the “Accessibility” tab to make it easier to find.

[u]Improvements/bug fixes:[/u]
- Added various buff effects when consuming cooked items.
- Buffs give special attributes to players for a limited time.
- Upgrading to house level 2 now gives the player an oven.
- Improved the Journal feature to correctly keep track of everything you’ve captured in the game.
- Bug fixes of random crashes for low ram devices.
- Re-added Sprinkler II back.
- All sprinkler models have been made smaller.
- Various 3d model improvements. 
- Rebalancing various items.
- Masteries are being reworked to up to 6 skills for each mastery.
- You can now level up until level 8 for each Mastery.
- Relationship UI now shows bathing outfits for NPC.
- Relationship UI now shows the Giants tab to see relationships with the Giants.
- Interacting with tower views across the map now show you a zoomed-out view of that area
- Play how you want with our new customized Mouse / Keyboard and Controller keybinding.


[b]Thanks for reading,[/b]

Stairway Team
