notes.title: January 2023 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the January 2023 Coral Island development update!

Please check out our Steam page to purchase the game and find out more: swg.gg/corstm


This month, we'll give you a sneak peek at the upcoming Spring Update, which will feature bathing suits, the tree planting festival, wind gate mining, and more!


[b]We're planning to release the Spring Update sometime in March 2023.[/b]


[h2][u]Bathing Suits[/u][/h2]


Coral Island will feature multiple outfits for a large number of NPCs. We're excited to drop the first batch of outfits for the upcoming spring update: bathing suits! Here's a sneak peek of what it will look like.


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_fefec745593f437c896fc90befe3c86e~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_800,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_fefec745593f437c896fc90befe3c86e~mv2.png[/img]
[bathing suits, coming in hot!]

For some outfits, like [b]seasonal clothing[/b], NPCs start the day wearing them. For outfits like bathing suits, they will change into [b]bathing suits[/b] at some point during the day. You can see it in action here:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_64b1cffd9b434444b977fe1a6d05d4c7~mv2.gif[/img]
[this may look familiar if you've ever been obsessed with a certain simulation game...]

To best showcase the new bathing suits, we've added a bunch of [b]new NPC schedules[/b]. Whether its downtime at the beach or a nice bath at the hot spring (once you've opened it), there are a lot of new routines for you to discover:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_dbf2d9a6ad89450aa54d9b41a501cba5~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_612,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_dbf2d9a6ad89450aa54d9b41a501cba5~mv2.png[/img]
[volleyball, a classic beach activity]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_fb5c4124a7f84e73b00c6ddff29a0ec2~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_612,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_fb5c4124a7f84e73b00c6ddff29a0ec2~mv2.png[/img]
[don't forget to wear your sunscreen!]


[h2][u]Tree Planting Festival[/u][/h2]

Another WIP festival will be accessible for the upcoming Spring Update: [b]The Tree Planting Festival[/b]. The festival takes place every Spring 21 and can be triggered in the forest, right behind your farm. Don't miss it!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d939c69067154415af9d3ab9896e10a6~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_612,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_d939c69067154415af9d3ab9896e10a6~mv2.png[/img]
[festival area shot]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_37166c4e59c744a1bf2bd33d2fc6d160~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_833,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_37166c4e59c744a1bf2bd33d2fc6d160~mv2.png[/img]
[everyone is pumped up!]


[h2][u]Wind Gate Mining[/u][/h2]

The wind gate will become available in the upcoming update. You'll find [b]more gems[/b] and, most importantly, come across [b]gold ores[/b] in this mining gate. Have a look:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_a3f8275d49b34484a852bedb29ceacb6~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_833,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_a3f8275d49b34484a852bedb29ceacb6~mv2.png[/img]
[wind gate mine shot 1]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_26fbc8dbd51c40dc9aae66b5e3f67f8a~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_833,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/491ae5_26fbc8dbd51c40dc9aae66b5e3f67f8a~mv2.png[/img]
[wind gate mine shot 2]

[h2][u]New Mine Monsters[/u][/h2]

You will encounter some [b]new monsters[/b] if you visit the mines. Please note that they are still WIP!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_c601f7fe82eb4cc29b75a584a6d37482~mv2.gif[/img]
[meet new slime]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_94baea4be3bd4f82897edb4c64120e3b~mv2.gif[/img]
[meet tuku-tuku]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_9fee0dff214d4f4295b1c8365e1b36d7~mv2.gif[/img]
[meet skully]


[h2][u]Beards[/u][/h2]

At long last, [b]beards![/b] A new customization option: beards are now available!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_4cf08d745ff3430fa4dd7e0a78c801b7~mv2.gif[/img]
[yay!]


[b]Thanks for reading,[/b]

Stairway Team

notes.title: Feedback Update and Controller Support are now live!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/P1YjxyJ/Roadmap-Art-Feedback-Update.jpg[/img]

Hello Islanders, the first of many updates has arrived.
We compiled all your feedback and added features that will improve Coral Island. Thank you all for your support!
Here are the things we're adding to the game for the "Feedback Update":

[h2][b]Controller Support:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] The game will now detect if the player is plugging an Xbox controller and automatically switch all button prompts into controller mode when the player starts using the controller.
[*] Options screen will now display two new tabs, and the player will now be able to review all the action lists with its input. (Rebinding input will be supported in the next update)
[/list]


[h2][b]Implemented Player Feedback/Suggestions:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Craft from anywhere. Stored resources are now accessible from anywhere when you craft.
[*] Hold the RMB over a tile to display more information about it, i.e., the planted crop and the number of days left until harvest
[*] "Donated" icon so you can see if you've donated an item to the Museum or not
[*] "Offering" icon added so you can see if an item can be offered to the Goddess
[*] Improved Interactions on farm buildings. It should now be easier to enter/leave farm buildings
[*] Added a button on the relationship tab where you can click to "find" where an NPC is currently on the map (currently not functioning on the controller)
[*] Added a comprehensive sorting feature inside the relationship tab. You can now sort by certain criteria such as heart level, eligible partners, upcoming birthdays, and more
[*] Waiting time for fish to bite has been reduced
[*] Added ability to resize mouse cursor size
[*] Added option to rescale HUD elements like Gameplay HUD and Hotbar.
[*] Added rope as a possible rare spawned item in the mines to make going through a little easier
[*] Reduced the price of moving buildings down from 2000c to 300c
[*] Simplified the flow of acquiring hay. Hay can now be acquired by destroying weeds and grass. For grass, the season that you destroy it will influence the chance of finding hay
[*] Made the mysterious letter date riddle more obvious
[*] Pressing the middle mouse button on a stack of items in a storage container will automatically move them to the next available spot inside the player inventory
[*] Improved sorting option inside chests
[*] Add a sort button for the backpack. Press "x" on KB/M to sort by category
[*] Added option to display time in AM/PM. This is currently limited to the gameplay hud clock. Time in other areas of the game is still displayed in 24 hours
[*] Added option to zoom in on the camera a bit more
[*] Buffed the price of crop slightly
[*] Rebalanced artisan goods processing time and increased the price of artisan goods
[*] Decorative calendars that are placed inside the house are functional yet still buggy.
[*] Hot pepper can now be placed into Mason Jars
[*] Option to match hair color and eyebrow color
[*] When customizing colors in character customization, the currently selected color will be used as the starting point inside the color wheel
[*] Added map markers in the game for festivals to help you find where they are located
[*] Added hair physics to various player character hair
[*] Improve the behavior of spawned wildlife
[*] The two gift limit per week now excludes birthday gifts
[*] Nerfed how often legendary fish can be caught, i.e. Great White Shark
[*] Added storage component to dressers. You can now store clothes inside them and preview outfits. Currently only works on one dresser
[*] Tweaked the logic for grass spread. It will no longer destroy crops by creeping over a fence
[*] Added coffers and geodes as possible spawn chance when fishing in various areas
[*] Time now moves twice as slow when inside the Museum, so you can enjoy what you've collected without feeling rushed
[*] You can now place chests inside your home
[*] TV shows will disappear the day after you've viewed their content. Now you won't mistakenly see the same show twice (unless there aren't any new shows left)
[*] Increase the chance for rock domino to occur
[*] Rebalance the requirements for explosive
[*] Removed the gap between the coop/barn and fences. Animals will no longer slip through
[*] Improved the spawning logic for fish. There should now be more variety in terms of how they spawn
[*] Made Okra behave as it does in real life, now continues bearing crop after harvest
[*] Added text to make clear which quests are not completable and or are still a work in progress
[*] Nonfunctioning Festivals will no longer spawn. The player will also no longer receive mail about them
[*] Added option to remove the "low stamina" screen effect inside the in-game settings.
[*] Reduced the chance for crops to get destroyed during stormy weather.
[/list]


[h2][b]New Cosmetics:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] 20 New Hairstyle
[*] 61 New Clothing
[*] 17 New Outdoor Decor
[*] 24 New Indoor Decor
[/list]


[h2][b]New Features:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Museum donation UI
[*] Lab fossil process UI
[*] Improved offering UI
[*] Festival pamphlet UI (open to see where the main event and minigames are located)
[*] Soft bristle brush now allows fossils and torn pages to drop
[*] Library book UI 
[*] Damaged books now spawn and can be accessed in the library
[*] Museum reward mechanics added
[*] Festival rewards were added for various minigames
[*] Added four fruit plants into the game: rambutan, banana, avocado, and dragon fruit
[*] Added option to view farm from bird's eye view, press P inside the farm area to enter/exit this mode. Toggle the UI by pressing T
[*] Added ability to delete save (USE WITH CAUTION)
[*] Cows will now display all possible interaction options for that day, i.e., heart and milk icons will show when the animal can be petted and milked/sheared
[/list]


[h2][b]Improvements/bug fixes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated all tool models. They appear like the icons and will reflect the current quality
[*] Add quality stars to upgraded Produce from the lab, i.e., seedbags and seedlings
[*] Improved tools use animation. Previously tools disappeared too soon on use
[*] Various typos and grammar have been fixed
[*] Time no longer runs when filling out the feedback form
[*] Ore veins in watergate now drop silver ore
[*] Increased the time it takes for baby animals to become adults
[*] Fixed various clothing-related bugs like the incorrect skin color carrying over after shopping
[*] Simplified shopping for cooking utensils. All utensils are now always available at the socket & pan. The featured utensil on the TV show is discounted for the week
[*] Enabled option to donate to Cherry Blossom Potluck
[*] Increase the price of various clothing and furniture
[*] Secret forest shop items and clothing are now functional
[*] Fish bait is now craftable and functional
[*] Updated various UI button prompts for better readability
[*] Fixed overly dark shadows on farm animals
[*] Improved layout of various UI and added cool transition animation
[*] Pressing E and Space during dialogue will now fast-forward dialogue
[*] Improve the reward you get for donating 50 items to the Museum
[*] Added confirmation prompt when leaving mines/diving through the rope and anchor
[*] Added fast travel to Hotspring
[/list]


Thank you,
Stairway Games

notes.title: Steam Cloud Saves now enabled.
notes.content:
Hi Islanders, Good news!

Steam Cloud Saves now enabled. All your save files will sync across devices if you're using the same steam account.


[b]What do I have to do to enable it?[/b]
Nothing, Steam Cloud should be turned on by default on all Steam clients.

[b]How do I know if it's already working?[/b]
Look for Cloud Status "Up to Date" Icon next to the Big Green Play button. If it's "Up to Date," you're good to go. If it still doesn't show the Cloud Status icon, please check the following:
1. From the top menu of the Steam client, select Steam > Settings
2. From the left-hand menu, select Cloud.
3. Make sure Enable Steam Cloud synchronization for applications that support is turned on.

[b]Any potential problems?[/b]
If you've played Coral Island on two devices using the same Steam account, there is a possibility of a one-time Save file conflict; please pay attention to keep the one you want.

notes.title: June 2022 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the June 2022 Coral Island development update!

Please check out our Steam page to wishlist the game and find out more: swg.gg/corstm

This month, we look at mouse-based controls, the Hotspring, more updated NPC models, and more!


[b]Alpha v0.09 will launch on July 11 @ 11:59PM PDT.[/b]


[h2][u]Mouse based controls[/u][/h2]


You asked, and we listened. By default, you now use your mouse to determine which tile you to hit. We're very pleased with how this turned out.


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_89eac3f6572041b28e8d343f74ff570b~mv2.gif[/img]

We're also still on track to release the controller support and look forward to receiving feedback from Alpha players.


[h2][u]The Hotspring[/u][/h2]

Ah, the Hotspring, a place to relax and unwind. When functional, pay a visit and soak yourself in the warm water to recover some stamina!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_38fc362cd8fa4ba8a91a4e61eeb84b76~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_90/491ae5_38fc362cd8fa4ba8a91a4e61eeb84b76~mv2.webp[/img]

[what happened to the Hotspring?]


[h2][u]Updated NPC models[/u][/h2]

Check out the upgraded models for Dippa, Zarah, Frank, and Yuri!

[Dippa usually spends their day looking for inspiration and painting around the island. Luke's store sells their paintings! Check often!]

[correction from last month, who doesn't love a good A pose]


[h2][u]Furniture store UI[/u][/h2]

Check out the furniture store UI. We've spent a lot of time making sure the shopping experience is frictionless. This is especially important given the large number of items you can purchase to decorate your farm and house with.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_663be4cbd5be48028591f64f4e55c90d~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_90/491ae5_663be4cbd5be48028591f64f4e55c90d~mv2.webp[/img]

You can shop by looking at styles or selecting the catalogue and view items by category. Let us know what you think!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_34975bc46c5f4f65b06bffb9daf5970f~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_2560,h_1440,al_c,q_90/491ae5_34975bc46c5f4f65b06bffb9daf5970f~mv2.webp[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_52d303caee704194b4202d883d8b117f~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_2560,h_1440,al_c,q_90/491ae5_52d303caee704194b4202d883d8b117f~mv2.webp[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_bb30f59b1293460bb5471c22fc54a5d2~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_2560,h_1440,al_c,q_90/491ae5_bb30f59b1293460bb5471c22fc54a5d2~mv2.webp[/img]


[h2][u]Future blog posts and minimizing spoilers[/u][/h2]

For this month, we had originally planned to showcase revamped diving and reveal more interior locations. To make sure you have the best experience playing Coral Island for the first time when it launches into Early Access, we've decided to hold off on doing this.

For Alpha players, note that for the Alpha 0.09 update, we've unlocked all interior locations and most of the newly revamped diving will be accessible too. Looking forward to getting feedback!


[h2][u]Cat[/u][/h2]

Mood.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_5851912679c849e9bd0a058bffb290d5~mv2.gif[/img]

[h2][u]What's next?[/u][/h2]

We will resume the monthly dev blog in September. Between July and August, all hands will be on deck finalizing the Early Access game content, polishing assets, and optimizing the game performance.

[b]Thanks for reading,[/b]

Stairway Team

notes.title: May 2022 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the May 2022 Coral Island development update!

Please check out our Steam page to wishlist the game and find out more: swg.gg/corstm

This month, we tease the diving revamp, look at the furniture store, and showcase some updated NPC models!


[b]Alpha v0.09 will launch on July 11 @ 11:59PM PDT.[/b]


[h2][u]Revamped diving tease[/u][/h2]


Diving is going through a major rework. Unfortunately, we're still finalizing things, so we can only share what's confirmed to stay today.


We're adding a bunch of underwater sea-creature NPCs you'll come across when diving. You'll need to bribe some of these NPCs, like [b]Grantle[/b] below, to gain access to more diving areas.


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_4e57b7ed2b034f35974614cc3e9afdc9~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_95/491ae5_4e57b7ed2b034f35974614cc3e9afdc9~mv2.webp[/img]

Grantle is part of a squad of turtles that roam the 10m depths of the ocean. Check out Grantle's portrait!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_545c8e01ea454ae6ab8bcc1754f0bbcb~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_925,h_1192,al_c,q_90/491ae5_545c8e01ea454ae6ab8bcc1754f0bbcb~mv2.webp[/img]

[Meet Grantle! a.k.a Grandpa Turtle]


The diving maps are being combined to make one, big sprawling open world. We've added a pressure meter to help communicate the sense of diving deeper into the ocean.

You'll need to upgrade your suit to reach deeper diving depths.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_35b6310f91fe4993a59bb10b8e697e5b~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_723,h_713,al_c,q_95/491ae5_35b6310f91fe4993a59bb10b8e697e5b~mv2.webp[/img]

[As you go deeper into the ocean, the pressure will increase]


[h2][u]Furniture store part 1 [/u][/h2]

This month, we're revealing both the exterior and interior of the furniture store! 


There are two ways to purchase items: the [b]catalog and direct display purchase.[/b] The catalog allows you to access all items the store has unlocked. Items purchased from here will be delivered the following day.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_e37a0ff85ff54613a8afc192a31d3254~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_694,al_c,q_95/491ae5_e37a0ff85ff54613a8afc192a31d3254~mv2.webp[/img]

[Dinda and Joko own the furniture store in town]

With direct display purchase, you'll be able to snag any of the 7 display items at a small discount. Don't dilly dally though, because display items are cycled every week.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_9cbc1862e859427d9f79327dcab22f6f~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_513,al_c,q_95/491ae5_9cbc1862e859427d9f79327dcab22f6f~mv2.webp[/img]

[Dinda and Joko's relatives help run the furniture store]

notes.title: April 2022 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the April 2022 Coral Island development update!

Please check out our Steam page to wishlist the game and find out more: swg.gg/corstm

This month, we'll go over Mount riding, New decor mode UI, and Combat!


[b]Alpha v0.08 will launch on May 9 @ 11:59PM PDT.[/b]


[h2][u]Mount Riding[/u][/h2]

A trusty steed awaits you on Coral Island. To acquire one, you'll first need to build a stable on your farm. Some perks include increased movement speed and, most importantly,  trotting into town with style.


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_49c5db1744af45c1bd328862a924c1d2~mv2.gif[/img]

[yeeehaaaaw]

While on your horse, you'll still be able to chat with folks in town. Don't think about entering stores though!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_82675c9c04d1452d8002a22757a96354~mv2.gif[/img]

[yes, my name is Player, Player Player]


[h2][u]Movement Mechanics[/u][/h2]

[u]Dashing[/u]

We've added dashing to the game! It makes exploring the island more enjoyable, but it's also an essential move-set for combat, allowing you to dodge enemies.


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d35f88ee4a3b46589b66dfd7c5edfb3c~mv2.gif[/img]

[press space bar to dash]

[u]Vaulting[/u]

We've gone and done it. Listened to and reviewed the feedback from alpha players and voila! Vaulting is [b]officially[/b] in the game!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_a9c83f58dc274387bdca1ed61b4c1d5f~mv2.gif[/img]

[vaulting feels good y'all, press space near a fence to vault over it]


[h2][u]New decor mode UI[/u][/h2]

We're in the process of improving the interior decor UI. We added [b]categories[/b] so you can find the items you're looking for more easily. There's also an added benefit: your house will now have storage space for furniture after upgrading it!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_23caf316796b4f8ca95c28f4464b5f09~mv2.gif[/img]

[Still a WIP!]

There will be A LOT of decorations for you to choose from on Coral Island. Take a look at some WIP assets below!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ba5a1a573f314cd8951cc7c30ca2961e~mv2.gif[/img]

[what style do you want to see in the game?]


[h2][u]Combat[/u][/h2]

Our first iteration of combat will be available to test out in the upcoming Alpha update.
 
Fleshing out combat will be next, so we're looking forward to the feedback from the community, what feels good, what needs improving, ideas, thoughts, all of it! We'll do a deep dive into combat in a future update.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_abc5704d7902445eb5b21fb2a54834ac~mv2.gif[/img]

[attack, block, stagger, dash - these are essentials for combat]


By the way, crates in the mine? You can now break those!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_c5d57782cef849428dafb9ab254ea429~mv2.gif[/img]

[oddly satisfying to break crates]


[h2][u]Other updates[/u][/h2]

[b]For 0.08:[/b]


- All seasons unlocked, available to test (assets are WIP)
- Fight a boss in the earth gate (WIP)
- Water gate now accessible (early WIP)
- Revamped questing and progression
- Greenhouse is now accessible to test (WIP)
- Furniture store accessible (WIP)
- Town board requests are testable (WIP)
- Diving continues to be reworked
- Multiplayer?! (experimental, host/join, very buggy)
- Cherry Blossom minigames added (Balap Karung and Apple Bobbing)
- Place objects (like chest) almost anywhere on your farm
- A glimpse at one of the new NPCs
- Ton's of environment/asset updates


[h2][u]What's next?[/u][/h2]

Next month, we'll provide updates on the following:

- Revamped diving (we needed more time on this)
- Furniture store
- Combat mastery


[b]Thanks for reading,[/b]

Stairway Team

notes.title: February 2022 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the February 2022 Coral Island development update!

Please check out our Steam page to wishlist the game and find out more: swg.gg/corstm

This month, we'll go over the museum, mastery, strafing, and more!


[b]Alpha v0.07 will launch on March 7 @ 11:59PM PDT.[/b]


[h2][u]Happy Valentines[/u][/h2]

Happy Valentine's from the Stairway team! More importantly, who would be your Coral Island valentine?


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_061be43362314f54b44d70260f14d488~mv2.jpg[/img]

[Rafael playing 4d chess]

[h2][u]Renovated Museum[/u][/h2]

A full-fledged museum can be completed in Starlet Town. It features a section for artifacts, gems, insects, fish, and fossils. Without spoiling too much, here's a glimpse of several areas inside the museum:


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_1535198267ee4f9f86cffc42cc66b120~mv2.gif[/img]

[artifacts are grouped and displayed based on where you find them]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_a44cb1f2b41240d5a4aa667534900406~mv2.gif[/img]

[donations to the museum will increase the towns rank!]

[h2][u]Player Strafing Unlocked[/u][/h2]

One recurring feedback we've received during Alpha is improving the farming controls. We're excited for you to try out the strafing mechanic in-game. To strafe, hold "ctrl" while the hotbar is actively selecting a tool - it's that simple. 


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_fc16b288fb014d7ebbc73f2e67091a6e~mv2.gif[/img]

[movement speed is reduced while strafing for finer control]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_77354a2e73e64dd8a7229714135ad4e1~mv2.gif[/img]

[aiming for tiles definitely feels more precise while strafing]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_f704d8c5dee24cc9aac286e2208d0e6a~mv2.gif[/img]

[plus, we unlocked an unintended feature, the moonwalk!]

We realize a good portion of Alpha players want mouse-based controls. Although we don't have anything to share on that today, please know we'll try our best to implement it into the game.


[h2][u]Mastery Skills Revamped[/u][/h2]

We've revamped a significant portion of the mastery skills. Now there are a total of 15 levels and skills you can acquire for each mastery. We'll look forward to hearing feedback from Alpha players on this!


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d0a66be7e0044eeda63a2d704c4c2b2d~mv2.gif[/img]

[please excuse the placeholder UI]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_10bfb4a7622c427f9b45e2d422711a42~mv2.gif[/img]

[The Rock Domino's skill is a popular choice internally]


[h2][u]Revamped Interiors & Exteriors[/u][/h2]

This month, we're teasing Jim's house and just a couple of the many new shortcuts that have been added to the map.


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ec97048bad4549c2adb8237c7f9ec001~mv2.png[/img]

[Jim's house is now accessible to Alpha players]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_00d075d401e74e3cba3d1f249192b05d~mv2.png[/img]

[a shortcut has been added connecting the Observatory and Woodlands]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_bcb5be0a67524cb3b2ff3f0f4fc8dd07~mv2.png[/img]

[a shortcut has been added connecting the mid forest and rice paddy terrace]


[h2][u]Mount Riding Teaser[/u][/h2]

A look at what developing new features looks like.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_bc622a5633b4470f94307117eb4ad360~mv2.gif[/img]

[if one must fall through the ground, it should be done in style]


[h2][u]Fanart Contest Winners[/u][/h2]

Congratulations to all winners:
@greifate  (Twitter)
Tylendiel#5875 (Discord)
goompher#9124 (Discord)
@syphos.art (IG)
@pinkielartsy (IG)

Last image credit: SDAX!


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_9f84e777068647e9ac522fb75144a4eb~mv2.png[/img]

[goompher#9124 (Discord)]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_7d0b2fc8f3f446cf803b6bef6c514e44~mv2.jpg[/img]

[syphos.art (IG)]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3e0bf46e51f346e6bf70c0b8e680853c~mv2.jpg[/img]

[Tylendiel#5875 (Discord)]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_4c65f3a27f3c4f91a82b9f164227893d~mv2.jpg[/img]

[greifate (Twitter)]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_692713d7d9964948bc8171591be55649~mv2.jpg[/img]

[pinkielartsy (IG)]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_88bbc1e048154624a29543252c1cf058~mv2.jpg[/img]

[Honorable mention for making us laugh, SDAX!]


[h2][u]Development Timeline Update[/u][/h2]

We really appreciate your patience in waiting for Coral Island. Development is making a good pace towards the Early Access release. Below you'll find the high-level features we want to knock out before we do a polish pass and eventually release the game.


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_f1e6563eabb04058894243232afca234~mv2.png[/img]


[h2][u]What's next?[/u][/h2]

Next month, we'll provide updates on the following:

- Heritage overview
- Player clothing overview
- Updates to character customization
- Refreshed 10m diving map
- And more


[b]Thanks for reading,[/b]

Stairway Team

notes.title: January 2022 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the January 2022 Coral Island development update!

Please check out our Steam page to wishlist the game and find out more: swg.gg/corstm


This month, we'll go over fences, outdoor decor, and meet the C.I.C!


[b]Alpha v0.07 will launch on March 7 @ 11:59PM PDT.[/b]


[h2][u]Happy New Year (again!)[/u][/h2]

Happy lunar new year to those who celebrate!


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_f3e713cba4804ea7a6822de320f10d59~mv2.jpg[/img]

[h2][u]Fences, Gates & Arches[/u][/h2]

Take a look at how fences, gates, and arches will work in the game!


[h3][u]Fences[/u][/h3]

Placing fences is super easy. Select the fence item on your hotbar, find an empty spot on your farmland and plot it down.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_43143ab2ce6a4b088a739d1a7225a727~mv2.png[/img]

There are [b]three different styles[/b] for how fences connect. We have the following from left to right: post on every tile fence, homogenous fence, and corner post fence.


[h3][u]Gates[/u][/h3]

Now that you've fenced an area, we need a way to get in and out. To place gates, find an empty spot between two fences, and place it. Voila, you now have a gate!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_97f4a0379316496e99fae932d884f178~mv2.gif[/img]

Good news, all styles of gates will work with any fence style. 


[h3][u]Arches[/u][/h3]

Complete your decoration with arches! You'll be able to rotate them in 4 directions and place them anywhere on the tillable ground.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_597f426f91e14fe38277d9c3cc9fb67c~mv2.png[/img]

We're still developing the feature, but you'll be able to place half arches and make double-wide ones too. For a sneak peek of this, be sure to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/stairway]Discord here[/url].


[h3][u]Community vote: add fence vaulting, or not[/u][/h3]

Last but not least, we're looking for feedback from the community. Do you want us to explore [b]fence vaulting[/b] for the game? Please let us know your thoughts!


[h2][u]Outdoor Decor[/u][/h2]

We've been hard at work adding a variety of styles for your outdoor decoration needs.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_351604c23b614fe688d5e1c6c392d10d~mv2.png[/img]

Here's a sneak peek at the [b]Mountain Cabin[/b] Outdoor Props. Let us know what other styles you want to see in the game!


[h2][u]Meet the C.I.C (Coral Island Current)[/u][/h2]

The Coral Island current is an underwater highway transporting various things to and from different parts of the ocean. It's located on the [b]West[/b] side of the island.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_960c215ba6c44a74b979173b516f48d5~mv2.gif[/img]

[where's all the fish...?]


[h2][u]Fanart Contest: Valentines in Coral Island[/u][/h2]

Win a chance for your character's hair design to be featured in the game!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_7c3ba95b4c954a59ab9926f79ccac2b2~mv2.jpg[/img]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_1a928700dc7a4375a8e36f26754d9295~mv2.jpg[/img]


[h2][u]What's next?[/u][/h2]

For Alpha v0.07, we've got the following planned: 

- Renovated museum
- Heritage implemented (temple offerings)
- More interiors and exteriors
- Refreshed 10m diving maps
- Rebalanced mastery progressions
- And more!


[b]Thanks for reading,[/b]

Stairway Team

tags.feature: Take a look at how fences, gates, and arches will work in the game!
Placing fences is super easy. Select the fence item on your hotbar, find an empty spot on your farmland and plot it down.
There are three different styles for how fences connect. We have the following from left to right: post on every tile fence, homogenous fence, and corner post fence.
To place gates, find an empty spot between two fences, and place it. Voila, you now have a gate!
Good news, all styles of gates will work with any fence style.
Complete your decoration with arches! You'll be able to rotate them in 4 directions and place them anywhere on the tillable ground.
We're still developing the feature, but you'll be able to place half arches and make double-wide ones too.
We've been hard at work adding a variety of styles for your outdoor decoration needs.
Here's a sneak peek at the Mountain Cabin Outdoor Props.

It's located on the West side of the island.

notes.title: December 2021 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the December 2021 Coral Island development update!

Please check out our Steam page to wishlist the game and find out more: swg.gg/corstm


This month, we'll go over the highlights of Alpha v0.06. Take a look at Giants gameplay and how Town Rank will work in the game. 


[b]Alpha v0.06 will launch on January 10 @ 11:59PM PDT.[/b]


[h2][u]Happy Holidays[/u][/h2]

Happy holidays from everyone at Stairway! Here's to a great 2022.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_97b81d5ef32b40138bd73a597079beac~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_925,h_1106,al_c,q_90/491ae5_97b81d5ef32b40138bd73a597079beac~mv2.webp[/img]

[h2][u]HD Wallpaper for Backers[/u][/h2]

We'll be sending HD/4k versions of this wallpaper early next year, and it will come in both horizontal and vertical orientations. Thank you to all backers. We hope you like it!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_4cada23810f9459381ecbb516d30f408~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_90/491ae5_4cada23810f9459381ecbb516d30f408~mv2.webp[/img]
[what's the first thing you noticed?]

[h2][u]Giants Gameplay Prototype[/u][/h2]

At long last, we're ready to talk about Giants! 


Giants are farm helpers that you'll unlock as you progress through the game. By deciding which totems to craft and where to place them, you have ultimate control over the type of help you get on your farm.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_548ae7a6e9e44e808a5db4ec89c0a81d~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_2992,h_1683,al_c,q_95/491ae5_548ae7a6e9e44e808a5db4ec89c0a81d~mv2.webp[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_92e9cfad7cbb4f219f4ca5ee9fb4e09e~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_2994,h_1683,al_c,q_95/491ae5_92e9cfad7cbb4f219f4ca5ee9fb4e09e~mv2.webp[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_596e6a4309db486ba916c36f3d725f9d~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_2991,h_1683,al_c,q_95/491ae5_596e6a4309db486ba916c36f3d725f9d~mv2.webp[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_dc3661319e5b4aa1bc25a07fb49931b8~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_2991,h_1683,al_c,q_95/491ae5_dc3661319e5b4aa1bc25a07fb49931b8~mv2.webp[/img]
[craft and place totems to get some help on your farm!]

There are three types of craftable totems: water, harvest, and animal totems. Today we're going to take a look at the Water and Harvest totem.


[h3][u]Water Totem[/u][/h3]

Place Water Totems to get help watering tilled soil. Please note, Alpha players that the Water Totem will replace any previously placed Sprinklers on your farm.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_dc3661319e5b4aa1bc25a07fb49931b8~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_95/491ae5_dc3661319e5b4aa1bc25a07fb49931b8~mv2.webp[/img]

Now, for a look at the water totem in action:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_400eee65981145b883fc87f9622236f6~mv2.gif[/img]

 [Totems activate when a Giant is about to work its coverage area]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_2c260ae3ac91408fa0aa030ade325b54~mv2.gif[/img]

[who doesn't get happy when their work is done for the day]

[h3][u]Gather Totem[/u][/h3]

Place Gather Totems to get help gather items on your farm. They come in handy to harvest crops and collect items from processing and artisan equipment.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_bf059f9c344146288789910a062436d3~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_95/491ae5_bf059f9c344146288789910a062436d3~mv2.webp[/img]

Now, for a look at the Gather Totem in action:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_14a6997bc1d5468c8b2db4c1836ee6a4~mv2.gif[/img]

[REDACTED is skilled at Gathering]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_6593887fd3aa4143ba99b50b02ff8a11~mv2.gif[/img]
[It's not all work and no play for the Giants. Or err... nap time]

[h3][u]Collecting Gathered Items[/u][/h3]

The Giants will place gathered items inside a plant pouch, and it's conveniently located to the left of your house. 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_54eaef0dc4a048da85d630d22b62aec9~mv2.gif[/img]

[worth checking the plant pouch now and then...]


[h3][u]The Three Giants[/u][/h3]

Although each Giant can work on all farm tasks, they excel at one thing. To unleash the full potential of a particular farm task, you'll need to unlock higher grade totems and develop your relationship with the Giants.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_93fa5bcdc29248e99e2d2a5aa9b12647~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_816,h_622,al_c,lg_1,q_95/491ae5_93fa5bcdc29248e99e2d2a5aa9b12647~mv2.webp[/img]

[h2][u]Town Rank[/u][/h2]

The residents of Coral Island want to improve the town, for good reason! 

The town rank comprises four key components: Heritage, Fame, Museum, and Ocean. We've added a special tab in the UI to keep tabs on your progress and figure out ways to earn points. 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_dd1369aeb8814d748d62c08f4fb08bea~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_95/491ae5_dd1369aeb8814d748d62c08f4fb08bea~mv2.webp[/img]
[WIP of Town Rank UI]

As you increase the town's rank, shops will have an easier time sourcing items, which means new things for you to buy. And well, who knows what other shops you'll attract to town.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ac01a4ed4bc947d5a8f286325e4cbb6d~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_95/491ae5_ac01a4ed4bc947d5a8f286325e4cbb6d~mv2.webp[/img][mock up of store selling new items after town rank increases]

The town hall houses a monitor that tracks your progress toward increasing the town rank.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d8648ba8e16a48a18a8935c5b16ca162~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_95/491ae5_d8648ba8e16a48a18a8935c5b16ca162~mv2.webp[/img]
[that's one big monitor]


[h2][u]Other updates[/u][/h2]

For 0.06:

- Q&A system with NPC testable with Yuri, more information available in Discord
- Several map tweaks have been made
- Opened up the blocked path on Hillside
- Functioning gates for fences
- New buildings on the map?
- Manual cooking!
- Cherry Blossom main festival objective implemented
- New interior music, check it out
- Various bug fixes and optimizations

[h2][u]What's next?[/u][/h2]

For Alpha v0.07, we've got the following planned: 

- Renovated museum
- Heritage implemented (temple offerings)
- More interiors and exteriors
- Refreshed 10m diving maps
- Rebalanced mastery progressions
- And more!

Changes for 2022:

- We're increasing the time between Alpha updates from 1 month to 2 months. For example, Alpha 0.07 will launch in March 2022
- We will continue posting dev updates every month




[b]Thanks for reading,[/b]

Stairway Team

notes.title: November 2021 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the November 2021 Coral Island development update!

This month, we'll go over the highlights of Alpha v0.05. 

[b]Alpha v0.05 will launch on November 30 @ 11:59PM PDT.[/b]


[h2][u]We're Grateful[/u][/h2]

Everyone at Stairway has a lot to be thankful for this year. Happy Thanksgiving, everyone!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0c980d5782d24012a48c195d927a48c9~mv2.jpg[/img]


[h2][u]Cherry Blossom Festival[/u][/h2]

We've completed most of the assets for the Cherry Blossom festival. To avoid spoilers, we'll only be showing the entrance and lake area:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_939a15b9c96b42ac9aadfd62ded51803~mv2.png[/img]

Below, the decorated lake and a sneak peek at the Cherry Blossom festival music!

[previewyoutube=b7NhNts_Dt0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]



[h2][u]Festival Day Decoration[/u][/h2]

Themed umbul-umbul (penjor) are displayed around Coral Island on festival day. The goal is twofold: communicate that it's festival day and help guide players to the festival area.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_1184450aab7644908ebb4e06c662effd~mv2.jpg[/img]

Umbul-umbuls will be decorated differently based on what festival is being held:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_89a5d429fabb476599b15dbc28934542~mv2.jpg[/img]

[hmm, mooncake!]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d5594e398a2e406b865bc920b5118323~mv2.gif[/img]

[an early in-game look what the umbul-umbul will look like]


[h2][u]Fast Travel[/u][/h2]

Oh, the places you'll go! 

Introducing the fast travel system. As you progress through the game, you'll unlock tokens that can be used to activate teleport spots around the map. Here is a look at it in action:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_99860f5623624abfae8f243f968fd584~mv2.gif[/img]

[alpha players, please note that fast travel will be limited to 5 areas for now]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3aec635ceac141debcbee01998223cb2~mv2.gif[/img]

[whoooooosh]


[h2][u]Farm Building Upgrade[/u][/h2]

More room for farm friends! Alpha players will now be able to upgrade both the coop and barn building. There is a total of one upgrade for each building, giving you a maximum capacity of 8 animals per building.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0aa8875daa4044fd837e51c4918baf36~mv2.gif[/img]

[the upgrade flow]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_324d2474ec784776b51ae6ceb3f2aaca~mv2.png[/img]

[one can never have too many chikins]


[h2][u]Revamped Buildings[/u][/h2]

This month, we're showing off the interiors for the clinic and school. As for exteriors, we'll be showcasing what the townies call the dump.


[h3][u][b]Exteriors[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0be89a8276754c6ab51b7f36aa272caf~mv2.png[/img]

[no comment]

[h3][u][b]Interiors[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_8991f9f3fc334b1a895d7736efe1d975~mv2.png[/img]

[the clinic]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_7f05d57ddfd941fda7af724d303ebaba~mv2.png[/img]

[the school]


[h2][u]Revamped Grass and Mines[/u][/h2]

Progress continues to be made in the mines, and grass. Yes, we finally have grass!

[h3][u][b]New Environtment Grass[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_454c72a570ec49c1a7a1987e3b3705e3~mv2.png[/img]

[we're still in the process of applying grass across the map]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_2125f902031e4be9ae752b56dc60f449~mv2.gif[/img]

[a close up of the new grass]

[h3][u][b]Mine Earth Theme[/b][/u][/h3]

A lot of progress was made on the mines this month. An additional 15 levels have been redecorated with improved assets!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_fd0aeae5ab884738a22ffcf280c9b206~mv2.png[/img]

[mineeeees!]


[h2][u]Edited Dialogues[/u][/h2]

More edited dialogues, for this month!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_12d22439edfe43e19961a10f8e1e81cb~mv2.png[/img]


[h2][u]Other Updates & Behind the Scene[/u][/h2]

- The Q&A system with NPC's has been delayed to next month
- Woodlands is now open to Alpha players
- 'Grass' now drops from scything grass. The mill is required to process `grass` into `fodder`. Fodder can now be dispensed inside coop and barn provided player has a Mill.
- Added music for buildings, including Carpenter, General Store, and more!
- Basic town rank implemented. For now, you can earn points by donating to the museum, planting super coral, and completing sesajen offerings at the temple. As town rank increases, merchants will have more items to sell


[h2][u]What's next?[/u][/h2]

Next month, for Alpha v0.06, we've got the following planned: 

- Giants gameplay
- Town rank fully implemented
- Q&A system with NPC
- HD Wallpaper for backers revealed and delivered
- And more!

[b]Thanks for reading, [/b]
Stairway Team

notes.title: October 2021 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the October 2021 Coral Island development update!

This month, we'll go over the highlights of Alpha v0.04. 

[b]Alpha v0.04 will launch on October 31 @ 11:59PM PDT.[/b]


[h2][u]Happy Halloween![/u][/h2]

Spooky, but then make it *Coral Island*.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_f7be4d9aea024b81bb14ade6cd259c32~mv2.jpg[/img]


[h2][u]Bug catching[/u][/h2]

Get your [b]Bug net[/b] ready! We're releasing an early WIP bug-catching system! Eventually, you will donate bugs and unlock an area for them at the [b]Museum[/b] ([b]not[/b] ready for Alpha). In the meantime, purchase a bug net at the [b]Beach Shack[/b], and start catching!

P.S. the bug models are placeholder and not final.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_85fc67258b98440382d2fe8554406e91~mv2.gif[/img]

[There are different types of bugs depending on the [b]time of day[/b], [b]location[/b], and [b]seasons[/b].

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_b27b4ded3b2c4464be024ed3415d550c~mv2.gif[/img]

[Not a-sneaking-type of farmer? Don't worry. Find [b]slow bugs[/b]. Shown above: caterpillar. Adorable and slow.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_9abbe22a4400423bb4b88597f59886a4~mv2.gif[/img]

[Careful though! Some bugs are very fast and [b]perceptive[/b] of human movement. Sneaking might just be necessary to catch them.]

Thank you to all the backers that made bug-catching a reality in Coral Island. This is one of the first stretch goals we unlocked on Kickstarter.


[h2][u]Player house upgrade[/u][/h2]

You can now upgrade the house! In the [b]first[/b] house upgrade, you will receive a [b]kitchen[/b] that allows you to [b]cook[/b] various dishes. Pay a visit to the Carpenters and they'll be able to help you with upgrading the house. Make sure to bring enough money!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_52da0c329d0c4a6e9a95c5e393489331~mv2.png[/img]

[the exterior of the first house upgrade]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d20b8f6d4791475c9b3e466e44ebc821~mv2.png[/img]

[look at all that space, plus a built-in kitchen!]


[h2][u]Coral Shopping[/u][/h2]

Have too [i]much[/i] money and don't know where to spend it? Worry not. Introducing Coral Shopping! Here you'll find items to complete your [b]Kitchen[/b]. Check out the channel on your TV to find out what's for sale. Then, head to [b]Socket & Pan[/b] to make a purchase. New items are available for purchase every [b]Tuesday[/b]!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_19fec7854359400bafc703b26ecc07b2~mv2.gif[/img]

[a look at what the shopping flow looks like... purchased items are installed in your kitchen. Anyone else feel a little nostalgic?]


[h2][u]Cooking part 1[/u][/h2]

In Coral Island, there are two ways to cook. By [b]recipes and manual[/b]. You can simply click on any learned recipe on the [b]recipe tab[/b] or do it the old-fashioned way, mix and match. High risk, high return, right?

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_16f6b740f8464d3583bfc67554d062c3~mv2.gif[/img]

[there are around 10 utensils to collect... I spy, with my little eye, a [b]Blender[/b], [b]Grill[/b]...what else?]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_f87f3f1bee2d42129e676281a08e541e~mv2.png[/img]

[recipes tab are the [b]easiest[/b] way to cook things you've already cooked before]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_eabac3dcfc4446adb7b8116e9cbc7355~mv2.png[/img]

[the manual tab is for the adventurous; mix and match utensils and ingredients and unlock recipes yourself through trial and error. PS, please don't mind the placeholder art above]

Please note Alpha players, only the recipe section is available in the 0.04 update.


[h2][u]Revamped Buildings[/u][/h2]

This month, we're showcasing [b]Socket & Pan, Salon, Community Center, and Jim's house[/b]. Keep in mind that Salon's, animal shelter's and clothing store's features are NOT ready for Alpha...that said, don't let it stop you from exploring the interiors. There might be interesting notes in there.


[h3][u][b]Exteriors[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3695a9920cb2474baab5d175faa503f3~mv2.png[/img]

[Socket & Pan]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d4ed6fcc696143cabff4a8bbdcde521a~mv2.png[/img]

[Jim's House. This is where Jim, Lily and Theo live.]


[h3][u][b]Interiors[/b][/u][/h3]

The animal shelter is where you'll go to adopt a pet. For all the Kickstarter backers with the Pet Design tier, this is where you can meet your pet! Also worth noting, the Community Center is one of the largest interiors we've worked on to date.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3f50916debcd4d74a8d38fa56bb34e65~mv2.png[/img]

[The Community Center has 5 rooms inside it: Yoga room, White Flamingo clothing store, town hall, library, and an animal shelter. We're not going to show more due to SPOILERS]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_b851f33b0636409fadf453d33e593312~mv2.png[/img]

[Salon is run by Emily and Erika. One word = chic.]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_01223977c0c04e1cb69fa04844e7d636~mv2.png[/img]

[Socket & Pan. Submit your TV shopping orders here!]


[h2][u]Cutscenes & dialogue[/u][/h2]

More edited dialogues, more cutscenes, more fun!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_a8c1840d77ab4e1fa5dbe9c3827a716a~mv2.png[/img]


[h2][u]Other updates[/u][/h2]

- Added a WIP Town Rank system, check it out in the community center
- Experimenting with additional simplified daytime music
- Experimenting with cloud shadows in the game
- Display player objective in the Diving UI level selector
- Completed exteriors not listed: Mansion and Clinic
- Unlocked the Look Out area, now accessible to Alpha players
- Added a WIP glossary section to the main UI


[h2][u]What's next?[/u][/h2]

Next month, for Alpha v0.05, we've got a lot planned: 

- Open up the Woodlands area to Alpha players
- Unlock farm building upgrades (for barn and coop) and the Greenhouse
- First version of the Town Rank system that ties the game together
- New Q&A dialogue system with NPC's (unlock questions/topics to discuss with an NPC as you get closer with them)
- More revamped buildings (exteriors and interiors)
- And much more!



[b]Thanks for reading, [/b]
Stairway Team

- Unlocked the Look Out area, now accessible to Alpha players

notes.title: September 2021 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the September 2021 Coral Island development update!

This month, we'll go over the highlights of Alpha v0.03 and provide an update on Coral Island's release.

[h2][u]Ranching part 2 (mooo)[/u][/h2]

Ranching sees a big update this month. We release the barn, which allows you to purchase your first Barn animal, baby & adult [b]cow[/b]. You'll buy the Barn from the carpenter and the cow itself from the Ranch. While at the Ranch, be sure to purchase a [b]Milk Pai[/b]l so you can get to milking!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_6f4000262ec04f4ea6897665b785f9dc~mv2.gif[/img]
[baby & adult cow, just mooing around the barn]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_44ca51502c574668b586cc1649ec44cc~mv2.gif[/img]
[over time, baby cows turn into adult cows]

[b][u]Move or sell farm animals[/u][/b]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_5c5b0a995aed43f784ba0c58a8625eee~mv2.gif[/img]
[please excuse the programmer UI art for the move and sell buttons, lol]

[h2][u]Fishing Gameplay[/u][/h2]

For all of you fishers out there, your time has finally arrived. You can finally fish in the game! Currently, there are only about [b]10 fish[/b] you can catch. Where you find them depends on where you'll fish: in the [b]ocean, river, or lake[/b].

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_63aa3d1f53ae4bf88e2d6cd2f934bf6d~mv2.png[/img]
[purchase a fishing pole at the Beach Shack]

Please be mindful! Cast length in our game impacts the size of fish you are likely to catch. For example, a shorter cast has a higher chance of catching a small fish like the [b]goldfish[/b].

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3c66e1469f7548c7bd640457d36150e0~mv2.gif[/img]
[how long you hold the cast button will determine the cast length]

[h2][u]Map 2.0 (featuring player tracking!)[/u][/h2]

Player tracking on the map was one of the most requested features we received after launching Alpha. With the new map, you'll be able to do just that!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_eb89b7912fb94a68a6b7dc197fd09dea~mv2.png[/img]
[check it out, that's you, Player!]

We're working to tie the map tracking experience with the social mastery component of the game. By acquiring the appropriate skill and heart level with an NPC, you'll be able to see an icon of them on the map.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_108428cc83f54a62965cf94fe748f024~mv2.png[/img]
[we are still playing around with the NPC icons for the tracking feature]

[h2][u]Revamped exteriors[/u][/h2]

More revamped exteriors this month! We want to highlight the [b]Beach Shack, Millie's house, Frank & Erika's house,[/b] and last but not least, [b]a new coffee spot[/b]. Check it out!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3376dd67d6b1416daafacf8d0cc59853~mv2.png[/img]
[consider stopping by the Beach Shack!]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d0d5b1d769fe4c48948c110bf8a5aea9~mv2.png[/img]
[Millie's house]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d644fb607ce24230b1994621e7a96e7c~mv2.png[/img]
[Frank & Erika's house]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_1e8242a8830344d996ad1073ee83845d~mv2.png[/img]
[new coffee spot, and what's that other thing?]

[h2][u]Revamped interiors & mines[/u][/h2]

Reworked interiors accompany the new [b]Beach Shack[/b] and [b]Barn[/b]. In addition, new rooms have been added to already accessible interiors. We also start set dressing the mines in preparation for the game's story. So far, we've decorated the first 5 levels. More to come next month!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_64131a29f0ef46a7a4e90fbd95f7ed59~mv2.png[/img]
[checkout the Beach Shack]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_b530e197f8c942ccaebeae2e869739f3~mv2.png[/img]
[updated mines, what do those carvings mean...]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ca3567292eb342aa969d696631f708e1~mv2.png[/img]
[updated barn]

[h2][u]Other updates[/u][/h2]

> Added the ability to move or destroy farm buildings
> Added a `[b]LookAtFunction[/b]`. NPC's turn their head to look at Player when they are near
> Added preliminary assets for the `[b]SuperCoral[/b]` questline
> Dormant oil rigs placed in a couple of spots around the island by Pufferfish
> Farm buildings turn translucent when you are behind them
> [b]New, unrevealed NPCs[/b] roaming the island
> And much more behind the scenes

Check out some images below of these other updates:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3c9ecca87cd34ca686716fd3ef2c4834~mv2.gif[/img]
[go to the carpenter and purchase a [b]move or destroy[/b] order for your buildings]

[previewyoutube=pMbk-vuSLks;full][/previewyoutube]
[NPC's now look at you when you are near them]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0de541059377439bba92cc5e52dcb2db~mv2.gif[/img]
[early assets placed to get a feel for the Super Coral questline]

[h2][u]Early access launch delayed[/u][/h2]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_853889f827874286b3e8390250646753~mv2.png[/img]

[h2][u]What's next?[/u][/h2]

Next month, for Alpha v0.04, we hope to release Bug-catching gameplay, the ability to upgrade your house, additional revamped buildings, tons of heart cutscenes, and much more!



Thanks for reading,  

Stairway Team

notes.title: August 2021 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the August 2021 Coral Island development update!

Monthly dev updates are back! For this month’s developer update, we will share more details of the Alpha v0.02 update.

[h2][u]Alpha v0.02 content overview[/u][/h2]

[b]Alpha v0.02 will launch on August 31 @ 8 PM PDT.[/b]

Over 20,000 players participated in the Alpha v0.01 of the game. Thank you so much for providing feedback on the game, sharing your impressions, and of course, finding and submitting those pesky bugs.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_c08f499003004074ac72f56cef34a172~mv2.png[/img]

[h2][u]Ranching (erm...chicken army)[/u][/h2]

What's a farm sim game without the ability to ranch and raise some chicken? Ranching is now available to test for alpha players. Right now you're limited to raising chickens. We're excited to receive feedback!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_e340f7f2eb3f4c26a719101ed3cc7d89~mv2.gif[/img]

[also, a sneak peek at our new grass model]

For now, you'll be able to purchase a Chicklet (a cut surprise awaits you) or Chicken at the Ranch. As you take care of them, you'll gain relationship points that will impact the size of the product an animal produces.

[h2][u]Mastery skill tree[/u][/h2]

We've reworked the skill system in the game to make the act of mastering aspects of farm life more rewarding. Now, you'll earn specific experience points into different masteries depending on what you do. For example, clearing debris on your farm and harvesting crops will yield Farming experience.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_cc090f3c9a704043b51579d6c58c001b~mv2.png[/img]

[unlock cool skills like using the scythe to harvest crops!]

After gaining enough experience, you'll level up that mastery and earn points to spend on skills. In addition, as you gain more levels, you'll also unlock crafting recipes!

[h2][u]Revamped exteriors[/u][/h2]

We continue to revamp and finalize many of the buildings in the game. For this month, we want to highlight the Ranch and Fishensip (the tavern).

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_2390b640aabf4fa69d9b6d3d4bc91551~mv2.png[/img]
[purchase all your ranching needs at the Ranch]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_10e9eb45b77f4ba78f3c467d3f076a3c~mv2.png[/img]
[the go-to hangout spot on Coral Island!]

[h2][u]Revamped interiors[/u][/h2]

Accompanying the new exteriors are completely reworked interior spaces for the Ranch and Tavern. To coincide with the ranching update, we've also made updates to the level 1 coop interior.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_4d0d49d56e904b29bb7af4bf98207da0~mv2.png[/img]
[now featuring cubby holes for your coop animals]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_c455574d00ae41d8ad98290f66fb3eef~mv2.png[/img]
[revamped ranch interior]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_33c69d5c99b146b3b945e0122aeb11ae~mv2.png[/img]
[revamped tavern]

[h2][u]Other updates[/u][/h2]

- Added a WIP news channel
- Added a WIP shopping channel
- Experimenting with a new mouse hover based UI
- Optimized memory usage in the game
- Process fossils and nodes at the Blacksmith and Lab
- and much more behind the scenes!

[h2][u]Wallpaper anyone?[/u][/h2]

Rafael and seals... enough said

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_c788d14912a447d0850dfd8aa377643f~mv2.jpg[/img]

[h2][u]Bug of the month[/u][/h2]

Our lovely Alpha players have been submitting bugs left and right! For this month, we want to highlight a bug found by Discord user MisterNBD#1103. 

[previewyoutube=6IyF2NVKdE8;full][/previewyoutube]

[when humans and butterflies collide, it's magical]

[h2][u]What's next?[/u][/h2]
Our target is to release a content update every month during Alpha. Next month, for Alpha v0.03, we hope to release Fishing gameplay, more revamped buildings, and the ability to care for cows!



Thanks for reading,  
Stairway Team

notes.title: May 2021 Dev Update

Welcome to the May 2021 Coral Island development update!


This May, we showcase a WIP of the character customizer, more revamped NPC models, and other exciting news worth sharing. Check it out!

Let us know what you think!


[h2][u]New NPC Models, Shop Keeper Edition[/u][/h2]

Check out the upgraded models for both Sam and Dinda. Sam runs the general store in the heart of Starlet Town. You'll see him frequently as you make supply runs for seeds! Dinda runs a carpenter shop with her husband Joko for all your building needs.

We're happy to announce that Stairway Games has been awarded an [url=https://www.unrealengine.com/en-US/megagrants]Epic MegaGrant[/url]! 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0ebb5faec7864fed8789bfa59b8364c4~mv2.png[/img]

For our Switch players - here is the update that you've been waiting for! We have received the Switch Dev Kits that will allow us to start testing the game on Switch hardware.

notes.title: April 2021 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the April 2021 Coral Island development update!


In April 2021, we worked on many, many things. We’ll focus on character customization, jogging animation 2.0, revamped exterior buildings, and more for this update. Check it out!


[h2][u]Character Customization Showcase Part 1[/u][/h2]

Here's a sneak peek at the character customization UI in Coral Island. Please note that this is a WIP. We're excited to share that for Alpha, there will be 3 body types available for players.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_8a0d21bf99114723b14000eaf0a16fa8~mv2.png[/img]
[3 body types to choose from + plenty of color options]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_6543ec23acce4d03b4ad2140e6fdeca2~mv2.png[/img]
[there will be many hair options to choose from]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_6543ec23acce4d03b4ad2140e6fdeca2~mv2.png[/img]
[custom honorifics are working in-game, huzzah!]


For part 2 next month, we will do a deep dive into the character customization system. This will come in the form of a video showcase that will be uploaded to Youtube - stay tuned!



[h2][u]Jogging Animations Revisited[/u][/h2]

We've received a ton of feedback on our animations. This month, we've tried to improve the jogging animation. We plan to let players choose their animation style eventually.


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_741dc0d16f91423294a9c47258329489~mv2.gif[/img]

[4 styles of animation for the early access release!]



For alpha, there will be several more animation types for you to check out. We hope you can help us narrow the 4 to ship Early Access with. Please let us know what you think!


[h2][u]Revamped Buildings[/u][/h2]

Much like interiors, many buildings in our game are also getting a make-over for better storytelling. This month, we tackled a fair amount of locations already! Please have a look at just one of the buildings being improved: the carpenter shop.


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_f5e733e8806843388666f35afbc594ee~mv2.png[/img]

[Carpenter: [b]NEW in-game[/b]. This is what it currently looks like in-game, still a WIP]


Fun fact, the carpenter building is inspired by Indonesia's traditional Joglo architecture, known for its distinct roof work. A very fitting home for our carpenters!


[h2][u]Earth Day Art[/u][/h2]

Earth day, every day.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_9da9b5a038224669b57ca83174a2032c~mv2.jpg[/img]

No one wants to admit it, but something tells me this was done on purpose... #sus

Stairway Team

notes.title: March 2021 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the March 2021 Coral Island development update! 


In March 2021, we hired more devs, set a new benchmark for NPC 3D models, got the ball rolling on interior improvements, worked on alpha content, and managed the pre-order store! 
Let's take a closer look:


[h2][u]We hired more devs![/u][/h2]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_b39d9ff820044f2695e8cd2310a00bfc~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1056,h_1162,al_c,q_90/74a294_b39d9ff820044f2695e8cd2310a00bfc~mv2.webp[/img]


[h2][u]NPC 3D models, new and improved… Now with fingers![/u][/h2]

We are working on the new benchmark for Coral Island's NPC model. With the current timeline, we expect to have all NPC's in their Spring outfits ready for the early access release. We've updated the scale, body proportion and tweaked lots of details.

During [b]alpha[/b], all NPC's will be released with old models, as the new ones are not yet ready. Check it out!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_2b00b1d41db3406c9793abb984981311~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_407,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_2b00b1d41db3406c9793abb984981311~mv2.webp[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_c731902369de49a582338b705937cba9~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_361,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_c731902369de49a582338b705937cba9~mv2.webp[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_39c82efeef3a400295be288fc7fd575d~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_361,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_39c82efeef3a400295be288fc7fd575d~mv2.webp[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_28281535941d441eb51b3d5726bd69fd~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_361,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_28281535941d441eb51b3d5726bd69fd~mv2.webp[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_228aafd2187141638ab9aa42b82c417f~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_245,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_228aafd2187141638ab9aa42b82c417f~mv2.webp[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_87636d90b863482eb53b34d2d44ffdf9~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_245,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_87636d90b863482eb53b34d2d44ffdf9~mv2.webp[/img]

[b][Alice and Theo Status: Work-in-progress. 3D modelling, emotional growth and otherwise.][/b]


[h2][u]Brand new interior designs[/u][/h2]

We are improving the interiors by making them feel lived in. To do this, we look into each NPC’s unique characteristics and fuse them into the design of their bedroom, kitchen, and even the whole house… This means we'll be creating over [b]1000+ unique props[/b] to accommodate this major change (on top of the current available common props!).

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_c27ba2b69aae4885a5ccc6dc81453892~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_611,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_c27ba2b69aae4885a5ccc6dc81453892~mv2.webp[/img]

[b][Archie's room concept art. Spot the [i]guling[/i]!][/b]


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_fddb27c3d32f49bc9790126bce78f0e8~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_531,al_c,lg_1,q_90/74a294_fddb27c3d32f49bc9790126bce78f0e8~mv2.webp[/img]

[b][Archie's room in-game. Status: WIP][/b]


For the Coral Island [b]Alpha Access[/b], most rooms will only have placeholder assets. Each room is a work in progress and we will use common props for a lot of the interiors. Bear in mind that some rooms, and even buildings, will be [b]inaccessible[/b] for Players during Alpha.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_41768c6cc6824e9caecb2c40f9ef48ec~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_523,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_41768c6cc6824e9caecb2c40f9ef48ec~mv2.webp[/img]

[b][Alice's room concept art][/b]


[h2][u]Public Roadmap[/u][/h2]

The alpha release is delayed to [b]July 2021[/b]. We are asking for an extra month to polish the experience. Going into Kickstarter, we did not expect to receive this level of support. There are over 20k alpha farmers! While this is amazing and we are very grateful for it, to be candid, it also feels daunting. 

To make the most out of your feedback, we will be releasing content and features in 3 tranches for Alpha. Please take a look at the [b]roadmap[/b] below:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_211a6c146b544874a391db77b0d9e3fa~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_1112,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_211a6c146b544874a391db77b0d9e3fa~mv2.webp[/img]


[h2][u]Pre-Order Store[/u][/h2]

The exclusive reward (Premium outfits, Crowns, and Mythical pets) ended at 10 pm EST (GMT-4) on March 31st, 2021.

Starting [b]April 1st[/b], 2021, the Coral Island pre-order store only has:

1. Alpha pack (steam only)  
2. Double-double pack (steam only)  
3. Coral Island game key  (steam only)
4. Digital Art Book + OST  
5. Pre-order exclusive Pack (Alpha access + steam game key + artbook + ost)

March pre-order Double-Double, Deluxe Farmers, and Pioneers [b]backers[/b] will receive the survey by next week. If you do not receive/ fill in the survey, please do not worry. It does [b]not[/b] cancel your order.


[h2][u]Language[/u][/h2]

Coral Island is adding [i][b]Dutch[/b][/i] and [i][b]Italian[/b][/i] to our list of localization. Here is the list of language that Coral Island will support:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_9fa48dd2002042478ec8a6385d5da617~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_448,al_c,lg_1,q_90/74a294_9fa48dd2002042478ec8a6385d5da617~mv2.webp[/img]

[h2][u]Bug of the Month[/u][/h2]

Spinning Giants for the win!

notes.title: Various stretch goals reached. Next to unlock: Multiplayer!
notes.content:
[h1]Various stretch goals reached.[/h1]

Not even two weeks in, you all have helped us reached most of our goals! Thank you so much!

[b] Support us below:[/b]

Kickstarter linked [url=https://t.co/UKw0Y7rqkq?amp=1]here[/url].


[b][u]Bug Catching - UNLOCKED[/u][/b]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/032/283/308/4fd80224e9a0f49aa8c6c959d1d748d4_original.png?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1612666153&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=dc4a0686e40b205f451e524bc2cb6423[/img]

In Bug Catching, you will be able to catch colorful bugs around the island and document them. There are more than 30 kinds of bugs in Coral Island, from Firefly, Leaf Beetle to Blue Morpho butterfly. Pop your net in your backpack and get ready to catch some bugs!


[b][u]Expanded Museum - UNLOCKED[/u][/b]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/032/283/574/195386fb185717ec8c722ed5623d13c4_original.png?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1612668920&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=26fbc401124852cf289139c3bd87571c[/img]

Now, we can display our bugs and fish! It will have 2 different wings; 1 section will house bug catches and the other, exclusively, for the aquarium. In Coral Island, we have more than 60 fish to catch.


[b][u]NPC Seasonal Outfits - UNLOCKED[/u][/b]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/032/294/362/de4eaa3756a6e2303ac90a2aa73a1cfc_original.png?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1612768227&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=c446c9437097d23b5fa012b9b07bb8bd[/img]
Lily shown in Spring, Summer, Fall and Winter.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/032/293/653/93d6195b50b6d0725429755009b3ba21_original.png?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1612760762&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=41df9e45e0e91d7d77383c590dc02b82[/img]
Rafael shown in Spring, Summer, Fall and Winter.

In this update, you will see all islanders change outfits every season, totaling more than 170 outfit designs. We assign a color theme for every islander, play around with the design and color combination around it. This approach allows each NPC to be identifiable in-game throughout the year. At the same time, we are also making sure that each outfit design is still true to their character. This change in the outfit will bring the NPC and the overall game more alive! We can’t wait to share them with you.



[b][u]Console and Switch port - UNLOCKED[/u][/b]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/032/309/554/3dc3a119008119d11d90e74257f39a40_original.png?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1612874328&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=42ba6294fcf8acdbd2f55e2eb390f785[/img]

[list]
[*]Q: When?
A: It depends on the platform holders, as they all have different policies. But our plan is to have Coral Island ported around 6 months after the early access release.


[*]Q: Can I get a console/ Switch key instead of a Steam key?
A: Yes, absolutely! You will be able to choose between a console/Switch or Steam key.
 [/list]



[b][u]Merfolk Underwater Village - UNLOCKED[/u][/b]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/031/484/262/e63fe44b2fea75e487a32b430f1afdb2_original.png?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=680&fit=max&v=1605863610&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=f5d6028222797f7a4afdd757a5a38156[/img]

This is your ticket to explore the underwater village. There are many merfolk villages around the world and this pass will allow you to traverse the one located by the coast of Coral Island. Decipher their language and develop relationships with them!



[b][u]Kids Grow Up - UNLOCKED[/u][/b]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/032/322/378/22419fa8de5e0c1ab1eb2842596d5ef5_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1612950869&auto=format&frame=1&q=92&s=c47d3b99709e1e2bc17b91222e869404[/img]
Left to right. Current Zoe, Goat, Teenage Zoe

This feature will include additional stories and relationship development. There will be new schedules, dialogues, and many more! For the Player's children (you can have up to 2), there will be a variety of children's designs. The children will have their own personality and interest;  you can influence this as they grow up, or let them discover it on their own.  Worth noting that the children's characters/traits are not exactly tied to the spouse you marry.


[b][u]Mod Support - UNLOCKED[/u][/b]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/032/338/183/043944021994545e69cd76cc911692ec_original.png?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1613055310&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=318fc93ec56728cb981e5966ac84cd59[/img]

In order for us to create modding tools that will best serve the community, we will start by first figuring out what parts of the game people want to mod the most. From there, a full-time developer will be assigned to continually expand moddable parts of the game.  We’re extremely excited to see what the modding community will create for Coral Island!   


[b]What's next?[/b]

Multiplayer is next!!! Play with friends, spouse, whomever! We'll hire two additional full-time devs to implement co-op and up to 4 players online farm in Coral Island.

Kickstarter linked [url=https://t.co/UKw0Y7rqkq?amp=1]here[/url].


Thank you for reading!

Stairway scavengers.

notes.title: Stretch goal: minigames UNLOCKED!
notes.content:
[h1]Minigames UNLOCKED[/h1]

We just hit our first stretch goal of 125k! We’re so grateful for the amazing support. Now, let’s dive into the Minigames!

[b] Support us below:[/b]

Kickstarter linked [url=https://t.co/UKw0Y7rqkq?amp=1]here[/url].


[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/EteCw6JU0AYhgNx?format=jpg&name=900x900[/img]


[b][u]Here are several of the minigames that we are adding for the full-release:[/u][/b]


Available all year round, on the world map:
[list]
[*]Mini-golf; Head to Pufferfish Corp. office and receive a token for 20c. Take a swing, get 3 strikes, and beat the high score! PS: Suki is the current Coral Island’s mini-golf champ.
[*]High stake darts at the tavern, challenge yourself, and collect as many bullseyes as other Farmers. Do you dare?
[*]An arcade game made exclusively by our in-house designer; it involves surviving an attack masterminded by giant forks. “Donut Survival by M.B.”
[*]Dungeon cart-race; ride the questionably old cart inside the cavern. Get in and see how far it will take you. Watch for the turbulence ahead!
[*]Home console; find the elusive home console and collect all of its game cartridges.
 [/list]

Featured in a festival:
[list]
[*]Pet race!
[*]Color-throw for a festival; let loose and test your aim. Grab colorful ammo and stain as many islanders as possible.
 [/list]

We are open to more ideas! Leave a comment to let us know what minigames might be cool to have. We will add at least 2 additional minigame ideas from the community.


So, what’s next?

Our next goal is at 175k for Bug Catching. You will be able to catch colorful bugs around the island and document them.


Thank you for reading!

Stairway folks.
