notes.title: October 2020 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the October 2020 development update!

[h2]Character Reveals[/h2]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_234877da139e48f3b656e49b0a93216a~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_416,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_234877da139e48f3b656e49b0a93216a~mv2.webp[/img]
Meet Sam, Ben, Ling, Alice (left to right).

[b]The Lineup So Far[/b]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_92a2f9cddf9e4c43a5365add268e977d~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_314,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_92a2f9cddf9e4c43a5365add268e977d~mv2.webp[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_7d248df934014bfaab2910eaf5979881~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_1047,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_7d248df934014bfaab2910eaf5979881~mv2.webp[/img]
[b]Sam.[/b] He owns the general store and lives on the second floor with his wife. Sam usually spends his day off relaxing at home, enjoying home-cooked meals, and working on puzzles. On the rare occasion that he goes out, he visits the Beach Shack to catch up with his friends over chess.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_56e08c5040654f63b10553840142c0a1~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_1047,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_56e08c5040654f63b10553840142c0a1~mv2.webp[/img]
[b]Ben[/b]is a nomad who lives in a caravan stationed in the forest. If you knock on his window on the weekend, he might have some random things to sell -- be it items he finds scavenging around the island or things that he doesn’t want anymore. Ben spends his money attending the Fall music festivals and green tea.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_012b162c72bd43b4934599042da5b3e9~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_1047,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_012b162c72bd43b4934599042da5b3e9~mv2.webp[/img]
[b]Ling.[/b] She spends her day working as a marine biologist at Coral Island laboratory. During time off, she knits cold-weather accessories, beanies, scarves, etc. She has dedicated her life to study coral reefs, and how to make them more resistant to rising ocean temperatures.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_f751a6f3725d425194ea2c86322b3733~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_1047,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_f751a6f3725d425194ea2c86322b3733~mv2.webp[/img]
[b]Alice.[/b] A bachelorette. Alongside her twin sister Suki, they own, run, and live by the beach in Coral Inn. Running a business is hard, and running it with your sister is harder. Alice spends her days working at the inn, and her free time hanging out with friends in town. Loves minced jackfruit pies.


[h2]Beach Environment Showcase[/h2]

Coral Island has a white sand beach along its coastline. You'll come across various wildlife and scavenge for items that only appear here. Islanders go here to fish, and on the weekends, spend time with family playing volleyball.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_49e5b08f3e6c406487019e438ce558de~mv2.gif[/img]
Take a peek at Coral Island’s coastline... And a cute little crab!



[h2]Ranching[/h2]

This month, we've decided to show off ranching! Showcased here are level 1 coops. Small and cozy, they occupy 7x4 tiles. Before farm buildings are ready for use, they go through a construction phase.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_f2bc32b67c2947ddbe7ddb7e7600c55d~mv2.gif[/img]
To keep ranch animals happy, you have to feed them every day. If you forget to feed animals, it affects their mood. An upset Chicken won't produce any eggs. No fodder, no egg!


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_c29c51d062424792ac07c2e4b718a54a~mv2.gif[/img]
PS: The coop interior is a work in progress. Also us before and after coffee.

Ranch animals have an indicator to let you know whether they can be petted, sheared, or milked. The Heart emote will disappear once a Ranch Animal is petted. 

Imagine having 5 cows and 10 chickens out in the field and not being able to keep track of which ones you've already petted? We think this might help.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3b86d5aa4a28437baed4cba878a9ad7b~mv2.gif[/img]

Ranching in action!

[previewyoutube=KkOwrcVKfGs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Farm Animal: Cow[/h2]

We’ve shared Pig and Chicken back in April (shown animated in July) and now, it’s time to reveal a chonkier, barn-dwelling animal, Cow.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_f8a737e83511484298edd501e4aa0abc~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_375,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_f8a737e83511484298edd501e4aa0abc~mv2.webp[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d78b0cd491024f738ed6ce6ffc34e040~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_375,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_d78b0cd491024f738ed6ce6ffc34e040~mv2.webp[/img]
Brown Cow vs. Regular Cow

Coral Island's Cow comes with four different horn designs. The design will be randomly selected when you purchase Cow from the Ranch. We think the diverse horn will give our Cow more identity.


When you welcome an adult cow onto your farm, they will come with one of four horn designs. We hope these horns will give your cows more identity, and make them more personable.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_09ead891f4254130bbfbf498dfcfb700~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_375,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_09ead891f4254130bbfbf498dfcfb700~mv2.webp[/img]

Once Cow is an adult, it can get pregnant and give birth to Baby Cow. During the pregnancy, Cow will stop producing milk. Keep in mind that Baby Cow can not produce milk until they mature. 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_9aa1ce2ffe894e2d9109fd0cf36c2451~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_375,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_9aa1ce2ffe894e2d9109fd0cf36c2451~mv2.webp[/img]

[h2]NPC Activity Animation[/h2]

In addition to having different personalities, each islander in Coral Island also has their own hobbies and professions. Shown below is Theo, a daytime fisherman and an amateur entertainer by night. A look at how Theo spends his weekends, making a quick buck performing live at the Tavern.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_da3391550b0d47cc899a4b53adcca575~mv2.gif[/img]

[h2]Bug of The Month[/h2]

Theo makes it to the bug of the month! Is it a bug or mad guitar skills? Twitter seems to think the latter, but we will let you decide on that.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_75c0174bff9149e78ceafd5f8650d32b~mv2.gif[/img]


[h2]What's Next[/h2]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_ad179c272a4a478dbbfe2600a60c8dd7~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_416,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_ad179c272a4a478dbbfe2600a60c8dd7~mv2.webp[/img]

Over the next 2 months, we are going to have less content to share on the blog. The reason being that the team needs to focus on delivering the announcement trailer, planned for January 2021. 

Instead, we will be doing mini updates with character reveals, music, animations and animals. The Diving blog post has been moved to the end of January 2021, to coincide with the trailer release. This means any update until then won't include game features. As always, your feedback is appreciated.


Thanks for reading,  Stairway Team

notes.title: September 2020 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the September 2020 development update!

[h2]Character Reveals[/h2]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_32f2cd5aacf143c5b88274d58c6c86f4~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_32f2cd5aacf143c5b88274d58c6c86f4~mv2.webp[/img]
Meet Nina, Kenny, Pablo, Betty, Suki (left to right).

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_cdfd20536c834df3bb90557e6dfed525~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_393,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_cdfd20536c834df3bb90557e6dfed525~mv2.webp[/img]
[b]The Lineup So Far[/b] - We are officially over halfway through our character reveals!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d56f1d778a5644b1b5091246009a991f~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_1308,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_d56f1d778a5644b1b5091246009a991f~mv2.webp[/img]
[b]Nina.[/b] This bachelorette technically doesn't live in Coral Island anymore, but still visits her vacation home at the beach, from time to time. Aside from wild rumors around town, she's never talked about her abrupt departure, so it remains a mystery until now. A close friend with Suki.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_167a65d20cf7489e92037c1346182160~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_1308,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_167a65d20cf7489e92037c1346182160~mv2.webp[/img]
[b]Kenny[/b], a part-time rancher, and full-time bachelor. He grew up in Coral Island and has fostered close relationships with other islanders-- be it people, animals, trees, spirits from the beyond-- all of them. Besides making friends, he loves having lunch outdoors, playing the flute, and cold kombucha

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_8f568c1850c84e96ae56f701af6e6250~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_1308,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_8f568c1850c84e96ae56f701af6e6250~mv2.webp[/img]
[b]Pablo:[/b] He and his brother, Rafael, are both blacksmith and bachelors. When Pablo isn’t smelting ores, he can be found around town, lending hands to the townfolks, cleaning up the graveyard, or tossing anecdotes at the Tavern. Hates beaches—Dislikes sands in his shoes.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d8234ab061944029b33a2bdada3a9001~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_1308,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_d8234ab061944029b33a2bdada3a9001~mv2.webp[/img]
[b]Betty.[/b] Back in the day, Betty used to run the Tavern with her late husband, Frank Sr.. Now, she spends her retirement days going around town re-filling bird feeders, educating kids about coral reefs, and baking patisseries.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_8002bb84cf9d4287b19e809814d7cfd3~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_1308,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_8002bb84cf9d4287b19e809814d7cfd3~mv2.webp[/img]
[b]Suki[/b] is recently divorced and, according to her nightstand, currently “finding love from within,” and learning “how to expand love.” Focusing on herself, she drowns herself in work, exercise, and building a healthy co-parenting relationship with her ex.

[h2]Tile Menu Animations[/h2]

Very excited to show more of the title menu. We've added several more animations. You can also check out styling for the options, new game and load game sections.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d667060076124c4ba9b3ec6335a52b21~mv2.gif[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0fd31c2b501645bda4e499d6064fd2e9~mv2.gif[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_32ff5d5aeb554939b17f54a90caa7111~mv2.gif[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_5732baba68d347bf8b1dffafb83eb275~mv2.gif[/img]

[h2]Interior Decoration System WIP[/h2]

We've been hard at work implementing the logic of the interior decor system. It is now fully functional! Next is designing the UI, paying attention to both style and function. We'll be asking the community for feedback in Discord this coming month.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_66cb9784bd584ffc9179b046f560fbb5~mv2.gif[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ae510f2c71e84a788b89f0958a9422b2~mv2.gif[/img]

[h2]NPC Activity Animation[/h2]

Coral Island features a large cast of NPC's. Several of the islanders have unique professions and or responsibilities in town. We're implementing a wide range of animations that certain NPC's will play. The goal is to breathe life into these characters.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_f483f4ecb11f42c491df7d154116e3dd~mv2.gif[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3f527952a74640958d0fde293ae8dc16~mv2.gif[/img]

[h2]Spring Main Theme Music[/h2]

We feel that music can help us to transport you to the shores of Coral Island. Today we are pleased to reveal the main theme song for Spring. Please let us know your thoughts!

[url=https://video.wixstatic.com/video/491ae5_566592ce3e0f47fdb44bcd504fd43b12/1080p/mp4/file.mp4]Spring Main Theme Music Link[/url]

[h2]Town Center Building & House[/h2]

A lot of work continues to be done in populating the game world. Featured this month is the town center, where both the museum, library and communal area reside. Somewhere in town, check out the house belonging to Lily, Theo and [redacted].
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_9b7a02b8d0c343edb95cc3a82b12f7f5~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_9b7a02b8d0c343edb95cc3a82b12f7f5~mv2.webp[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_fc43f266766f460aacc68ef9b6693b55~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_fc43f266766f460aacc68ef9b6693b55~mv2.webp[/img]


[h2]What's Next[/h2]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ea1b710196184c30bb772dddf5e00f02~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_ea1b710196184c30bb772dddf5e00f02~mv2.webp[/img]

For October, we are not yet sure if we will reveal diving or ranching, but it will be one of those! You can also expect to see more character reveals and other areas in game. As always, your feedback is appreciated.


Thanks for reading,  Stairway Team

notes.title: August 2020 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the August 2020 development update!

[h2]Character Reveals[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/a347a1d99ad6611a9ae4c57a4eb4c7437a23a5a0.png[/img]
Meet Leah, Rafael, Frank and Erika (left to right)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/689c226dffc74630c74f98693a895df2f83ddaa7.png[/img]
[b]Leah[/b] lives her bachelorette life with her father and stepmom in an old massive house that the locals call “The Mansion.” She is a self-hired, yoga instructor at the community center and takes her online presence seriously. She spends her day wandering around the island with a camera on hand. Dislikes mushrooms and eggs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/b1fecc711755054791685977f10e5e32b6b9dbcd.png[/img]
[b]Rafael[/b], along with his older brother, Pablo, who is also an eligible bachelor, run a local blacksmith shop. As a reserved fellow, Rafael is rarely seen out at town, but on rare days that he does, he can be found at Socket Electronics or Coral Inn, visiting his cousins and niece, Valentina.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/54758b687c1d943e75c20cede198ba067f00133a.png[/img]
[b]Frank[/b]: He and his brother, Noah, run the tavern at the town center. Though he doesn’t live there anymore, Frank spends most of his time at the tavern, trying out new recipes. Frank is married to his high-school sweetheart, Erika, and the couple live with their 2 cats, Peanut and Butter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/cd2e6f614fd1d4d7e529c2d7dc0acabd41c01935.png[/img]
[b]Erika[/b]: When she isn’t working at the salon or volunteering at school, she can be found around town, lending her ears to those in need, free of charge. She is honest and would say things as is. Perhaps a good candidate to marry if she weren't already married to Frank. Loves all sorts of jam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/b01ef8af968b5423cda0898a37b573d636e29350.png[/img]
[b]The Lineup So Far[/b] - Almost halfway there, before surprises!

[h2]Coral Island Main Theme Song[/h2]
We're excited to reveal Coral Island's main theme song. Hopefully this can give you a glimpse of the adventures that await you on the island!

[previewyoutube=Ah173naoSZg;full][/previewyoutube]
[also a look at the title screen for Coral Island's early access launch]

[h2]General Store Interior & Translucent Walls[/h2]
This August, we also showcase some interior work and how we deal with walls when indoors. Our pipeline is finally clear, so we are kicking interior production into high gear. 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0d46e1e0c5ee4fad86e780f2fff0b789~mv2.gif[/img]
[walls will disappear when you enter rooms]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/976fedc72a6797f72726f52812ef8904b9d43b16.png[/img]
[Eva works at the General Store, she bakes the best cookies]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/70b6f0a99b7de854b4db9285c652f5250b42d41e.png[/img]
[work in progress look at the general store interior, polish incoming!]

[h2]Shop UI[/h2]
There are several shops in Coral Island, each selling something unique. We tried our best to create a shop UI that blends both style and function. Please let us know your thoughts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/6514a4cd91f934aa328838400d3af8669cb7876d.png[/img]
[this is our bug of the month, you can probably guess this characters name lol. Also a soon to be revealed character]

[h2]Mining Sneak Peak[/h2]
What's a farming game without mining! Although the level and assets are still a work in progress, we've overcome the hardest part of mining -- building the system itself! We can't wait to show off more layouts when something more polished is here.

[previewyoutube=1-IAb5Gdwfo;full][/previewyoutube]
[a look at the general feel and vibe we are going for in the mines]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_8306a7adc3c740508b260eca87a25981~mv2.gif[/img]
[we've added several animations that play depending on your point of entry down the rope]

[h2]What's Next[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/b4525f34da2159f4f721c0ba673874f0b0562b9c.png[/img]
[your next batch of characters!]

For September we'll be taking a look at interior customization for players house! You can also expect to see more character reveals and some animation work. As always, your feedback is appreciated.

Thanks for reading,  Stairway Team

notes.title: July 2020 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to July’s 2020 development update!

[h2]Character Reveals[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/7f2291ce4dd775068073904f441a801162cb22c2.png[/img]
Meet Surya, Eva, Zoe, Anne and Paul (left to right). Here is a little bit about them:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/045a9c88e525e60cb5c80ed1a105f4d343027485.png[/img]
[b]Surya[/b], an eligible marriage candidate, is a fresh marine biologist graduate who is currently doing a fellowship in Coral Island. Like you, he is also new to the island! Loves Lodeh dish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/70695a11071b40f5b2776ffcf48086812cef3341.png[/img]
[b]Eva[/b] is a bachelorette. She is a happy-go-lucky baker who works at the general store. She enjoys talking to the islanders, be it local, new, visitors, everybody! And is good friends with a lot of them. According to the islanders, Eva is always a delight to talk to-- a positive ray of sunshine. A fan of red velvet cakes and cookies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/469728e91eb052fd9bad70abeb2e50bba5e4899e.png[/img]
[b]Zoe[/b] is a wild-life enthusiast, just like her parents. Zoe goes to school on the weekdays and spends her weekend following her dad around. She enjoys a game of volleyball, bird watching, and winters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/2f7eda1993f0ae91d269b0ad290ca065035341d2.png[/img]
[b]Anne[/b] makes a living by filming wildlife documentaries around Coral island. On the weekend, she can be found at the beach, enjoying the weather and sharpening her volleyball skills. She likes carrots and hummus combo for snacks, and a cup of green tea to start the day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/74111ca435de71ff44a119b0be9ac1db9b0d87f7.png[/img]
[b]Paul[/b] is a dad, husband and wildlife enthusiast. Along with his wife, Anne, the couple spends their days capturing wildlife footage around the island. He would leap out of his bed the second he is needed to save animals, without hesitation. Big heart, likes hummus.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/74baf27142e90b8bc97c2a435b2b612646c4636f.png[/img]
[b]The Lineup So Far[/b] - Moving forward, we will add newly revealed NPC's to this lineup. We hope this makes it a little easier to keep track of everyone you’ll meet in Coral Island. Note: we’re not even halfway there, plenty more to unveil!


[h2]Fishing Showcase[/h2]
Coral Island features a robust fishing system. You’ll be able to catch fish in rivers, lakes and in the ocean. As you clear the island of pollution, you’ll unlock more species to catch, and perhaps, cross lines with something legendary.

[previewyoutube=WIVaSa_V4mc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Animal Animations[/h2]
This July, we also showcase some of the animations your farm animals will play. We have a mix of idle and 'rare' animations for you to check out:

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_48dca2eacd57486bbdef06a243431c59~mv2.gif[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ab0e16901b484321b1e77cf3c971fd94~mv2.gif[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0b1bd60ccf5f422189b82cd93e46d012~mv2.gif[/img]


[h2]Conversation UI[/h2]
We are really excited to showcase the conversation UI! Please don't mind the grammar, that will be fixed in the coming months ːsteamhappyː

[previewyoutube=IWgL3WWw6CI;full][/previewyoutube]
There are a ton of personalities to meet, so we want to make sure they look their best! After some experimentation, we feel that showing ¾ of the NPC portrait looks right. Displaying up to 3 lines of dialogue per box also feels good to read. What do you think?

[h2]Rainy and Windy Days in Coral Island[/h2]
It’s not always sunny in Coral Island -- today we showcase what a windy day looks like, and how the environment changes when it rains.

[previewyoutube=BpXwpiAF1Ec;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=KSp06dchtqA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Somewhere in Town[/h2]
Nestled in Starlet Town is a temple -- it is the only one of its kind that is fully intact. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/6473eaf607ae360c72ab92d740fbd9469ea03f4a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/72cdac571c6bbb93add07050f1aae224f9981b6f.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Of The Month[/h2]
One does not simply fish in the river.

[previewyoutube=ki91MlZ0wok;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's Coming Next Month[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/9865c581f85bd40499d9525a372633ebfa5010c7.png[/img]

[we swapped July and August character reveals]

Next month we'll be revealing Coral Island's main theme song! You can also expect to see more character reveals and a look at the interior of the general store. Last but not least, be on the lookout for mining as well!  As always, your feedback is appreciated.

Thanks for reading,  Stairway Team

notes.title: June 2020 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to another monthly development update. Before we begin, happy Pride Month!

[h2]Coral Island Is Coming to Steam[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/82bb28d3d42fbdf8db0012dce58052fb951fa58a.png[/img]

We're incredibly excited to share that our Steam page has officially launched. Please follow and wishlist the game.

[h2]Your Next Batch of Characters[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/cc8782214c29832a5934254d55aeeb985a36f8b9.png[/img]

Meet Theo, Macy, Dippa and Charles (left to right). Here is a little bit about them:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/3f877bc3b8b7a2a56b6dad302db08b7c3c10e6e3.png[/img]

[b]Theo[/b] is an eligible marriage character. On the weekends, he makes a quick buck performing live at the tavern. He doesn't have what people call a “decent voice,” but he does have “soul” when he performs. Apparently, according to him, that's what's important. Day job: a fisherman.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/be7487dad19a590d4df0f3966095a922f6737a1c.png[/img]

[b]Macy[/b] is an eligible marriage character. She grew up in a neighboring island and now lives full time at the Inn. She makes a living by selling images to a visual media company, Pletty inc. She loves simple nights, taking pictures, playing video games and Stephen, her rescued lobster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/3e5f47c1a89958318c74f3fe08fed4f657d07eda.png[/img]

[b]Dippa[/b] usually spends their day looking for inspiration and painting around the island. They do not like night-outs, and think that those days are behind them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/efc764748a9a0f3bf22b7451b7b5813b1f1c489f.png[/img]

[b]Charles[/b], a town doctor, uses his free time catching up with the islanders at the tavern and going around spitting out medical advice.  Has pollen allergy, dislikes flowers.

[h2]Default Player Model[/h2]

Please join us in welcoming version 1.0 of the farmer you might play as. Later this year, we'll showcase the customization options that will be available for your farmer at launch. Let us know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/2d9a7dede4ac4a814043a307ac06b6ed04202a27.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/840d139aee9cb6ad838f451c45b4a2c572d34a3f.gif[/img]
[your farmer will play different idle animations depending on the in-game time of day]

[h2]UI Showcase[/h2]

The first iteration of our UI has finally made it into the game... So we finally feel comfortable showing you all a glimpse of what to expect.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_902e9bf6a0be45a1adb02b0b82df6dd5~mv2.gif[/img]
[text temporarily appears above icons when cycling through the inventory]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/f093173be6e5cfec8f05daef56422bd162164b7d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/dcb9bf1c77893eb1b7ed0d0dde9c07a5a9a6f18a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/e62fd2a626f34d96b26fa456e18f0dc675af3ce3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/0e1aadccb9005c143923985e7e99f44dee982b23.png[/img]
[other screens to give you a glimpse of various UI elements]

[h2]Improved Character Movement Animations[/h2]

The biggest complaint we received from the initial gameplay snippet was the lacking quality in movement animation. We've tried to improve this by adding locomotion, which blends animation together. Feedback appreciated!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_1d63bfe504054286bc839c45f8d0efbd~mv2.gif[/img]
[start and end jogging anims are blended onto the new improved base jogging anim]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_72b2afd08eb24e34b9347df22810816d~mv2.gif[/img]
[we've added sprinting into the game, and it comes with a cool stop animation]

[h2]Tree Chopping & Translucency[/h2]

Being able to see behind a tree is really important in farming games. We've spent a lot of time developing our solution, which both feels good, and keep those FPS up.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_072712d4ab9a42dba0c5bd231264d3cf~mv2.gif[/img]
[there is no such thing as hide and seek with the trees on your farm]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_7141b6793d9f44ef8b7d78d26c44f93c~mv2.gif[/img]
[Best Lumberjack Ever]

[h2]Bug Of The Month[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/f3473a9017ba94d3853d8130c1acfe46351ddb0f.gif[/img]

MJ does a moonwalk.
Chicken: "hold my beer'

[h2]What's Coming Next Month[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/9865c581f85bd40499d9525a372633ebfa5010c7.png[/img]

Next month, stay tuned for more character reveals and a look at fishing in the game. We'll also be showcasing what both rain and windy days look like on Coral Island. As always, your feedback is appreciated.

Thanks for reading,  Stairway Team
